title: Good design for a cervical collar, delivering three applications. Easy operation.
text:
This is a smartly designed cervical collar. They have a very credible collar/brace, with various 'pads' to offer a variety of function.
The 'comfort pad' is the simple pad, that extends the collar. It does have a pocket, which you could insert a gel pack (this is not mentioned in the product details, nor is any gel pack included) to have heat/cold therapy.
The magnetic pad looks like a regular pad (no pocket), until you touch the pad and notice some hard objects embedded inside the pad. these are the magnets composed of Tourmaline. Tourmaline magnets are used to promote circulation and calm/soothe one's nerves/anxieties. These magents also 'self-heat' warming up as they come in close proximity to the body. I had my doubts about this feature. However, after testing the pad by placing it on my thigh, it gradually warmed up. I will admit that I was surprised.
The heating pad has a receptacle to accept a power cord. This cord connects to a USB source for power. Note that no USB power plug is included. For a device like this, I think the appropriate USB power plug should be included. Just be aware that you'll need to be near a USB port or have a spare/available USB power plug.
Attached to the USB power cord is the controller. It has two functional buttons: timer and heat controllers.
Pressing each button will cycle through their respective options. An indicator light will signify the chosen selection. Very simple, especially with good contrast, easy to read/understand labeling.
The cervical collar, with three functions, delivers on the product details statements. It performs as expected, including the surprising magnetic (Tourmaline) pad. As a simple cervical support collar, it is comfortable with adequate support. And since the pads are similar, this comfort and support is consistent amongst the three function pads.
Attached are photos to show real world images of the collar, with a ruler for size reference.
Based on these initial impressions, this product meets expectations, earning a 4.5 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

title: Exquisite, beautiful Himalayan Salt hearts. Exactly as shown. Lovely.
text:
I got these with the intention of using it for massage treatments. However, once the significant other saw them, she said they should be displayed because they look beautiful and emit strong energies. I did have to agree with her. They seem like works of crystal art/sculpture. So, if you plan to purchase these for massage purposes, you might consider buying two sets. One for display and one for massage.

The pair of hearts received are very similar to the pictured product. One is pale pink, while the other has more of a rose pink hue. The shape/form are practically identical. There are generously sized, with corresponding thickness. The heart shape is well proportioned. I estimate the height and width at approximately 3 inches, with the thickest aspect about 1.5 inches. Attached are photos to show real world images, with a ruler for size reference.

Even though they are touted for their mineral content and physiotherapy application, they can easily stand alone on their visual beauty. These Himalayan Sea hearts are expertly crafted, resulting in wonderful heart shapes, with appropriately smooth surfaces.

The pair of salt hearts come in a gauze drawstring bag, that increases it's worthiness as a gifting option.

We are both impressed with these Himalayan Salt hearts. It matches the image and descriptions in the product details. It deservedly earns a 4.75 - 5 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

title: Perfect fit. Good quality. Arch support a bit stiff. Excellent heel design.
text:
I wear a mens 8.5, and this insole is listed in their size chart indicating compatible with size mens 8 - 8.5. Well, it fits absolutely perfectly inside my Nike sneakers. At first, when I put my foot on the insole, it was definitely longer than my foot. So, would it be cramped inside the sneaker? The answer: Nope. Once I got the heel in place, i put my hand inside to feel if the toe end was curled, or not lying flat. It was a perfect fit.
I walk, bike, jump rope and play some sports (mostly tennis). While i don't have the best arch, i haven't really had problems with foot fatigue or injuries. Doctors haven't suggested orthotics. So, I'm usually wary of arch supports (not wanting to create an issue or a dependence). This insole does have a somewhat stiff arch support. I did some biking with this in my sneakers. In the beginning I was aware of the arch support, but eventually I forgot about it. I think the true test will be from a few mile walk or sports.
I like the heel design. It seems to envelop the heel, without feeling constricting. The design makes it feel more secure and custom fitted than the original condition of the sneaker.
Not having to trim the insole already created a favorable first impression. The product seems to be composed of quality materials and construction. There are many favorable/positive aspects of these insoles. If the arch was not as stiff, i would be totally content. But, the issue with the arch is a personal bias. Who knows, after extended use of these insoles I may want better arch support all the time.
Based on these initial impressions, this insole product earns a solid 4.75 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

title: Exactly as shown and described. Great touch-up kit.
text:
If you get a scratch, scrape or minor chip on wooden furniture (actually any wooden surface), somehow it seems magnified and always catches your eye. Even a tiny, slight scratch.
This touch-up kit can help minimize that annoyance. It comes with 10 touch-up markers and 10 filler touch-up crayons. The supplied colors: Black, Gray, White, Mahogany, Maple, Oak, Cherry, Walnut, Chestnut and Brunt Sienna. Each set has it's own specialty.
The touch-up markers will mask a slight scrape or scratch. The 10 markers have a range of wood tones that should accommodate most finished wood surfaces. The filler sticks resemble crayons, and you use the included sharpener to make a finer point, depending on the nature of the repair. They recommend warming the filler stick before application. You rub this filler stick into the problem area, 'filling' it. Allow it to dry. To refine the repair, use the touch-up marker to attain a close match to the surrounding wood.
If the filler stick doesn't handle the repair, it's probably not a minor issue. Then you could try other repair products, like wood putty or plastic wood to fill the chip or crack. Then when those products are dry/cured, you can use the touch-up markers to match the original wood.
The product matches the product details. It's a worthwhile repair kit. Besides furniture repair, it can be used in arts/crafts projects, too. Overall, the product is exactly as shown and described. It won't create magic and restore things like new. But, it will mask obvious scratches, scuffs and chips. So, it earns a 4.25 - 4.5 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

title: Nice, quality black gua sha. Too many noticeable nick/pock marks.
text:
Don't know if this is black jade, seems more likely to be obsidian. In general, the stone is black with no blending or gradations exhibited: it's totally black (thus the guess that it's actually obsidian). The stone is fine, with a nice thickness. It's fairly well polished with nice shine and associated smoothness. However, there are too many nick, pock marks on the gua sha. These appear as white marks. It's possible that they're post manufacturing damage, since the marks are white, possibly from slamming into another stone or object.
In the attached photos, two pictures show some of these marks, which will be clearly visible, the white marks contrasting with the black stone.
These defects/flaws negatively impact the rating. So, while the black gua sha is a nice product that closely matches the product details, it receives a 4 star rating.

title: Excellent construction. Nice size. Elegant, attractive tools.
text:
The significant other has another set that follows the same design form. However, these are substantially larger. She was very delighted when she saw the size of these attractive eye massage tools. Besides the size, we were both impressed by the rich golden lustre. These are very eye catching instruments.
Close inspection of these tools found no defects or flaws. They are smooth, with nary a scratch or mar. Pristine examples of good craftsmanship.
Excellent construction. We like the larger size, while not at all cumbersome. The set matches the description and images in the product details. It earns a 4.75 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

title: Beautiful Aventurine Jade Massage Roller and Gua Sha. Excellent value/bargain.
text:
While the gua sha and massage rollers exhibit different coloration, each piece is composed of excellent quality aventurine jade. The comely presentation elevates the worthiness as a gifting option, too.
The highlight of this set is the massage roller. It has a smooth jade roller on one end, and the other end contains a jade roller with segmented ridges. The center handle/shaft is also crafted from aventurine jade, not a resin product. The three jade elements of this massage roller are color matched, with a rich dark green hue, interspersed with shades of lighter green. If you subscribe to energies within stones/crystals, I would offer that the dramatic aspect of the jade stones intones considerable power/energy.
The metal arm is sturdy, and has a metal collar/ring where it enters the jade rollers. This collar is found on better quality massage rollers. Also at this juncture, the metal arm enters the jade rollers with a plastic grommet/plug acting as a bearing buffer. This affords a quiet and smooth rolling motion when in action. Just as important, this grommet acts as a buffer, to protect both the jade and the metal arm from abrasive interaction during the rolling action. The quality of the aventurine jade, quality of design and construction are all indicative of a premium level product.
The gua sha is a fine contrast of color to the massage roller. It's a lighter green, with streaks and marbling of darker greens. The gua sha follows the conventional heart shape, and has a thin, flat characteristic. With this thinner element, the edges are not as rounded, but there are no harsh sharp edges. The gua sha does not have scratches or nicks.
Both the massage roller and gua sha have noteworthy aventurine jade stones. They have decent polishing, but still maintains a natural stone tactile feel. The surfaces are smooth, but not glossy, nor a mirror smooth finish. If you believe in the inherent energies and properties of stones/crystals, you will probably prefer this level of polishing. The more closer to a natural state, the more effective the jade.
At the current cost of $10, this is an incredible bargain. I think either piece alone would cost more than that. So, this is an excellent value, deal.
Premium quality design, materials and construction, coupled with an incredible price point, make this a very serious contender if you're searching for a worthwhile aventurine jade massage roller and gua sha set. This set merits a 5- star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

title: Wonderful trio of gua sha massage tools. Color matched drawstring bag and eye mask.
text:
An impressive collection of rose quartz gua sha variants. It includes the popular heart shape, a paw shape and a rectangular with notch. These are composed of quality rose quartz, and not resin. Personally, I prefer actual stone materials over resin formed tools. If you subscribe to energies and metaphysical properties, you'll only want stones, and these will fit the bill.
Each of the rose quartz pieces are nicely color coordinated, making them a perfect set. In fact, they match up to the drawstring bag and eye mask, too. The whole product offering delivering a comprehensive color motif.
Instead of detailing the characteristics of each component of this trio, I'll note the collective observations, since there is a uniform level of quality shared amongst them.
The rose quartz appears to be good quality. The designs of the gua sha follow the usual, conventional forms. The rose quartz have uniform thickness, which looks and feel appropriate for gua sha instruments. They are nicely polished, affording a quality shine and smoothness, the surface free of scratches, nicks and marring. As previously mentioned, the trio all maintain a consistent pink coloration aspect.
Attached are photos to show real world images of the rose quartz gua sha set, with a ruler for size reference. Note the consistent color theme.
Very close scrutiny of the gua sha implements found no issues with quality or materials or manufacture. Just well crafted gua sha massage tools, with excellent rose quartz. I am impressed with this product offering. It clearly matches the description and pictures in the product details. Accordingly, it merits a 5 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

title: Great transportable phototherapy device. 54W = good power. 630nm, 660nm and 850nm wavelengths.
text:
Considering the design, the form makes this a very transportable device. It even comes with a drawstring bag to store it. With a rating of 54W, this has ample power, similar to some of the more powerful bulb types. It covers 630nm, 660nm and 850nm wavelengths, as opposed to most bulb types that don't only include red light 660nm and infrared 850nm. I also feel the rectangular format issues a more uniform exposure.
The power cord has the power button, which also accesses the timing function. Successive taps of the power button will cycle the timer settings. Including the usb power plug is a smart decision, making the item a complete product. Now, the user won't have to search for an available usb port, or a spare usb power plug. The only disappointment is the lack of a user guide/manual. But, to be fair, other red light therapy bulbs that we have did not have a user guide/manual included.
Another included accessory is the folding stand. It can unfold in various configurations to allow numerous positions for the lamp. See the attached photos, I show two possible configurations, with the lamp in horizontal and vertical orientation.
Attached are photos to show real world images of the product, with a ruler for size reference. Note the compact size, and the smart design. There is no fan, operating in complete silence. This product could easily travel inside a gym bag or luggage.
If you are searching for a credible, quiet photobiomodulation (red light therapy/phototherapy) lamp for skin, muscle treatment, this deserves serious consideration. It matches the descriptions and images in the product details, and appears to be a very well crafted device. It earns a solid 4.75 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

title: Excellent value/bargain. Gorgeous white jade gua sha. Great gift option.
text:
The attractive presentation lifts the worthiness as a gifting option. Inside a simple, white fabric drawstring bag is a well crafted white jade gua sha. The stone is almost completely white. If you angle the stone to alter how the light hits it, you can see faint shades within the white. If you want a white stone, this will satisfy your expectations.
The stone has the usual thickness, definitely unlike some thinner gua sha with flattened characteristics. The stone is nicely polished, affording a shiny and smooth surface. The contour edging is well rounded, with the same degree of polishing, creating a comprehensive smooth and shiny exterior.
Close inspection of the gua sha discovered no defects or flaws. There are not scratches or marring evident. Of note, there are no nicks along the contour of the stone.
This very credible white jade gua sha is competitively priced at $7.40. It's actually lower than the usual range of gua sha, $9 - $17.
Based on the quality, appearance and good tactile feel of the product, it earns a 4.75 - 5 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

title: Credible facial rotating brush. IPX7 waterproof. Compact size.
text:
This rotating cleaning brush matches the descriptions and pictures in the product details. It has three good speed settings, accessed by successive presses of the power button. As is common in such devices, a long press of the power button will power the device on or off. The power/speed button is located on the bottom of the device. This product requires slightly more force to activate the button, because there is a silicone covering that secures the watertight aspect for the power button, and the charging port.
The device is nicely designed, with a nice compact size. I like that it can stand upright easily (see attached photos). It comes with the silicone bristle brush head already attached. Two bristle brush heads are also included. The silicone brush head works well, especially for exfoliation. I found the softer bristle brushes actually enhances the foaming of soapy lather on the face. I think a smart move would be for a brush head that includes both silicone and normal bristles to get best of both worlds.
The brush heads easily pull off and press on. As mentioned, the three speeds offer a range from a gentle cleansing to a more robust scrubbing.
It's IPX7 waterproof, which means it can be used in the shower or bath without water damage. I always wonder how any cleaning brush could not be IPX7, since it will always involve interaction with water. Anyway, this product meets that requisite waterproof rating.
The initial removal of the cap was a bit frustrating, but once it was on/off a few times, it was fine. Although, I would advise that the cap be removed before you lather up your hands with soap/shampoo, because your hands will be slippery and you can't get a good grip of the cap.
Overall, this is a very credible rotating brush. This is a nicely manufactured product, with a simple, straightforward utlity: a rotating brush device with three speeds. It met expectations, and currently sits on the bathroom sink. Based on these initial impressions, this cleaning brush earns a solid 4.5 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

title: Cute. Good flexibility. IPX7 Waterproof. Decent speed. Adorable.
text:
Per the significant other, this is adorable. It's smaller than expected, which works to it's advantage in this case. It is flexible, and not just at the neck of the device. It handle yields, and bends allowing a generous arching.
The operation is very easy and simple. Press and hold the power button. This requires a deeper press than usually found on other facial brushes. This is because the device has a generous silicone covering, which establishes the IPX7 waterproof rating. In fact, this rating allows this device to be safely used in the shower or bath. (At the bottom of the handle is the self-healing silicone port for the charging cord. It closes and seals to maintain the waterproof integrity.)
Once powered with a long press of the power button. Successive short presses of the power button cycles through the 4 speed settings. The silicone brush is not silent, emitting an audible buzz/hum. The frequency changes with speed increases. The accompanying speed increase does noticeably increase the vibrations felt during skin contact. The sound level might be a bit louder than desired, but it's indicative of the powerful motor. Personally, since the motor/vibrations are robust, I can accept the associated sound levels.
We both like the appearance and performance of this silicone brush. I am amazed at the degree of 'bend' capability of this device. (The significant other just yelled to me that it's pink, so it's hers, and I shouldn't use it. Find a buy a blue one. haha)
The product is exactly as described and shown in the product details. It easily earns a 4.75 - 5 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

title: Decent sound quality. Very poor manual. Audio files seem sub par.
text:
I was intrigued by a sound machine that also displayed the temperature and humidity. And, this product does indeed prominently show that information. Maybe the next innovation will be incorporating a clock with an alarm (with option to sue the various sounds), which would be fantastic. But, the temperature/humidity works as advertised.
There are few buttons, which would normally indicate ease of operation. However, in this instance, it could use at least one more button. There is a power button, a long press turns it on/off. Below that button is a control for volume. Unfortunately, it the only button for volume control. You cannot selectively increase/decrease volume. You need to go to full audio before you can begin lowering. Separate buttons for up/down makes more sense on a sound machine. At the very least, some manner to control the direction of volume.
There is a time button, that allows selection of 20, 40 or 60 minutes, with the default being no timer setting.
On the right side of the display, the top button has a lock icon. This button will lock the settings. Press this button and a single tone indicates lock state, another press with 2 tones is unlocked.
Below that button are two buttons, that give access to the categories and sub-group of audio files. The speaker system is surprisingly good for a sound machine/night light. Unfortunately, the audio/sound files do not seem to be the best quality or wise selections. For example, the water sounds are not soothing. One sounds like water dripping, which may be more like torture than sleep inducing. I went through a majority of the sounds, and couldn't find any that I thought would be conducive for meditating or sleeping.
The manual is close to useless. Perhaps the only value of the manual is to see the listing of all 48 sounds contained in the machine. I found that most of the functions were discovered by trial and error.
Case in point. the manual shows that there's a button with a light bulb icon, that controls the lighting on the machine. There is no such button. But, touching the speaker grill on the top of the device will cycle the lighting scenarios.
Now that I figured out the buttons and lighting, I wish the sound files were better. Based on these observations and considerations, this sound machine earns a 2.75 - 3 star rating.

title: Decent quality. Some scratches, nicks.
text:
The rose quartz in this set of 2 gua sha is decent quality. They both have a pale pink hue interspersed within a translucent form. So, I appreciate the look of the rose quartz. They follow the conventional heart shape gua form, and fit nicely, comfortably in the hand.
The value of two gua sha usage can be seen if the user is ambidextrous, and can maneuver both stones simultaneously. Another course of action, is to use one stone, while the other is being prepared for use (either being warmed, cooler,'purified' or 'treated'). Or, two people could be using the rose quartz gua sha, respectively in separate applications. Or, you can separate the pair and have two gifts. Plus, the price of the pair makes them very cost effective, significantly lower than purchasing two separate rose quartz gua sha.
Unfortunately, each of the stones has scratches and nicks. The stones are adequately polished, but the defects, flaws are easily noticeable.
When I first received the set, I thought at least one of the gua sha had broken, because I could hear the sound of stone hitting stone. Neither was broken, thankfully. However, the gua sha stones were just inserted into a plastic bag, with no cushioning between or around them. This could account for the scratches and nicks found on each gua sha.
Due to the noticeable defects, flaws in each gua sha stone, the rating suffers accordingly. If the rose quartz gua sha set did not have the scratches and nicks, it would have been a 5 star rating. Based on these considerations, the set earns a 3.5 - 3.75 star rating. If you purchase and get a 'clean' set, do the happy dance.

title: Decent quality replacement brushes for Oral B.
text:
These are credible replacement brush heads for Oral B electric toothbrushes. I own an Oral B Genius Pro 8000, and this fits perfectly. It performs identically to the name brand (Oral B) brush heads. Unlike some replacement brushes that are a noticeably snug/tight fit, these attach with the same ease as the name brand brush, too.
But, all is not wonderful. There's a reason that they use illustrations and not true photos of the brush head. The sections of bristles are not as well grouped/defined as a new Oral B brush. The bristles do not appear as uniformly packed, seeming to be a bit 'sloppy'. However, the brush still seems to perform fine. A test brushing felt as thorough as a brand name brush session.
I appreciate that the brush heads are individually sealed/wrapped. Many brush heads come in a group on a blister card. So, when you use one, you open the package and the remaining brushes are no longer protectively sealed. This is a big plus, in my opinion.
Attached are photos to show real world images, with comparison pictures with an Oral B brush head. Also, images of the product attached to my Oral B Genius Pro 8000, to show perfect fit.
The cost is much less than the brand name replacement brush heads. However, this set of 8 is a bit pricey when compared to other quality replacement heads.
Overall, these are decent quality replacement brush heads. It earns a 4.25 - 4.5 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

title: Attractive, quality rose quartz. Affordable rose quartz gua sha. Very good value.
text:
Examination of this rose quartz gua sha found no scratches or nicks. The edges are flawless, very smooth and nicely rounded. In fact, the whole stone is nicely polished and very smooth to the touch. The pink coloration is beautiful. The product follows the conventional design form of gua sha, which is a smart move. No need to fix something that's not broken. And, instead devote energies toward producing a quality product, which they've done. Attached are photos to show real world images, with a ruler for size reference.
The general range of cost for similar rose quartz gua sha is $10 - $17 (with some actually over $20; and occasionally you may find a special discount for $9). So, at the current cost of $10, this product is very competitively priced. It's a very good value, bargain.
The quality of the rose quartz, the excellent manufacture and bargain/value delivers a 4.75 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

title: Decent speakers, good audio selections. Nite light color selectable. True AC adapter included.
text:
The sound machine aptly reflects the pictures and descriptions in the product details. There is a large assortment of sound choices, each of decent quality. The speaker is decent, although a bit lacking in the lower frequencies (bass sounds). The sound machine does operate as expected. While the icon based touch buttons are a bit small, they are rather easy to figure out (especially easy if you read the user guide, and view the round card insert that details the function of each button (see attached photo, close up of the round card).
A 3 second press of the 'sun' icon will activate the light feature. Successive taps of that same button will cycle through the various colors. A 3 second press of the button will turn off the lighting feature. That's an example of how easy and simple the operation of this product.
Opposite the 'sun' icon are the three touch buttons to select the audio/sounds. There's 32 audio options available. You can adjust the sound level, however the lighting intensity cannot be adjusted.
The clock icon engages the timer options.
The operation of the sound machine is much common sense, and pretty straightforward.
An important note: this is not a rechargeable battery operated device. This could account for the better speaker (needing more power for this aspect). While I prefer cordless operation of this genre product, this was not a stated feature of the product. So, this does not negatively affect the rating.
On the other hand, a full AC adapter with long cord is included. Not a USB cable that requires a free USB port, or a USB power plug. This is a plus.
Another feature mentioned is the availability of a headphone jack. I find this a bit odd, but I guess if someone wants the sounds, without disturbing someone in the same room, headphones would be considerate. This scenario only makes sense if you're planning to use the sound machine for meditating or relaxing. I don't envision someone wearing headphones while planning to fall asleep.
This is a very credible sound machine with a rather bright night light feature. It basically satisfied expectations, based upon the descriptions and pictures in the product details. It earns a 4.25 - 4.5 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

title: Very nice product. Excellent non-metallic mesh scrubbers. Decent quality handles.
text:
The set of pot/dish scrubbers is smartly designed, with decent quality materials and construction. The handles are composed of a stiff silicone material (this is my guess, since they don't state what the handles are made of). My concern was how hard and sharp were the prongs used to hold the mesh scrubbers. At this point, I don't think they would cause any scratches or marks. If some of the prongs crack, exposing very sharp points that scratch or mar a surface, I will return and amend this review.
As mentioned, the head of the handles have a multi-pronged structure, that pierces the mesh scrubbers. This works well. I found many pieces of the mesh scrubbers that broke off. Will this repeat often, to the point that it won't easily 'stick' to the prongs?
The mesh scrubbers come in white, gold and silver. The gold and silver do resemble the metallic scrubbing products, but are composed of the same 'safe' nylon material as the white version. But, the metallic tones do look convincing and look nice.
I like that they provide a long handle and 'handle-less' versions. I tend to use the the smaller one for cleaning pots and dishes. The significant other uses the handled version for the same tasks. So, it's purely a matter of preference.
Attached are photos to show real world images, with a ruler for size reference. I'm uncertain why the product details fails to show the prongs on the handles, but I've provided those images for both handles.
Overall, it's a very nice product, with decent quality materials and manufacture. The set receives a solid 4.5 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

title: Thin masks. Attractive. Non-adjustable elastic band. Good value.
text:
The printed graphic and materials of the mask are decent quality. The mask is constructed with an opening, so you could insert more material to further block out light. If you need a very thin, light weight mask, these are worthy of consideration.
The masks have an elastic band sewn into the sides. There is no adjustment mechanism. In fact, it's the sort of elastic that will eventually lose elasticity. At that point, you could cut the elastic strap and attach velcro dots to the severed elastic band to secure the mask to the head. That's just one possible remedy for the eventual failure of the elastic band. It's unfortunate, because I do like the mask itself.
The mask is thin, and strong light may penetrate. There is a blue material lining the inside, which blocks out most of the light, though. If you are playing a game that requires a blindfold (pin the tail on donkey), these are excellent.
At the current price of $10 for three masks, it's a good value. Are they premium quality? No. Are they decent quality, that are visually pleasing? Yes. So, for the cost, it's more than worthwhile. Attached are photos to show real world images, with a ruler for size reference.
Based on the quality and cost/value, this set of 3 masks earns a 4.0 - 4.25 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

title: Mediocre performance. Not for use in wet conditions. Information discrepancies.
text:
This cordless razor for women has a nice design, but has performance issues. It seems to have a decent battery, but the overall power is rated at 3W. Compared to cordless hair clippers that are rated at minimum of 5W, and most are much higher than that. This could account for the suspect effectiveness of the device. Also, like many electric razors, the hairs should not be long. Long hairs tend to get pulled in most electric razors, that's just the tendency of long hair and moving blades. So, at best, this works best with fine, short hairs. If you use it daily, there will be less pulling, and a more comfortable shaving experience. Is this ideal? No, but that's the best circumstance to use this device.
The product details mentions in some spots that this is a 'wet/dry' device. The user manual explicitly states to keep this device away from wet conditions. Huge discrepancy. If someone just followed th product details and not carefully read the user manual, there could be serious issues. This serious misinformation negatively affects the ratings.
The product details also says it has a lithium battery. The product states it has a Ni-Cd battery, huge difference. There are more discrepancies, but these two major items suffice to note that the product details give inaccurate (and possibly dangerous) information.
Based on these considerations and issues, I would caution anyone considering this product.

title: Excellent source of organic maca.
text:
Maca is a superfood, adaptogen, that I consume daily. It is an acquired taste, mind you. I usually add it to coffee, along with mushroom powder blend and protein powder (sometimes a collagen powder, and often chocolate flavored). This is what I call my superman, superfood morning cup of coffee. Some studies have shown vast health benefits from maca consumption. It's contains antioxidants, vitamins, minerals and generally considered to be nutrient dense. It helps with energy, mood, general well being and hormonal balances, too.
The company notes that they "tested dozens of samples from various suppliers around the country, and based our choice on organic quality, flavor profile, 3rd party testing, and country of origin. WE DO NOT SOURCE OUR INGREDIENTS FROM CHINA" (Note: country mentioned is Peru.) I mention this aspect because many are concerned about the purity and integrity of supplements/foods with China origination. And, with maca being a native product of Peru, it makes sense to get the 'real' thing from the proper source.
The label has certifications/badges for: Gluten-free, Soy-free, Non-GMO, Packaged In USA and USDA Organic. The certification for USDA Organic is comforting. I wish they also had FDA registered facility and/or cGMP certifications.
The scent and taste of this maca is exactly as expected. I feel that it's an excellent source for quality maca.
This product merits a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

title: Excellent selection of sounds. Perfect for sleeping or meditation.
text:
An excellent device to create an audio ambiance. There are a number of user selectable options regarding audio type, volume, color of lighting, timer setting. So, it's easily customizable per your intended use.
We have a sound machine in the bedroom, and this will have a home in the home office, which is also the mediation room. Usually we like to use the water sounds, but sometimes the white noise is more useful to block out extraneous sounds/noise. Setting the timer is a gentle way to know when the scheduled meditation has ended. Instead of an alarm of some sorts, the sound machine simply ceases. Wonderful.
Even if you're not into meditation, place this unit in your bedroom. When you're feeling stressed, set up a relaxing sound and lie down. Just relax and breathe...be conscious of your breathing and just don't think about things. Just relax. And, umm, well, now you're practically meditating. hehe. You'd be surprised how this little mental respite can refresh you.
The only issue with this product is the absence of a USB power plug. It comes with a usb power cable, but needs a USB power port. Having this near a laptop or computer kinda defeats the purpose of the sound machine (getting away from stress/work). So, you need to purchase or have a spare USB power adapter plug, like the one usually used for smartphones. Luckily, with the proliferation of smartphones, most people have a spare usb power plug. For a device like this, the usb power plug should be included.
Overall, it's a fantastic product. It meets expectations, matching up to the descriptions and pictures in the product details. Attached are photos to show real world images of the sound machine.
it's a very useful and competent product. If it came with the usb power plug, it might be close to a 5 star rating. However, based on impressions and considerations, this product earns a 4.75 - 5 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

title: One side is effective, being a good quality shower brush. Other side is a fail.
text:
The soft bristle brush on this shower brush is very effective, and works as expected. The wooden handle is crafted nicely, with no sharp edges or 'thorns' (small splintery aspects). In general, with manufactured well with no unexpected surprises.
The surprise comes from the other brush side. From the product details: "One side is very soft and holds soap well, and the other side of the natural bristles is perfect for a deep scrub,especially in the exfoliation." Well, the natural bristles are somewhat stiff, but actually work well with scrubbing the back. Especially compared to the reverse side. This is supposed to be the softer bristle side. Instead of bristles, there's a widely spaced pattern of nubs (plastic, nylon, silicone?) that are not natural bristles. These nubs are attached to a flexible base, so they bend with contact and pressure. The nubs are not soft, by any definition. As mentioned, the base is flexible, and allows these nubs to rub along the skin.
I found this shower brush to be incongruent with the product details description.
If the hard nub side was not on a flexible base, it could serve as a decent back scratcher. As is, i feel it's ineffective and a design fail.
Another issue: the pictures show an exaggerated view of the size of the brush.
So, one side, with natural bristles, is an effective, functional shower brush. The other side is a fail. Based on these impressions and consideration, this shower brush earns a 3.25 star rating, and a cautious recommendation.

title: Excellent method to custom fit supports.
text:
This is a versatile and effective insole/orthotic. There are pairs of inserts that you can affix to the insole (or the inner sole of the footwear, thought placement would be tricky). They vary in size, but have the same height. You can build up to achieve your personal need by placing smaller insert on top, creating a dome-like shape. The orange inserts are 'normal' and the yellow inserts are 'softer' cushioning. You can stick with one form, or mix them. For example, a firmer bottom insert with a softer upper piece.
A word of advice: If you plan to use the cutting guide, and not the existing original insole as a template (maybe it's glued in and can't be removed), then cut larger than you think is necessary. Then you can fine tune the cut for a perfect fit. If you cut too short, there's not much recourse.
I like that you can start with this product as a cushioned insole, and gradually build up for arch support. Further, appreciate the option to customize the softness of the arch support. I put this into my winter boots, with soft arch support, and it feels great. My shoe size is mens 8.5, and it's near the lower end of this product's Medium size. I think I cut along the lines that measure for size 9 (checking that it seemed larger than the existing space). Lo and behold, it fit perfectly into the boot. Maybe boots have extra space, more than sneakers or regular shoes. But, this is the very reason I advise cutting larger and then fine tune your adjustments.
Overall, the product appears to be constructed of quality materials, similar to other insole/orthotic products. It is not as stiff as other orthotics, which I prefer. (I don't require an orthotic, even though i don't have normal arch levels. So, i use cushioned insoles which give a gentle arch assist/support.) I used the softer insert, for a gentle slope and support. At this point it's difficult to assess durability. It seems to be made with quality materials, similar to other insole products. However, if it deteriorates quickly, or affords less comfort/support, i will amend this review.
I like the concept and implementation of the assorted shapes and stiffness of self stick inserts, with a cushioned formed insole. This product earns a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

title: 9g protein per 10g serving. Good unflavored taste.
text:
This is a very competent collagen peptide powder. It delivers 9 grams of hydrolyzed collagen peptides per 10 gram serving. It has only 35 calories, No Fats, No Carbohydrates, No Sugars, No other ingredients other than Collagen Hydroglyzed (Beef) Powder. So, this is as clean as you get.
I added it to a morning smoothie, that had strawberries as the dominant flavor note. One scoop of this powder added no discernible taste to the drink. Fantastic. I did the finger taste taste, and any flavor is barely perceptible.
I am impressed. I am considering adding this powder to some tapioca pudding I'm making as dessert, to kick up the health/protein aspect.
The label contains a number of certifications and badges. The one that if of most critical to me is cGMP. Certified Good Manufacturing Practices denotes attention to the purity and integrity of the ingredients and manufacturing processes. Checking off this box is an import plus for me. At the current price of $23, it's reasonably priced.
Good certification/badge, very good 'non-flavoring', excellent hydrolyzed collagen peptides powder, decent price leads to a solid 4.5 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

title: Credible silicone scalp shampoo brush. Precursor to company's real product.
text:
Overall, the product matches the descriptions and pictures in the product details. The silicone appears to be very good quality. This is obviously the precursor to the company's real product, being the outer shell. My guess is the intention to put a battery operated vibrating motor to provide a vibrating shampoo brush. Actually, that sounds like a good idea. (In fact, the company answered a question noting that an electronic version is due soon.)
So, while the brush quality is good, and it does work well, the brush is unnecessarily bulky. The bulk doe not aid or improve the function or effectiveness of the brush. One could argue that if taking a bath, the brush will float. Ok, that's true. But, there are silicone shampoo brushes with a lower profile, some with a silicone handle. Plus, those brushes tend to be lower in price compared to this product. Perhaps the company needed to clear inventory, while it awaits the electronic components and decided to sell the shells as 'manual' brushes. Just conjecture on my part.
A vibrating silicone shampoo brush is intriguing. A silicone shampoo brush that has a hollow cavity, that does not serve any benefit to the effectiveness or function is odd.
Anyway, the quality of the brush is very good. Functionally, it is a competent silicone brush. Compared to other manual silicone brushes, it a bit on the pricier side. So, based on these considerations, this silicone shampoo brush receives a 4 - 4.25 star rating.

title: Excellent mushroom extracts. 5 popular mushrooms in capsule.
text:
As a long time advocate/user of mushrooms, in bulk powder and capsule forms, I am impressed with the ingredients in this supplement. Mushrooms have shown potential health benefits regarding antioxidants, anti-inflammatories, immune system boosters and positive aspects relating to brain/neural systems. That and tasting great, at least in my opinion.
This supplement provides a good quantity of the various mushroom extracts per capsule: 500mg Lion's Mane 4:1 Extract, 50mg Chaga Mushroom 4:1 Extract, 50mg Maitake Mushroom 4:1 Extract, 50mg Shiitake Mushroom 4:1 Extract & 50mg Reishi Mushroom 30% Extract. And, the company notes these are all extracts from fruiting bodies.
The bottle displays certifications/badges for 100% All Natural Premium Ingredients, Made in USA and cGMP (certified Good Manufacturing Practices). The cGMP is the most important badge, to me, because it indicates attention to the purity and integrity of the ingredients and processing. So, check this box.
Serving size is 2 capsules, with 60 capsules per bottle. If you consume other mushrooms, or supplements that offer the same health benefits, you could take one capsule/day and extend this supplement to 60 days.
Overall, I like and am impressed by the ingredients in this mushroom extract supplement. It matches exactly to the description and depiction in the product details. It earns a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

title: Very good flavor. 20g protein per 35g serving. only 12 sevings = pricey
text:
First, the chocolate fudge flavoring is very good. This might account for the rather high caloric numbers per serving. Also, 35g per serving seems like a considerable amount of powder for a protein mix. The notion that a Supplement Facts would note a serving size as being "2 heaped tbsp" seems like a rather inaccurate measurement. Either include a scoop, or use a conventional measure, like 1 level tbsp or 10g. Using 'heaped' could varying significantly based on the size and shape of the spoon.
This product contains collagen, milk protein concentrate, whey powder, whey protein concentrate, instant whole milk powder. I like that it has 0 saturated/trans fats and only 5mg of cholesterol. It does have 6g of sugars per serving. Of the 20g protein, 10g is collagen. Thus the remaining protein is derived from the milk/whey powders and protein concentrates. This does give a nice balance of collagen (which is not a complete protein source) and milk/whey proteins (which is considered a complete source of essential amino acids).
Based on their suggested serving size, there is only 12 servings in the container. I would prefer these types of products to provide a month's supply. So, based on 12 servings, this is a pricey collagen/protein mix.
There are badges for Gluten-free and All Natural Ingredients. However, not for GMP or 3rd Party Tested, which is disappointing.
The flavoring is top notch. The calories are excessive. The servings per container is too low. Pricey.
Based on these considerations, this collagen/protein mix earns a 3.5 - 3.75 star rating.

title: Impressed with the ingredients, with high potential health benefits. Collagen Peptides, too.
text:
I truly like the assortment of healthy ingredients in this Beauty Blend Powder. It contains: Beet, Maca, Chaga Mushroom, Goji Berry, Maqui Berry, Acai & Collagen Peptides. As a disclaimer, part of my daily regimen includes beet powder, maca root powder, various mushroom powders and protein/collagen powder. So, having these, with the antioxidant/flavonoids from the berries is welcome.
They don't list the quantities of each ingredient, but a 6.6g serving yields 3g protein. So, I am guessing that the collagen peptides fills most of that protein. That brings up an issue. I think users want more details about the quantities of the ingredients.
I do appreciate that the Nutritional Facts lists certain facts/numbers. 0 sugars, 0 cholesterol and virtually 0 fat are important aspects, in my opinion.
The flavors of the berries basically masks the flavors of the other ingredients. Adding it to a smoothie or almond milk gives it a purplish hue. it's a tasty addition.
There are no badges/certifications relating to FDA or GMP, which is somewhat disappointing. However, i did enjoy and appreciate the ingredients in this superfood blend. Accordingly, it earns a solid 4 star rating, with a moderately high level recommendation.

title: 250mg Trans Resveratrol per capsule. Very good value.
text:
It seems resveratrol products are finally becoming more commonly available, and from various companies. Further, trans-resveratrol, which is the 'active' component is being marketed (derived as a resveratrol extract). This product is an interesting variant which is composed of resveratrol extract (50%), yielding 250 mg of trans-Resveratrol per capsule.
While the suggested serving is 2 capsules, I would advise starting with one capsules and build up to 2 capsules per day. As with other supplements, give your body a chance to assimilate to the new addition to your diet. Also, see how your personal biology reacts. And, since this is an extract, it's more concentrated than normal resveratrol.
The two important badges on the bottle note Mae in USA, and GMP certified facility. These are comforting and confidence inducing aspects.
This supplement is very competitive in the resveratrol marketplace. So, beside being a 50% extract, it's also a decent price value.
As with many supplement, and especially with products like resveratrol, the benefits are not readily apparent. You ingest many supplements like this in quest of long term benefits (some supplements do provide relatively quicker benefit/effects, though). So, I can't comment on the efficacy of this specific product.
The product does match the descriptions and depictions in the product details.
Overall, the product earns a 4.25 - 4.5 star rating ,with a high level recommendation.

title: Mask is bit stiff and small. Plain, generic strap extenders. Nice neck lanyards.
text:
While the product has a nice presentation, instead of simply tossed into a plastic bag, there are shortcomings to the mask. I liked the openness of the design, which allows for easier an greater air flow. However, the size is rather small, and most people will feel that with the top place on the tip of the nose, it will barely cover the mouth.
Another issue is the stiffness of the mask. While I applaud the attempt to make a durable product, the stiffness makes the mask cumbersome and uncomfortable.
The strap extenders are generic and basically functional. Getting 50 of this item is excessive, but welcome. Personally, I use the ear loops and they're effective and easy to affix and remove.
The lanyards (2 provided) are decent. The masks have connection points, which you can use these lanyards to secure to the face, and to hold the mask when hanging from the neck.
Sadly, I was disappointed in the masks, which is the primary component of this offering. It needs to be more flexible and larger. As such, a rating of 2.75 - 3 stars might still be a bit too generous. A mild level recommendation.

title: 725mg of Vitamin C per capsule.
text:
This supplement contains 725mg of Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid). My usual Vitamin C supplement contains 1g of Vitamin C per capsule. However, this supplement adds Phospholipid Complex (Sunflower Oil and Lecithin), 25mg per capsule. I do like this addition, and prefer lecithin from sunflower instead of soy. In fact, the label also states that it contains no soy at all. There's a list of items that are absent from this supplement, like artificial ingredients, flavors and sweeteners.
The product displays certifications and badges for Made in USA, GMO-free, Vegan, Gluten-free and GMP. The two key badges are the GMO-free and GMP badges, in my opinion. These badges on the bottle lifts the confidence in the supplement's integrity and purity, and positively affect the rating.
So, while it is not as strong as other vitamin c supplements (per capsule measures), it is a very credible supplement. The suggested serving size is 2 capsules, so the does would reach 1450mg, which is more than decent.
Accordingly, this supplement earns a solid 4 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

title: Improvement over previous generation. Softer, more effective bracket. Not perfect, though.
text:
I was intrigued and interested in this upgraded mask bracket. Indeed, I feel it is an improvement over the previous generation bracket. It seems a bit larger and is constructed of softer silicone. This softer material, seemingly more malleable, conforms to the face better. Also, the shape is more triangular, which accommodates the positioning around the nose and mouth.
The larger holes compensates for the more numerous, smaller openings found in prior masks. So, I felt it was actually a bit easier to breathe with this bracket under a mask.
Is it perfect? No. But I think it's practically impossible to design a bracket that would work for everyone. It can't be one size fits all. Luckily, these just barely fit my facial features. I would have liked it to be slightly larger, but it still seems effective at the current sizing.
I don't wear glasses, so I can't comment on resistance to fogging. I'm giving one to my sister, she wears glasses, and will get her opinions on fit and whether it effectively deals with the fogging issues. I will amend this review/rating upon receipt of that evaluation.
Attached are photos to show real world images, with a ruler for size reference.
My initial impressions are positive. Thus, I feel the brackets deserve a 4 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

title: Impressive claims, like the stated ingredients.
text:
I've read alot about the benefits of eating bone marrow (bone marrow broth, too). It's touted for health benefits regarding bone, collagen, immune systems. I respect the stated aspects of this company and this product. Sourcing the ingredients from grass fed, New Zealand pasture raised bovine, and being hormone free and GMO-free,
Of note: "Our certified quality and manufacturing processes are exemplary and safe. From only 100% grass fed cows, our bone marrow supplement is FREE of hormones & GMOs. Our bovine supplements contain absolutely NO fillers or flow agents, and undergo rigorous quality screening for agricultural and chemical contaminants. Manufactured under the highest quality cGMP standards. "
That statement impressed me, I try to be careful and look for manufacturing processes that align with my health pursuit. I am bewildered that none of these 'standards' are noted on the bottle. The omission of these badges or notifications on the bottle does not instill overwhelming confidence in these claims. For this reason, the rating gets appropriately dinged. It is unfortunate because I am impressed with the ingredients, otherwise.
Accordingly, this gets a 3.75 - 4 star rating, with a moderately high recommendation.

title: Problem with USB power supply. TENS unit worked as expected.
text:
This is a credible TENS EMS product, with a variety of patterns and a very good range of intensity.
I wanted a portable unit that I could put in my backpack or sports duffle, so I could deal with achy muscles after sports or doing odd jobs away from home. This unit fits that bill admirably.
The TENS unit is solidly constructed, not too heavy but with enough heft to give it substance. In other words, it doesn't feel cheap or like a toy. The display screen is nicely sized, so viewing the options is fairly easy. There are basically 6 modes, with each having 4 iterations. A and B channels are independent, which allows you to alter the intensity of each channel. While not usually mentioned in these portable TENS units, you can also opt to just set up one set on a channel, for a simplified 'massage' instance.
The setup of the pads is very simple and straightforward. The setup of each channel, selecting the modes and intensities is fairly intuitive. I'm not sure if my prior experience was a large factor, but setting up the channels and actually using this unit seemed very easy and less complicated than previous generations of portable TENS products.
I did have one issue with the product. The USB power supply was faulty. After connecting the power cables, it failed to charge the batteries. I simply used another usb power brick to charge the TENS unit. I will need to test the provided USB power supply to determine if it's truly defective. I will update this review after I determine the actual condition of that component.
After an afternoon of biking and playing some tennis, my leg muscles were barking, especially the calf muscles. So, while at my friend's house, we were both recuperating from being weekend sport warriors, and i pulled out this product, to attend to my leg aches. He watched with amazement and curiosity. After a brief session, he asked if he could try it. So, I set it up on his balky knee, and adjusted the pattern and intensity. He said it's fascinating and effective. I told him I have a set at home, and got this for my 'away' bag, and explained the science/technology behind the TENS EMS. Told him I got it from Amazon. He wrote down the name of the product and said he needed to get one, too. So, that is a random, objective endorsement, which I feel positively influences the rating.
Attached are photos to show real world images, with ruler for size reference.
I feel the product matches exactly with the description and illustrations in the product details. It is decently priced in the market niche. Based on ease of use, and quality of build, it merits 4.25 - 4.5 stars and a high level recommendation.

title: Impressive mushroom supplement. Wish they included Cordyceps.
text:
In general, I liked the components of this mushroom supplement. One mushroom is missing, in my opinion. I would have been happier if they included Coryceps mushroom powder in their mix. However, the mix of mushrooms in this supplement is impressive.
Also impressive, they note that much of the ingredients of the blend are extracts, so theoretically more potent than just mushroom powder.
Overall, an excellent assortment of mushroom powders (in extract form) in a capsule.
High recommendation.

title: Slightly more bitter than comparative products.
text:
Nicely packaged, which I think preserves the freshness of the powder. I like the aspect that it's 'wild grown' organic, and cruelty-free. The certifications are assuring. I've ingested moringa powders from different brands, in capsule form and pure powder. This package seemed a bit more bitter, which was definitely noticeable. I used it alone, and then I added it to a mixture that included maca, spinach, beet and kale powders. The bitterness was less apparent, obviously. Of course it's impossible to assess the efficacy after a few days, even after weeks...So, I won't even try to offer any speculations.
I think that the taste will not be a factor after daily use, which was the case of other powders that I ingest. I will continue to use this product, and the aspects of certifications, being organic and 'wild grown' will encourage me to purchase this brand.
So, in all fairness, I'd currently rate it at 3 - 3.5 stars.

title: Medium size a bit snug, but credible set of dishwasher gloves
text:
Overall, a nice set of dishwashing gloves. They are individually packed, and come sealed in a larger plastic bag. Funny thing is one set was supposed to be green, but my eyes see them as being more bluish. Not to start another internet meme about colors, but i found it interesting the color differed a bit from the product details illustrations. Other than that, these gloves are pretty much as described and depicted by the product details.
One set is unlined, another set is flocked with cotton, integrated into the glove. The gloves I received were size M. As opposed to a different set by the same company, these fit reasonably well. Just a smidge snug, but no complaints. Personally, I usually get these genre of gloves in size L, so that it's easier to put on and remove. I will say the flocked lined gloves were easier to put on and remove, and perhaps has more of a premium, luxurious feel. The company says they use the latest materials and manufacturing processes. Since these gloves feel kinda thin, hope the technology facilitates stronger durability of the materials. However, being thinner, the fingers feel more free to handle items. Personally, I did not notice any appreciable increase in tactile grip, but that could just be a function of normal washing of glasses and dishes. For a test, i was able to pick up a dime from the marble countertop.
I think I may re-purpose the gloves to protect my hands while crafting. I think these could be very useful when making candles in molds, or using soap molds (I don't make soaps, but think these gloves could benefit those that do.).
For the purpose of dish washing, these are fine gloves. They are thin, but I can't determine durability until time, usage has elapsed. If there is any development after some reasonable time of use, I will amend this review (positively or negatively).

title: Decent set of dishwashing gloves, latex-free. IMO, a bit thin.
text:
Overall, a decent set of dishwashing gloves. They are a nice length, and you can always fold them upwards if the length bothers you. The length is nice to protect your sleeves/arms from getting wet, also to prevent water from spilling into the interior of the glove. The integrated flocked lining is the nicer of the two types, with a nicer feel on the hands. This lining also seems to allow easier removal of the gloves, I found.
These were sized L, and they were a little loose, which was fine. I usually wear a L sized men's glove (USA sizing), and the fit is just right.
I cannot say the textured fingertips performed any better than other rubber gloves, partially because I am careful while handling pots or items that are handwashed. The coloring on the fingertips have not real additional functionality.
The gloves seem to be on the thinner side, which concerns me regarding durability. To be fair, time and usage will be the arbiter of that issue. Latex-free for those with such sensitivity.
Again, of the two types, the integrated flocking is the nicer feature.

text:

title: Happy hands!
text:
Okay, this is an awesome little machine. It's small enough to sit on a desk or end table, the battery charges quickly, and the various modes let you choose between several combinations of heat/massage strength/pressure and duration.

The only downside is that if you don't have your hand positioned quite right, the pressure on your forearm just back from the actual wrist joint can be almost painful even on the lowest setting. However, turning it off and adjusting my hand/wrist to a slightly different position solved that issue.

Also, it gives a very strong massage, even on low. I'd definitely have to work up to using higher levels!

I think this is a good product, has enough options for almost anyone to find one that is comfortable and works for them, and is a good value for the listed price. My starting-to-be-arthritic hands are very, very happy!

title: Not for me, but just my opinion.
text:
I was very intrigued when I saw the Drops of Nature products. I've tried the Lemon Balm, Stinging Nettle, and Oil of Oregano drops and what you get is exactly what is shown and described on the product pages.

Pro:

Each "dose" comes its own little tube. Easy to open the first time, and the nifty little cap can be replaced if you don't use the whole vial at once by turning the cap upside down and placing the open end of the cap on the tube. I don't know, however, how long it will stay fresh once it's been opened & re-capped if you don't use it all at once.

Reasonably priced for a 30+ day quantity of liquid herbal supplement. (30+ days because if you use less than one tube per day and finish off the tube the next day, it will, of course, last longer.)

Cons:

The only con for me, is the taste. Of the three types, the Lemon Balm drops tasted the best. Very lemony without the sourness.

Stinging Nettle drops tasted a lot like the way a fresh cut lawn smells. Not horrible tasting, but I didn't like it. (This is just me, someone else may love it!)

Oil of Oregano tasted kind of like a bland, but slightly bitter, mint. I liked this one the least of the 3 flavors.

Sooo... these are one of the "sitting on the fence" type products. The things I didn't like were personal taste, and every person's is different. I can say that I had no bad effects from any of them.

[Cross-posting to all 3 flavors pages.]

title: Okay, but there one thing I hate about it
text: I've been using this for several months now.  I bought it after my last clock went out.  My old clock was also a "wake-up to light" type of clock and I loved it, but the batteries corroded and it stopped working.  I thought that if I changed brands I could avoid this from happening again.  This clock works about the same as my old one, but there is one feature I absolutely hate.  If you wake up immediately, you either have to wait out the 15 minute light show and then wait for the alarm to start to sound before you can turn the alarm off or you have to hit a button that literally stops the alarm all together, that means that you have to remember to re-set the clock before you go to bed.  Seems easy enough and seems like you would remember to do this, but I sometimes do and sometimes don't.  My last clock had a button that, like on most alarm clocks, turns it off and then it is automatically re-set for the next morning.  Not having this option is driving me batty and I'm going online to find another clock to replace this one.  I read an earlier review that mentioned this flaw and I really wish I had taken it to heart and bought something else.  (On a side note, I love waking up to the light and don't ever want to go back to the old buzzer alarm.  Also note that this type of alarm only works if you wake up before the sun comes up or else you need to keep your bedroom very dark.)

title: Great brand for Irish moss powder
text:
I’ve found that Super Organics is a great brand to use. This Irish moss (also knows as sea moss) comes in powder form. I have previously only used it in its whole form. It’s great as a thickener to replace gelatin for a vegan option.

There are a ton of health benefits from Irish moss. I’m skeptical of some of the claims but there are lists and lists on Pinterest to sift through. Similar to coconut oil, it’s made to sound like a cure all, but you’ll have to decide for yourself.

I have added this to smoothies and muffins for tile nutritional boost. How much to add is a matter of personal taste so I would experiment with small quantities to make sure it’s a flavor you like. I don’t mind it in small doses, it gives off a little seaweed flavor that is easily masked by other ingredients.

I do think this is a good brand to use, there are some less than high quality options out there for Irish moss/ Irish moss powder and it’s hard to tell the difference sometimes but I’ve been very happy with this brand.

title: Great for tots!
text: I've gotten a couple different types of xylitol tablets online, and found one kind (Xyloburst sours) that my toddler really liked-- then I later discovered that the 2nd ingredient is citric acid which is of course bad for teeth, so that seems to contradict the purpose of taking xylitol tablets. I finally bought these since there's such a limited selection here, whereas in other countries like Japan, products with xylitol are everywhere. Since it's being shipped from Japan it took about 2 weeks to get here, but my toddler really likes these--it has a pleasant peach flavor and it doesn't dissolve right away like the other tablets I've tried. The packaging and instructions are all in Japanese, but there's a lot to like about these-- they're sugarless and made for babies and toddlers, & there's roughly 0.4 grams of xylitol in each tablet, which is pretty much the same amount in most child-friendly xylitol tablets I've seen. I give my child about 3 of these a day, since she thinks they're candy but they're actually doing her teeth good. I thought these were a bit on the pricey side, but I guess it is about the same cost for any xylitol product in the US. Until I find something better closer to me, I'll continue getting these--maybe trying out some of the other flavor options as well.

title: Great product, a little on the short side
text:
This footrest is built like other similar items on the market. It's basically half a cylinder. You can use it flat side down or curved side down which has some versatility. I prefer curved side down because I fidget. The fabric is a nice soft touch velvety velour material. The footrest is soft but just firm enough. There are 2 parts, the main footrest and a 2nd rectangle that can be used to add additional height if necessary. I do not use this as the rest by itself is fine. I have 2 of these type footrests and my cats enjoy sleeping on the extra pieces that I don't use, so, bonus! The flat bottoms of both pieces have textured silicone dots to give traction when placed on the floor and these work well.

I like this footrest but I do not like sitting with my feet together at my desk and at about 17" my feet want to naturally be just beyond the edges of this footrest. I think 24 or 30" would be a better length for me which is why I now have 2. If you tend to sit with your feet together or closer than 17" this will work fine. If you need more width I think having 2 of these side by side works fine.

title: Great idea, poorly executed
text:
I have always hated pill organizers because I don't (yet) need the daily dose reminders and the little S/M/T/W/Th/F/S things don't hold enough anyway to be worthwhile. But by the same token I hate having a bunch of bottles around. This gadget lets you put all your meds in one place (you can color code by med, e.g., Nexium in the purple compartment), and the medium size is big enough to hold a 30-day supply of everything, unless your pills are really big or you take more than seven different things. So you can stock this thing up and get rid of medicine bottle clutter, and you can just drop the whole thing in your suitcase when you travel.

The problem is that it is poorly made. The compartments screw together, but not well, so it's easy to get them out of line and then they either come apart or crack. And if you drop the thing, you're toast. At least part of it will invariably crack or break apart altogether. Still and all, it's such a good idea, I keep buying replacements on Amazon Prime. Been using them a couple of years now, and am on my fourth . . .

title: By far the easiest extender to get on and off
text:
This extender is very easy to get on and off. The round "button" type loop is easy for your fingers to figure out while behind your head. I tried other extender types- the ones with the u-shaped hook, and the ones with clasps. Both are very difficult to get on and off, since theyre not very common types of clasp. This is a much easier to use product.
When you are putting on your mask, you need 1 side detached from the extender in order to get the mask on. So you end up having to try to attach the mask strap to the clasp/hook while it's behind your head-without being able to see what you're doing. In addition, the extender isn't very long (none of the extenders I've seen on the market are more than about 5inches except for the lanyards, and those aren't extenders or earsavers, they're just straps) so because there isn't any length to it, you can't just attach the mask to the both clasps and stretch out of over your head in order to get it on -- I tried that and the mask straps just busted.

title: Great facial steamer with a fantastic look!
text:
[[VIDEOID:a6226cb3f85010349ed640dec3d79e96]] What do you get:

1- The facial steamer device.
2- A stainless-steel skin kit including 4 tools.
3- Instruction manual.
4- Oil pad and its mount for using essential oil.
5- A measuring cup.

This facial steamer works great. The first thing I noticed was the fantastic and stylish design. It comes with a fairly long power cable to reach the plug conveniently. Using the device is very easy, you fill the measuring cup that comes with the device up to 80ml and pour it into the device, add essential oil on the pad if you want and place it in front of the steamer nozzle and turn on the device by pressing the power button.

It takes seconds to start the stream of the steam and the good point was that it was a consistent stream both in the flow and its temperature. The stream is warm enough to feel good on your skin and as long as you don’t move your face very close to the nozzle, you won’t have any problems with the steam burning your skin. Adding your favorite essential oil will add a much more pleasant scent to it as well. It is mentioned in the instruction to use the device for a few times a week and no more than 10 minutes each time. Based on personal experience, the device doesn’t run more than 20 minutes with 80ml but that’s more than enough for one person.

Pros:

1- Stylish design for the device and the plastic dome.
2- Decent length power cable.
3- Consistent stream of steam and temperature.

Cons:

1- The refill capacity is only 80ml which is not very much but more than enough for one complete use.
2- The plastic dome doesn’t sit stable enough and the slightest push can move it, so you have to be careful with it.

Overall, this facial steamer is fantastic. I would highly recommend this if you are looking for something convenient for at-home usage.

title: Great plant-based protein powder with good flavor!

This one comes very close to that in terms of not having either the bad flavor or the after taste. According to the supplement facts, it has about 24 grams of protein for every 38 grams and 140 calories plus 2.5g of fat. The amount of fat and the calorie were a little bit higher than my other protein powder, but it wasn’t a really big deal. The only thing that is missing in the supplement facts, is the amount of cholesterol in each serving.

The flavor is pretty good, but it is a bit overly sweetened. The artificial sweetener also doesn’t help. It is hard to find a protein powder that doesn’t have the bad after flavor, but this one was decent. Not the best but was good enough. The serving size is one scoop and it says to mix one scoop with 6-12 oz of water, but I mixed it with 16 oz and it was still decent. One thing that this one was missing was the flavor of hazelnut. The chocolate flavor is obvious, but there is only a slight hint of hazelnut.

Pros:

Flavor, great scent, dissolvability in water and gritty taste plus the good packaging.

Cons:

The amount of sweetener is a bit high. It doesn’t taste bad, but it is slightly over sweetened, in my opinion.

Overall, I would recommend this protein powder if you are looking for a killer protein powder with good quality ingredients.
