title: Made for women by women...and it shows!
text:
So I was an avid tampon kind of gal pre-covid. I started wearing pads during covid to avoid touching my V. I started with ALWAYS brand and I don't know if it was my age or stress due to the whole pandemic thing but my period seemed heavier and came with a lot more cramps. I was on the ALWAYS panties because my period was too much, and my cramps were unbearable to the point i was missing work. I went to my GYNO and asked them to check if I was in perimenopause. Each time my GYNO said no I was fine and perhaps my period just changed on me. I accepted that fact and just figured this was my life now.
I came across a Ticktock video that talked about these pads. I honestly didn't think too much about it other than I liked the essential oils part. I read the reviews and saw a lot of reviews where women complained about the essential oils and how it felt like it burned. I was a bit concerned but I bought a pack to see for myself. You can definitely feel a cooling sensation but it didn't burn at all. the adhesive was amazing as the other brand would ALWAYS slide off (maybe that's why they named it that lol). Anyways here I am 2 years later still using Honey Pot and have no issues. Just recently I ran out of them and was in need so i looked in my cabinet and found the ALWAYS panties ...I had no choice I wore them ...and let me tell you my period was heavier (like before) and I had the most ungodly cramps. AND that's from wearing that cheap recycled trash ALWAYS brand ONE NIGHT I never went back to tampons but I'm definitely a HONEY POT customer for life (or until my body stops this period nonsense). Thank you ladies who created these for us...you definitely made an outstanding product for women!

title: I love this little guy!!
text:
At first I was skeptical about purchasing this white noise machine because of the differing reviews. I've used a regular box fan to fall asleep with my whole life. But I wanted a fuller sound and I've gone through several fans over the years that work fine for a couple months but then start making weird clunking noises. This is the first white noise machine/sound conditioner that I've ever used and I love this. When I first turned it on, I wasn't thrilled with it. It took me about a week to get used to it... it was too loud and mechanical sounding... like a jet plane engine at first. But when I got used to it and played around with twisting the collar around... well, now I always have to have it on. And now I notice I sleep a lot better and I have an easier time falling asleep almost instantly as soon as I turn it on. It definitely won't completely drown out all noise but it helps to drown out any noises my family makes downstairs, my dogs barking, cats scratching at my door and neighbors snowblowing (its winter and I live in New England!) I am completely dependent on this to fall asleep now. Its so tiny, I imagine it would be super easy to take almost anywhere should I ever need to. The only drawback is that its kinda ugly. But that's honestly the only negative thing I can say about it.

Update 1/13/19: I've been using this white noise machine basically every night for almost 6 years now and it still works amazing. This is a quality product (assuming the quality of the product hasn't changed) and this continues to be a great purchase! I can't sleep without it!

title: Not the best shower brush I've used...
text:
I purchased these thinking they'd be like similar shower/shampoo brushes I've used in the past. They're not. These have more teeth, so when brushing your hair, the teeth don't slip through your hair quite as easily. And they are not 'soft' plastic.

Also, when using in the shower, I often clip the curved 'T' handle to the shower head spout. Unfortunately, these won't stay put. They slip off after a few seconds. (The curved 'T' handle was the reason I purchased this model in the first place. Most of the other models listed on Amazon have either loop or grip handles that can't be clipped to the shower downspout.)

Lastly, I've noticed on one of these that the teeth shrank and deformed, apparently after prolonged exposure to my preferred hair care product. This was a first for me, since I've used similar brushes for years without this happening (with others, you just had to live with the teeth falling out over time). Apparently, the manufacturer felt that testing (or at least researching) the effects of different solvents commonly used in hair care products on the plastic used in these brush's manufacture was an unnecessary expense. And that's entirely okay. I'll just post a less-than-enthusiastic review and never buy these again.

You'd think that something like a shower/shampoo brush would be easy to get right. Apparently not. Not recommended.

Kind of just sneaks normal back on to you. After 20-30 minutes you just feel normal. Not “better”. Which is pretty cool. title: Amazing hair straightener!
text:
I can not say enough great stuff about the Magnefiko brush straightener! I have a horrible wave to my hair that I try to straighten to get rid of so when I saw this product I couldn't wait to give it a try. After receiving the product I read the directions and put it to the test. When I got the Brush Straightener out of the package, the first thing I noticed was the great quality of the straightener. It has a really nice weight to it, not too heavy yet not chincy either. The bristles have a reddish/ orange tip which do not get hot so you do not get burned, which is a great feature! The directions let you know what temperature you should set the brush at for different types of hair. After figuring out my hair type should be at a 195 degree temperature I turned it on by holding the power button for 3 seconds. The display screen lit up blue so I pushed the plus button to get it up to 195 degrees. This only shows degrees in Celsius not Fahrenheit. The display shows the temperature as it warms up so you know when it hits the temperature you need it at. It did not take long at all. I took sections of hair and brushed it with the brush straightener. You can go over sections more than once, I only had to do my really wavy sections twice the rest only needed one time over with the brush. It took 10 minutes for my full head to be done. This is going to save me a great deal of time getting ready in the mornings. It did take a while to cool down after I shut it off and unplugged it, but that is typical with any straightener. I am so happy I was able to try this Magnifeko Brush Straightener!
* This has to be used on dry, already brushed hair.
* I received this product at a discount in return for my honest, unbiased review

title: Not inherently bad, but I am unimpressed
text: I bought a six pack of cotton candy bombs and found this product to be fairly mediocre. The bombs came in a cute package and none were broken. However, right away I was concerned by how soft and squishy they were. A lot of them were dented and crumbly, but that is not always a bad thing (it can mean they are fresh). A note on the scent--they DEFINITELY don't smell like cotton candy. They are more of a clean linen scent, not bad, but not what is advertised. This was extremely disappointing, as I purchased them for their scent. They turn the water a really dark, muted purple color and did not stain the tub at all afterward. It is very pretty. As you can see, the bubble turnout was not great. The bomb also left lots of grainy bits on the bottom of the tub from dissolving. I would recommend a strainer while running it under the water. If you are looking for something that creates bubbles AND water color, I would ditch this and purchase a Lush Bubble Bar. I would also look elsewhere for a cotton candy scented bath bomb (I personally recommend Soapie Shoppe). Overall, the product is not bad, but it was not what I was looking for. I will not purchase again.

title: JUNP makes me Jump for joy
text:
I like that the electrolytes are keto, no sugar and flavorful. There is a touch of Himalyan Pink Salt and sometimes, I feel like it has a bit of a salty bite to it, but it isn't bad.

The ingredients are fairly simple in that there isn't a ton of extra fillers, sweetners that most people don't want (fake and artificial), and they use Stevia Leaf extract. So, if you have issues with the after flavor from stevia or don't enjoy that, beware it is in there.

I find that the mix is really tasty and doesn't leave a bad taste in my mouth. It mixed up easily into my mug of water and made it much easier to drink the amount of water that I am trying to drink. The flavor that I picked is wild berry. I love mixed berry flavors a lot and this doesn't disappoint.

I find that it helps keep me from having cramping in my legs overnight, as it contains a decent amount of your daily supply of magnesium (24% of the daily recommended intake). Some enjoy having Zinc for reducing colds, etc, this has a decent amount of zinc include.

My only thoughts or comments for improvements would be a couple of items:

The plastic spoon in the package is great, in that you can find it easily up opening the container.

Downside, once you take it out to measure your mix into your water, is was very hard to put back into the container. It could also use a little "pour notch" to make it easier to fit into the mouth of a bottle a bit easier, as that can be a bit messy trying to pour this into the bottle top.

Overall the wild berry flavor is decent. Stevia leaf extract makes me excited as it is not a fake sweetener and it is a zero sugar, great for keto electrolyte option. The Pink Himalayan salt is a very nice touch to help as well. If you are looking for a decent flavor enhancement to make drinking water easier, this is a decent electrolyte and I am looking forward trying other flavors and adding it to my drink enhancements.

title: Immediate relief for my daughter
text: These really worked for my daughter who has severe flat foot deformity.  Her ankles end up hanging out in thin air supporting her whole weight when her arches collapse.  Any amount of continuous walking causes her pain and at one point, stress fractures.  She had to quit her waitress position for that reason.  She already has special inserts in her shoes, but it wasn’t enough.  Her current job started to be more on her feet, and it’s been causing her a lot of pain, meaning fracture wasn’t far off.  I got her these because they were not expensive and it couldn’t hurt to try.  I bought the High Arches option.  They helped tremendously and once she healed, the pain was gone.  She did find that they flattened over a shift. Washing fixed them, but she needs them daily, so I bought her more.  We ended up actually trying 2 on one foot, which worked even better, so I cut the pad part out of one pair and sewed  them to the other.  Over the course of a busy day they flatten a little, but are still enough to keep her from having pain.

title: Fantastic Supplement For Stress-Caused Fatigue And Labido Loss
text:
Due to a lot of stress in my life lately I've been struggling with a lack of energy and a severe decrease in my libido. Anyone who's struggled with these things knows that they can make a huge impact on your relationship. I discussed this with an herbal doctor I know and they recommended I look into trying a Yohimbine HCI supplement. I'm very accustomed to trying different herbal supplements, so I felt comfortable testing this one out. I typically order from BRI for my supplements, but a friend told me to try this one from Advanced Nutrition Labs- and so I did.

I have been taking this supplement for about a month and I am SO impressed with it thus far. It's definitely given me a much needed boost in energy and libido. I take the supplement as directed. For the first couple days I didn't see a significant change and I thought that perhaps this supplement wasn't what I was looking for. But my herbal nutritionist said that it often takes a while for herbs to take their full affect and that I should continue trying it. So I did, and within a week I definitely saw a lift in my mood and energy- as well as my sex drive.

Prior to taking this supplement I didn't even want to get out of bed. I was just stressed and anxious- which really affected m sleep. I had no energy at all throughout the day. Now, because I have more energy- I get much more done and then wear myself out through all of my activities, which allows me to sleep better at night. It's very similar to caffeine from coffee or tea. It allows me to wake-up and get going during the day, but I don't NEED coffee in order to do so. With this supplement I wake up and I feel awake. I don't need to rely on other energy sources to get me going, which is very nice.

The hike in my libido is the most life-changing part of this supplement though. The lack of energy was draining, but the fact that I didn't want to have sex made me feel guilty and upset with myself. Now, I feel back to my same ole' self. Nothing has changed about my 'stressers'. I still have the same busy things going on in my life; I just feel more capable of handling them because I have more energy. And my libido is back on track which eliminates a lot of the issues that were going on in the relationship. This supplement definitely worked for the things I needed it for, and I'm glad I tried it. I am now weaning myself off and doing well, but I'd recommend it to anyone who needs a short term energy or libido boost that works- naturally.

title: Great Curler For Inexperienced Make-Up Artists
text:
I'm not a super cosmetic pro, I love wearing make-up- but I'm terrible at putting make-up on. And when it comes to eye lash curlers, I'm fearful and extremely inexperienced. But I've had a lot of friends who use curlers regularly, and I guess I thought it was only fair I give up my fear of stabbing myself in the eye and try to use these darn things.

This eye lash curler was surprisingly simple and effective. It has small rubber handles, which allow for easy and accurate use of the curler. The rubber handles allow for a good grip, so even if you've just finished applying lotions or foundations- these won't slip out of your hand. Always a plus! On the negative side, I fear they may attract pet hair and dust. They haven't yet, but we shall see here in a few weeks if that becomes an issue (if it does I will update the review).

The rest of the curler is a very light-weight metal, with silicone grips on the curler itself. The curler fit my lashes really conveniently. The curve allowed me to get all corners of my eye covered in one grip, which allowed for easy, convenient curling. It does come with an additional refill silicone pads. I haven't used curlers very often, so I have no idea how many additional pads I would need, or how often they should be changed. But nonetheless, it's always nice to have extras!

The last and only other curler I owned was not half as effective or comfortable to use as this curler. My last curler looked VERY similar, but couldn't reach all of my lashes. This one, on the other hand, covers my entire eye and makes for a quick beautifying touch-up in one swift curl of the lashes.

So needless to say for the small amount of money this curler cost, it was a 'steal' of an investment. My lashes do look genuinely fuller and longer after using this, and very girl deserves to feel pretty. I'd easily recommend this to any beginner-curler, teens who like experimenting with new make-up tools, and anyone who needs a convenient eye lash curler that does it's job well.

title: Love--Will Buy Again
text:
Over the last three months I have steadily incorporated products so that I can follow the Korean skincare regiment [layering about 10 products. I am very, very picky with cleansers as they tend to dry my skin out no matter how moisturizing they claim to be. I have olive skin, it is dry and needs a lot of hydration. I am blessed by the gods and have no acne issues. My problem is redness and uneven/rough/dull skin. And dark circles.

That said, I love, love this product. A little goes a long way. It has the consistency of shaving cream. It tingles a little when you put on and you can kind of feel it doing it's job. It smells fine, and the fragrance is not overwhelming. I very, very gently rubbed in light circles. I don't think you should be really rubbing any product into your face, hence I try to rub as little as possible [and I think there is a lot of info to support this out there]. I use it after using an oil cleanser [to remove make up and impurities--this i just pat on and then rinse off it is magical]. I think this stuff brightens my face a little, but then I think almost all Korean skincare products do. I only use this product in the evening. Cleansing oil I use in the morning and evening. My skin looks polished and smooth and my pores look smaller [i think, but my pores are only really noticecable on my nose]. The product says it can be used as a mask if you leave on for 2 minutes. I did not do that.

When I finished [and I use room temperature/lukewarm water] I rinsed and then splashed some cold water on to close my pores. Then I use a toner [a moisturizing one, regular toners burn my skin]. When I am done I use a serum, then an eye cream. Once a week I use a mask after the eye cream [I recommend my beauty diary]. But if no mask then I use an emulsion, then a moisturizing cream [I still use these two even if I use a mask]. Twice a week I finish with a sleeping pack before bed.
I am working in an exfoliator. My skin looks amazing and it is very, very bight and smooth and pretty. No, it isn't bleached but I sincerely feel for the first time ever feel like I got that celebrity skin going on. I am really happy. Of course keep in mind that I also use like 10 other proucts and that whatever works for me or other reviewers may not work for you--skin, I have learned, is not to be generalized or taken lightly. See what works for you. Sometimes you waste money but it is all part of the pursuit of finding what works for you. But I highly recommend this.

Oh, and in the mornings when I am done with everything I put on a sunblock then cc cream. Except for the Etude house cleanser, every product I use is from Laneige. The masks are my beauty diary and the cleanser is rice water oil cleanser. The exfoliator, when I get it, is skinfood sugar scrub. I do NOT use the mircacle toner because I am happy with my laneige toner. Maybe when that runs out I will give the other toner a try but that is unlikely.

I broke it all down because I loved the product, think it did it's job, but I also use like 10 other products so it is difficult to say how well it works alone. I use very little make up [natural look]. I think that if you purchase, look at it as a good investment. Clothing goes out of style but your skin will be with you forever!

title: Consider what you are buying....
text:
I hesitated when purchasing this because so many of the reviews were complaints. I gave it a shot anyway and have been pleasantly surprised. Just a few helpful things to consider when buying this:

1. It's plastic, so for those who complained about an odor...of course, it's going to smell like plastic. I would hope everyone would know to wash it off in the tub before the first use. After that, I didn't notice any odor.
2. This is essentially a reverse vacuum motor - it is going to make noise, a fair bit of noise so if you're looking for quiet - don't buy this.
3. Wherever your body puts pressure on the mat, the bubbles are going to stop or not be so numerous because your weight won't allow the mat to fill with air.
I saw complaints that the air coming through the mat was cold and cooled off the water. I have not had that issue at all but I tend to run the water as hot as possible to begin with.

All things considered, it's a good product. I have found that a little creative thinking makes it work much better. I place the mat sort of diagonally in my tub. This way it sits directly under my legs but off to the side of the center of my body which allows a lot more bubbles. If you really want a jacuzzi feel - buy two, fill the tub all the way and place the mats on the sides of the tub. ;)

title: Useless unless modified
text:
My mother is using a Drive brand bedside commode. There are a few problems that I have had to work around to make sure this product doesn't just end up in landfill two days after its arrival in the mail.

First off, the center of the clip cracked when I clipped it onto the bar of the commode. I didn't apply any extra pressure, it's simply designed poorly. The clip itself is still intact and holds onto the bar no problem. The fact that upon it's first use it broke in some way is pretty disappointing though.

Another annoyance with the design is that it pivots around the bar of the commode a lot or simply falls off. I fixed this by wrapping a strong rubber band around it so that it stays more or less in place without falling with use. If it had a metal clip that wraps around the bar with rubber grips this would solve the problem. Since it is made of plastic it is useless without the rubber band around it.

The largest annoyance is that there is no end that prevents the toilet paper roll from slipping off with use. Whenever my mother pulled toilet paper while using the restroom the whole roll would fall off but the toilet paper holder (with the a more than a little help from the rubber band) stays on. To fix this I repurposed a platic lid from a small oatmeal box and cut a tight-fitting hole just big enough to fit over the end.

I'll update this review with pictures later.

Had I not been so determined to not let my money go to waste, this product would be in the trash right now and it would be receiving a one star review. Since I somehow made it work I'm giving it two stars.

If you buy this product be prepared to be extremely disappointed with how useless it will turn out to be... unless you make these modications.

text:
This is a really nice liver cleanse. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I am occasionally lucky enough to receive a product for free or at a discounted price in exchange for my honest review of that product. I am never paid to post a review on Amazon. I use Amazon review ratings to make my own purchases too so rest assured all my opinions are 100% my own and truthful.

My star rating system is as follows:
Five Stars: I loved this product and it worked out just the way I hoped it would. The product is attractive, well-packaged, and completes all of its described functions. This is a good quality product that is worth the cost.
Four Stars: I liked this product. It does what it is supposed to. The product is either slightly less quality than I would have hoped but works well for me, or it is good quality but just doesn't serve my functions ideally. This is still a good product, but I recommend you make sure it is exactly what you want before purchasing (size-wise, color, material, etc.)
Three Stars: This product is OK. It may be deficient in quality, size, or it may be inappropriately suited to my needs but still fully functional. A three star rating means it didn't live up to my expectations but I am still able to use it.
Two Stars: This is a fine product but it did not suit my needs. I give a product a two star rating when I can see its usefulness, but I simply cannot incorporate it into my life. This could be a drastically different size, color, or material, or just a poor quality item. Two star rating could also mean I'm able to use it, but I don't like it due to quality, aesthetics, or just my own tastes.
One Star: I really don't like this product and don't recommend it to anyone. This product is poor quality or completely different than what was described on the website.

If any of my review has been helpful to you, please help me out by clicking “I found this helpful” below my review. Happy shopping!

title: Great balance restorer
text:
At 45 these are my first pair of forearm crutches. I like them a lot at day 2 and I hope they last as they are very quiet but I'm not a power user yet! I put the large black zip ties on the cuffs so that my hand can still easily go in the opening but they won't fall off my arms when I'm not walking and let go of the grips (melt the ends of the zip ties after cutting so they aren't sharp). For the last 30 years I've had trouble walking smoothly that's gotten worse with age. My neurologist calls it Spinocerebellar Ataxia. In the last 7 years or so I've started having balance problems as well and my knees have gotten wobbly. All that results many times in my falling and when out on concrete this is hazardous. I watched YouTube videos on how to get these properly fitted and the basics of using these to walk and that was all easy. I'm pleased to see that my balance and wobbly knees seems to be better with these and walking doesn't seem to be such a task anymore.

Edit

After 2 days I was finding that the zip ties I added to the cuffs were cutting my arms even with the cut ends melted smooth, so I wrapped the ties in soft cloth and duck tape and now real comfortable.

Edit 2:

Found out that if u squeeze the cuffs they will tighten and keep the adjustment. Use a rubber band (I used black cloth covered hair elastic ponytail band) if u want to close the cuff.

The only con I've found about these crutches is possibly the crutch tip, though it might be crutches in general as I've only been using crutches for 2 weeks. These crutches tend to deliver a lot of shock to the upper back after 10 minutes of just walking with them. Compared to other crutch tips it is smaller but universal. I easily switched the tip for heftier Guardian Signature tips. But now the crutches aren't so quiet.

title: Nice price.  Nice Set.  No use!
text:
[[VIDEOID:8ee286ac50c67ae00b30690bf2bbe82c]] My 2-year-old Sonicare toothbrush is making some odd noises after being accidentally dropped. I’ve used electric toothbrushes for over 20 years. So, when I saw this toothbrush set in my Amazon Vine listing, I thought I’d try it as a potential replacement. As an Amazon Vine reviewer, I am offered new-to-market products, if I want them, at no cost to me, in exchange for an honest, objective, and comprehensive review.
At $25 for two electric toothbrushes and 10 brush heads, this seems to be a superb value. Too good to be true? – ABSOLUTELY! You really do get what you pay for.
.
DESIGN:
.
The brush heads are attached via a bayonet fitting to the top of the toothbrush. The fit works OK. The bristles are very soft. The product description does state soft. There’s no color indicator for when to replace the heads. The manual states to do it when the bristles are worn and bent over.
.
The toothbrush itself is fairly light but will stand up on its end without issue. Charging, recommended every 10-14 days, is achieved by removing a bayonet cap at the bottom and plugging in the proprietary USB-C charging cable (no charging brick included). The LED will glow red. However, it does not seem to turn off when a full charge is achieved. Plugged in – LED always glows red.
There is a selector button. Press once to turn ON. Long press to turn OFF. Once ON, a button press will cycle through the various vibration modes. If you long press to turn the unit OFF, when restarting, the toothbrush does remember the last mode setting. I found it all too easy though to change the mode when turning the unit OFF, by forgetting to long press!
The vibration modes really don’t change much other than a little maximum intensity variation and a slight change in the variable vibration pattern. There is a noticeable long pause at the 30 second intervals. You briefly think the toothbrush has turned off. To be honest, I’ve never used the different modes on my other electric toothbrushes. They are more of a gimmick than a useful function IMHO.
.
PERFORMANCE:
.
I had high hopes but was sorely disappointed. Yes, the toothbrush vibrates, but the level is so low, you have to use it like a manual toothbrush to get any cleaning effect. I just felt like I was back to using a manual toothbrush that shook in my hand.
I feel more vibration in my hand than on my teeth! The very soft bristles absorb any movement over their length and the ends essentially don’t move against the tooth surface.
I created the attached video to try and illustrate the difference between the Sonicare and the Eoryeo. You can easily see how the level of vibration is so much less on the Eoryeo. I chose the POLISH mode as that was the strongest.
.
CONCLUSION:
.
Nice price. Comprehensive set. No use.
.
Don’t waste your money! You aren’t getting the real benefit of an electric toothbrush, just a shaking manual toothbrush. I suppose if you have really sensitive gums and need a soft bristled brush and gentle vibrations, maybe this would work for you, but, in that case, I’d just buy a soft-bristled, manual toothbrush and talk with my dentist!
My dentist advises that you should not press an electric toothbrush hard against your teeth with a hand-hold grip but hold it at the end, or between two fingers, and let the brush head do the work. There’s no way, the Eoryeo Electric Toothbrush will work like that.
.
This set is unfortunately going in the trash at my house and I’ll be off to buy another Sonicare!

title: Not worth it - and can stain white fiberglass!
text:

The purple tablet was completely dissolved after 3 days sitting on the rear of the tub. However, I saw there was a faint purple stain on the white fiberglass. Faint in that no-one else would notice it, but I knew where the tablet had sat and dripped, and could see the purple coloring. It didn't wipe off and neither did a spray and soak with bleach cleaner remove it! Hopefully it'll fade, or maybe pure bleach will work if not. The unused ones are in the trash!
.
ORIGINAL REVIEW:
.
I recently reviewed some other shower steamers and they weren’t very good. I saw these in my Vine Listing and thought I’d try them and see if they were any better.
As an Amazon Vine reviewer, I am offered new-to-market products, if I want them, at no cost to me, in exchange for an honest, objective, and comprehensive review.
I get a laugh out of the spelling on the front; these are apparently Showen Steamers! 😊 At least the rear spelling is correct!
Interestingly, the package also includes a little purple nylon mesh bag and adhesive hook, presumably to hang a steamer block in. There is also a little pick, which I have no idea what it is for.
However, after some thought, I think it might be to open the plastic wrap! Each block is foil-wrapped, but unlike the previous steamers, these are also wrapped in plastic. That is very tough to remove without scissors, or a pick! One set of blocks is green and the other is purple. This is reflected in the actual crystal block as well as the foil. I assume the purple is the Lavender.
I say ‘assume’ because the aroma is nothing like Lavender or Eucalyptus & Menthol. It is certainly less “chemical” smelling than the previous set I reviewed, and perhaps less pungent in use, but I’ve no idea what the smell actually is. There’s no comparison with the essential oils I have of these very scents.
As with any of these steamers, you have to place them away from the direct shower spray. They will last less than one shower if you do. I place one so that it is occasionally hit with water, to release the aroma. That way it can last maybe 4 showers.
As mentioned, the aroma is not very strong and if hit with hot water, the block will release a burst of scent, which quickly dissipates and some of the coloring will run in the shower. The scent can be overwhelmed easily by any scented bodywash or shampoo. I certainly didn’t notice any residual aroma the next day, with the block having sat in the shower overnight. I think the product would be better if it were a small tablet for a single use directly in the shower stream and the price were less than 50c each.
.
While this set is less offensive and strongly smelling than the last, I still would not spend my own money of these. At $2.67 each, these are not good value and I can’t recommend them

title: Useful for hobbyists, but not for ears!
text:
The idea sounds good but stick to Mack's earplugs!
I use flanged earplugs all the time when working with my power tools / guns and when this new-to-market product appeared in my Amazon Vine Reviewer list, I was able to order it at no cost to me in exchange for an honest and detailed review. It seemed like I could get that professional, customized earplug fit at a really low price. Nice!
Since everyone's ears are different, the concept of a moldable silicone plug seems ideal. The advertised noise reduction is reasonable at 20dB (ANSI), though not the best you can get compared with dedicated plugs, like the flanged Mack's at 26dB (noting that +3dB represents a doubling of noise, or in this case reduction).
The material is like putty. You can roll it in your hands to warm it up and shape it. Pull it and it tears apart.
You can remold it into one again with some more finger/hand work.
I followed the instructions and simply pressed a ball of the putty into my ear over the ear canal opening. There was some noise reduction, but I needed to work it a little more. While it molded to my ear, it didn't feel well-secured. I did some head shaking, jaw clenching and bending down and I felt it come away slightly at the rear. I decided to reduce the size of the ball and took the putty out, pulled a piece off, re-rolled it and pressed it back into place. It seemed to feel a little better. I tried working outside with the earplugs in place and it didn't take long for the heat and sweat to loosen the grip. I seemed to be constantly pressing the material back in place, which isn't practical with fingers covered in soil or grease or with gloves. With gloves, I found deposits of the putty were left on the glove fabric. I wouldn't be keen on using a plug more than once as it'll contain all sorts of junk I wouldn't want in my ears.
I'll be sticking with my better performing and retained flanged ear plugs, which I can rinse off, thank you very much!
I can see someone using these indoors, like the photos in the description shows; for sleeping (though they might leave stuff on your pillows!) or ignoring the noisy kids! Not so sure about swimming, but maybe? These are not for use outside IMHO or where you need positive retention. As a DIY'er, I actually see some other uses, like temporary hole plugging or cleaning debris off things as these are akin to an automotive clay bar! I wouldn't recommend them to anyone though, based on my experience, but you can try them for yourself, since they are actually only $7 for, I think, 16 plugs.

title: Good value
text:
UPDATE:
I found these made my shoes MUCH too tight as the insoles that came in the shoes couldn't be removed. I have put them in my rubber boots, having been able to remove those insoles, which was about the same thickness as these at the front end, and they are really comfortable. I think I'll be using the half insoles in future as they seem to suit my shoes better.
ORIGINAL REVIEW:
I use orthotic insoles in all my shoes, even my slippers, to alleviate some of the pain of arthritis in my foot joints. I have several half-insole Rooruns and have worn out several Walk-fits. So, when I saw these in my "Recommended for you" list as an Amazon Vine Reviewer, I thought they are worth trying. As a Vine Reviewer, I was able to order these at no cost to me, in exchange for an objective and detailed review.
Here it is...
The construction is typical of Rooruns, with various layers of material to provide comfort and support. I do wish they were stiffer or were flat on the bottom, as they tend to bend under foot, losing some of the free shape, especially if the shoe has no arch support profile. That said, they do provide noticeable support in flat shoes. Also, the Rooruns I have do not lose their shape with repeated use and are very durable. The half-insole one in the photo has been in my shoes for some time now, with little sign of wear. My slippers' insoles have the most wear and that's a fading of the fabric color, the upper fabric layer has worn down under the heel (but not peeled, just worn) and the heel cushion/pad is starting to come loose. However, the slippers have the most hours on them, several hours a day over several months with the typical lack of support to stop the foot sliding around. I expect these full insoles to perform just as well. That is one key feature which draws me to Roorun insoles - durability.
The arch profile is definitely higher than my other Rooruns and I have high arches, so that felt good under my feet.
I ordered the XL for my size 13 feet. On the floor, the insoles seemed much longer than my feet and I was thinking I would need to cut the front ends down. There are molded-in lines underneath to suggest where and how to cut. However, when I tried to put them in my loafers, I found that forcing them over the top of the heel, down into the actually-longer sole area of the shoe, they fit my size 13 shoes perfectly. They do reduce volume inside the shoe, especially in the heel area. I measured them at approx. 3/8" thick at the heel, but that's the same as my half-insoles. The extra material under the toes, which I'm not used to, did make my shoes feel a little tighter at the front and top.
Interestingly, the round heel cushion/pad under the insole has a plastic film over it. Remove the film and the pad is very sticky. Presumably to retain its position in the shoe. Now why would you need that on the full insole when it's trapped front and rear in position, yet the half-insoles do not have it, and actually would stay put better with it?!
The half-insoles often slip forward when I put shoes or boots on.
ROORUN: PLEASE NOTE: I wish that sticky pad feature was on the half-insoles!
The price is competitive and only $6 or so more than the half insoles. I still think I prefer the half insoles, but the higher arch might be better for me. We will see.
I haven't had a chance to wear these for an extended time. I will get that chance this coming weekend on a trip. I'll update the review after I get more miles with these insoles.
I hope my review has been helpful.

title: Useful little kit
text:
My glasses had hard nose pieces with slip-over silicone pads. When cleaning them, one of the pads slipped off unnoticed and got lost. The hard pieces on their own were very uncomfortable. Unfortunately, the store is shut due to Covid-19 for a repair, so I resorted to a low cost DIY solution.
This kit seemed to fit the bill. Unlike other brands, the soft pads are one-piece moldings and not held onto hard pivots with glue, which fails after time. This does mean they are very mounted very flexibly and initially, I thought I'd not installed them correctly as they seemed to pivot around too much. However, that's just the flexing of the little silicone block. Once on the face, they don't move and are very comfortable. Not sure how durable these will be, but the kit does have plenty of replacements.
I reused the original screws. They were fiddly to get out as the short, supplied screwdriver was not long enough to use with the side arms folded and with the side arms open, they got in the way of my hand trying to manipulate the screw. I did manage in the end. Good job I have a pair of reading glasses to see those tiny, tiny screws! The tweezers were very handy to reinsert and push the screw in through the pad enough to start the threads.
I use keepers already. They are short, but they go hard over time and become uncomfortable. This kit has some nice soft and long blue silicone ones. I used those and my glasses are held nice and tight in the right place and I can't feel them.

title: Close to Perfect: Solid A-
text:
Bottom Line on Top: Hands down the best out there

I don't give five star reviews for anything short of perfection and, to be honest, this is close. Its simple, secure, well-made and well-sized. In fact, it's a bit like Hermione's purse from Harry Potter: Dramatically bigger inside than it looks outside. What fits in this thing? Everything. Although this feels smaller than most of the other 28-slot boxes, it holds dramatically more.

This box is easy to use for those with serious arthritis, with no "pop" lids or fussy small parts. The individual days come all the way out, and the lids slide smoothly. The labelling is obvious and intuitive. The construction is sturdy. The whole thing, unlike virtually any competitor, is perfect for travelling as the pills simply have no escape -- no more shuffling through the bottom of the bag for the stray pills. Lastly, there is nothing to break here. No little "keep it closed" tabs to snap off, no hinges to crack, no inserts to warps.

So how is this not a candidate for perfection? Several of the big benefits have minor drawbacks. Most importantly, none of the pieces are attached. Whilst this makes filling and using the box easier than any other similar product, it also makes it easier to mislay "today's" container between morning and night, or to lose the clear cover if you slide it all the way off.

Overall (checking Amazon history now), we've tried fourteen different pill boxes over the years. No other comes close to the mix of great features without major drawbacks. I honestly do not think there is a better option on the market.

title: Too Expensive for the Quality
text:
We spent a long time looking at these dolls on Amazon before finally deciding on this one. The major selling point to us was the size. It can be difficult to find bigger dolls like this that are just the torso on Amazon. But, the price tag we paid does not match our expectations.

- Skin discoloration. She has weird spots where the color didn't seem to blend well during the molding process. Not a big deal. Just, again, for the price tag you'd expect matching skin tone. The lower regions are also way darker than they are in the pictures. We were trying to avoid the oddly red/dark nether regions that most dolls seem to have but this one came with them overly colored anyways.
- It has lines all over it. Almost like hair fell into the mold and now is permanently part of the doll. You don't want to pay so much for such poor quality even if it doesn't change the use.
- One leg is longer than the other by like an inch.
- The "skin" part bundled up on her backside and looks like weird skin flaps.
- She came sticky and covered in old TPE dust or something. It got everywhere during the unpackaging. Several spots are much more sticky than the others and it makes me worry about the long term durability of the doll.
- The pictures are "cleverly" taken to make her seem more proportional than she is. Her butt is pretty flat. And the hole isn't accurate at all. The detailing on her in general isn't accurate to a real woman.
- Her breasts angle outward so much that not even a bra or holding them cannot make them look "straight".
- She does not come with clothes or a size chart for buying any. She does come with cheap underwear that doesn't fit her. None of the ones in the pics.

So! She's not bad to the point where it feels like a scam or anything. But, she isn't quality and certainly not relative to the price tag. If you were looking for a doll that was different than many others on Amazon for the reasons I listed (quality / coloration / accuracy), then I wouldn't suggest this doll. If you just want a taller one than you can normally find that is just a torso, then this one is fine.

title: Works Wonderfully
text:
I use this streamer with my PC, and it is terrific. I can listen to music, watch videos, and even play video games without disturbing those around me. The fact that the device makes this possible through my hearing aids is exceptional. I can pause or mute the computer sound and hear conversations around me. I am fully satisfied with the device, functionally.

However, it is insanely expensive since it's basically a Bluetooth audio interface. Hence, one star off. It is a specialty market, so you have to accept the gouging or do without. Perhaps someday, hearing aids will come with more versatile and inexpensive Bluetooth connectivity options.

Until then, I am getting reasonable value at a very premium price. If you have the money to spare, this streamer is worth it.

FYI, if you have hearing aids with tubes and little silicon tips, the sound fidelity will not be as good. Those "open" tip designs are great for hearing but don't provide as much sound fidelity for streaming as more "full shell"-like earpieces. You will get better sound with more "closed" tip earpieces, but they still will not have the dynamic range and deep bass that typical earbuds can provide. At best, the experience is more of a functional one rather than something for an audiophile.

title: Fantastic option for care lovers
text:
Off the top, I'll admit to having a problem with how much I love my car. With that said, this stuff is fantastic. I've used Adams, Chemical Guys, and other car pro washes in the past and they all generally pretty good. But the Hydro2 is like playing a video game on cheat mode. After a wash the car is glossy and looks amazing, but even better the car sheds water and dirt like it was professionally ceramic coated (I've done that in the past too).

Pros: it's obscenely easy to use. Add the soap to the foam cannon and apply as directed. Then rinse with water and then dry. I've found that for best results apply with the foam cannon then use a microfiber glove to wash (keep a clean bucket for this) and then dry. It's great at removing dirt and making the car as hydrophobic as possible. Even after a couple of weeks you can remove minor dirty spots with a top coat and it's still going to look great.

Cons: it doesn't smell great. I think it's fairly expensive compared to other premium detergents, and if you don't rinse and dry quickly you can end up with water spots (I'm in Texas, so the heat really ups the urgency)

Note that I can't vouch for the "2 month" claim as I rarely go longer than 2 weeks without waking my car. I do alternate this with another high gloss soap, so I know it lasts a month on a daily driver.

title: ... to expect from this product - the description is poor so I trusted my instincts that it would do ...
text:
I wasn't sure what to expect from this product - the description is poor so I trusted my instincts that it would do what I needed, and it does. The top edge of the open area in the middle is placed along the upper lash line to protect the lid from mascara smears and smudges and it works very well. I like to get my mascara deep into the root area to make the lashes look thicker, and this makes that easy. The top edge of the opening area goes under the lower lash line to protect the under eye area from mascara smudges and also works well. The two sides of the handle have serrations of differing sizes to comb lashes and brows - I might do a quick brow comb with it, but the teeth are too wide for me to want to use it to comb lashes.

I gave it four stars instead of five for several reasons. First, I waste a fair amount of mascara onto the applicator as I apply it to the upper lashes (I don't use mascara on my lower lashes so I can't speak to that); the plastic is easily cleaned however. Second, it takes practice to determine how best to hold it against the lid, as any pressure causes my eye to unfocus - kind of disconcerting in mid application. Third, it takes practice to figure out the blinking issue - I have worn makeup for decades and am practiced in holding my eyes open and unblinking, but there's something about having this pressed there that makes me want to blink and it is awkward, since the applicator is holding my lid firmly in place. title: Comfortable, Durable, and Affordable
text: I ordered this wrap to give my ankle support and limit movement while my Achilles’ tendon injury heals. It arrived quickly, and after reading through the instructions (with very clear, easy to understand images) it was fairly easy to put this on! I only wish it was a little more rigid to prevent me from bending, but I would need a boned brace for that, and they’re incredibly expensive (and uncomfortable.) For the price, I’m really satisfied overall! I’ve been wearing this on and off for around a week now, alternating it with my other ankle wrap to wash them, and it has really helped my tendon rest. It’s more comfortable than most braces I’ve tried, and has non-slip strips on the inside which keep it from sliding out of place. I’m surprised that they don’t both me, because I have really sensitive skin, but I don’t even notice they’re there. They just do exactly what they should. This wrap is much more comfortable to sleep in than my other one, and thanks to the length of it, I’ve never made it too tight by accident like I have with others. Additionally, the Velcro closure is really strong and reliable! It holds it firmly where I put it without coming off or making the wrap fuzzy. If you’re looking for an affordable ankle wrap to help you heal from a minor injury, I recommend giving this a try.

title: Not the makeup remover I expected but great on my sunburn!
text:
This product was not what I was expecting it to be but worked out well. If you are looking for a sponge or product to remove your makeup with just water, this is NOT it. If you are looking for something gentle to use on your skin that leaves it feeling FRESH then this might be what you are looking for. I attempted removing my make up with just the sponge and water and it left a goopy mess. HOWEVER I LOVE this for washing my clean face in the mornings before I apply makeup or for washing my makeup free face after a day of chores. It is very gentle but still enough to remove the dirt from the day or any small spots of dry skin. For my heavier exfoliation I still reach for my Clarisonic, but this sponge and the lack of harsh cleansers gives my face a nice break and has helped with the healing of bad breakouts.

The thing I liked most about this sponge however was how gentle it was on my SUNBURN and the peeling that had started. It got rid of the peeling spots but did so in such a gentle manner that it stopped the peeling from getting worse.

My skin feels clean, smooth and healthy after using it this sponge. It does work well with a mild cleanser if you prefer.

It increases in size quite a bit once it is wet all the way through. About six inches in length 3 inches width and a half inch thick when fully dampened. It feels a bit slimy or slick in your hand but is worth it for how gentle it is. It seems starchy. It is very soft and squishy when wet not at all hard or stiff (although when it arrives new and dry it will be). I did not experience any weird smell that I have seen in the other reviews. I am grateful the opportunity came up for me to try this product at a discounted price in return for my honest review.

PROS - Gentle on your skin even sunburns, skin feels good after use, helps to diminish breakouts, can be used with or without cleanser, string to store it hanging so it does not soak up germs

CONS - Does not remove makeup with just water

title: Good for Inflammation of Joints & Tendons-Worked for Me!
text:
On shopping for a vitamin supplement I usually go with a one-a-day multi-vit along with various stand alones like Vit D. & maybe some supplemental minerals. Occasionally a supplement will come along that intrigues me enough to try. I saw the HSN-Plus from Vizeri Nutrition on Amazon & because it was for hair, skin & nails with the added benefits of cardiovascular health, circulatory health, cognitive & vision support, along with joint & tendon support I decided I should give it a try.
The thing about vitamins is they are largely subjective. You think you feel better so you chalk it up to the supplement. Is it psychological or physical? It’s hard to be sure but with HSN-Plus I can say definitely say I noticed the improvement after just one day without even thinking about it being the supplement being the cause. It wasn’t until the end of the second day I attributed the relief & better physical recovery to the HSN-Plus.
Here’s the backstory... Bear with me, it may seem unrelated at first but it connects.
I have this amazing black labrador. She is blind & her back legs don’t work very well from a hereditary condition. She doesn’t seem to be in pain & she loves to play by wrestling & throwing a squeak ball for me to bring back for her. (She tosses it with her mouth.) Wherever I work on the property she finds me by hearing & smell & by moving like a seal she quickly finds me & hangs out while I work, be it weeding, mowing or whatever. Because she travels quite a distance over a ½ acre fenced yard I don’t want her to overdo so when were done working I put a tarp down with a cushion on it & say “Hop on.” She does and I pull her across the property, back to her blankets on the back porch.
We’ve been doing this for the past three years but for the last year my right knee is giving me grief, (my dog weighs 79 pounds so it’s no big surprise.) But in the evening it stiffens up & I have trouble walking until it limbers up. Plus there is a sharp pain when I pivot.
So two days ago I noticed in the evening my knee wasn’t stiff, it wasn’t sore & there wasn’t any pain when I pivoted. I didn’t give it much thought but the next night after working out back & bringing the dog up I didn’t have any knee problems either.
I ran it through my mind what was different & realized I had started taking HSN-Plus two days ago. I looked at the label very close & saw it contains MSM which I remember from days gone by as good for inflammation. I Googled it & sure enough it does have pain relieving benefits. So when the HSN-Plus label says it supports Joint & Tendon Health, it really does! The combination of supplements in HSN-Plus is apparently just what I need.
I can honestly say I am still pain free in my knee & this supplement is the only thing different about my regiment. So kudos to HSN-Plus! My dog thanks you and I thank you.

title: AccuMed VERSUS $325 Fertility Monitor
text:
My husband and I have been trying to get pregnant for 2 years now. I've tried every ovulation test imaginable, in addition to taking my basil body temperature every morning. So I took the AccuMed Test strips against the results from the most expensive monitor I have. The Clear Blue Ovulation Monitor ($200 plus $35 for the Clear Blue test sticks). - See pictures for the results.

Pros: First is the price, with this you get 40 ovulation test strips, and 10 pregnancy strips. When taking the test, you dip the strips in room temperature urine for 3 seconds. The results are read after only 5 minutes. The control line is nice and dark, which is much better than the drugstore brands I've tried in the past. Most importantly, this test had the same results & accurately caught my LH surge, which coincides with the results from my $235 fertility monitor. I dipped a new strip in urine again the following day & it accurately depicted that I had ovulated, which matches my temperature readings.

Cons: I would have liked the strips to come in some sort of box or bag. Instead they are rubber banded together. This is just my personal preference of trying to be organized. I have a lot of different ovulation & pregnancy tests/test sticks from ones I've tried over the last two years.

Reviews impact my buying decision when purchasing just about anything. I received this product at a discounted price however I take my reviews very seriously. I've always appreciated the help I receive from other reviewers & I hope I can return the favor.

title: Love it so far - used it less than 1 hour and love it.
text:
I just got my Verilux happy lite today - Bought mine online direct from the Verilux company (big sale/better deal) (Sorry Amazon).

Anyway - I always wanted to try one of these - but they were always in the $200.00 and up range - too pricey for a little sunshine. Anyway - each winter I seem to grow slower, and more lethargic, more passe', lower and lower energy. So I got to looking at these again and bought it when I found the deal.

Anyway - as a first time user of happy lite/SAD/sunshine lights - here's my take. In the evenings I get very, very sluggish and dragging around. I took it out of the box, assembled it, and tried placement where I wanted over my computer. Although it was 9:30, I flipped the switch on and thought I would try it for 15 minutes - but no more. (Take 1 hour to get 10,000 LUX and in 30 minutes you get 5,000 LUX). Anyway, the little 15 minutes I used it I definitely could tell a pick me up. I felt a little more energy and clearheadedness. Really I did. I popped up and cleaned up a little in the kitchen and set myself of to knock out some paperwork. After a while I started to settled back in to a late evening sleepy mode. So - I say it works based on the brief exposure I had tonight. I can't wait until tommorrow morning to try it out for the full time. I look forward to having 'full energy' again during the remains of these somber wintry months, so I can get things done and not be walking around like a zombie.

RE: the cheapness of the product stated in earlier comments. Not a problem. It's not THAT cheaply made. It's a solid plastic cover on the outside and metal on the inside. The outer plastic cover (called a diffuser) lines up in the ridges ok, but one side seems to not exactly lay flat in the ridge. No biggy. I can live with it. I'm not touching it all the time and after all, I'm using it for the 'light' it produces.

It was MUCH bigger than the picture makes it appear. It is as tall as a shoe box standing on it's side. A little taller actually. I'd best describe it as the size of a half a bread box standing on it's side (the old plastic ones that nobody has used in the past 50 years). Or expect it to be about 1/3 of the width your computer hard drive box (assuming you have a standard one).

Anyway, I figure in the morning this will have the same effect as a good cup of coffee.
I look forward to having energy and being highly active all day and getting lots done!!
It is sure to help me reclaim my days and hours.

Yaaaaaaaaaay. I'm so glad I finally tried this!
I say if you have *any* slow, sleepy, fatigued, groggy, slumbering, lethargic symptoms at all during the day in the cold months - this is well worth the money!!!

title: A Good Wakeup Clock
text:
I have been using the GM-01 Model Sunrise Clock for about a month now.

The unit is attractive and sturdy. It was relatively easy to set up considering all of the different things that need to be set. It took about three tries to get it right, but since then it was been working perfectly. The light itself is quite bright and a very white light. It was several nature sounds that can be used as an alarm. While the fidelity of the sounds was pretty good, they are about 5 second sound loops and so not that enjoyable. You can turn off the sound portion of the alarm by turning the sound to zero. You can also adjust the maximum intensity that the light goes up to. One feature not mentioned in the description is that the light will turn off on its own about 1 hour after the alarm setting, so you don't have to worry about turning it off or resetting the alarm for the next day. Also nice is the snooze "button" which is really a light sensor on the side of the unit--you can turn on the snooze with a wave you your hand.

Regretfully I have begun to sleep through it, but that may be because it is on the far side of the room. Perhaps moving it closer to the bed will be more effective. In any case, it is nice to have the room light when I need to get up.

title: UPDATE: IMPORTANT WARNING
text:
12/24/2019 UPDATE: After just 10 minutes of using this gamma brainwave entrainment device, my tinnitus (which I have had for years, but which has never been a bother) was amplified ten fold to the point where it is distressing and headache inducing and has already prevented me from sleeping a night. The product comes with disclaimers warning against seizures for those who are prone (I am not), but there is no warning about tinnitus (ringing in the ears), and so I feel compelled to issue one here should anyone else be subject to this symptom. I'm worried enough about it that I've already booked an appointment with a neurologist to get a brain map done in hopes of finding a countervailing frequency that can remedy this awful ringing in my head. I noticed this effect almost immediately and should have heeded it; should this happen to you, do yourself a favor and discontinue use at once!

On top of this, the charging cable has a short in it and the unit cannot be reliably charged, so I am returning it based on this alone. If only that were my only issue! Be forewarned.

------------------------------
Original Review:

I suppose this does what it says it will do: it plays an audible tone (maybe 1khz?) pulsing at 40 cycles per second. It looks like a tiny (one inch square) ipod player, replete with standard headphone jack, usb micro port, and a mini SD card. For some reason, they include ear buds with the unit; I'd have preferred they saved the money on the buds (which are common enough) and spent a bit more on the quality of the unit. I'm tempted to see if I can transfer whatever audio file is on the SD card to my phone. Or just download a binaural brain app that will play the same cycles... but typically, a gamma wave of 40 hz is inaudible. I'm assuming the 1khz tone cycled 40 times per second matches what was performed in the gamma wave entrainment studies.

I plan to use this nightly along with the 40hz lights to see if it has any noticeable affect on my cognitive state. Time will tell.

title: Good product for post ortho surgery pain
text:
I tried a few brands of these over-the-counter 4% lidocaine patches, the max concentration available w/out prescription, after knee replacement with normal postop pain. (None will completely remove all discomfort, so I don’t expect that.)
I was skeptical but wanted to decrease my opioid prescription ASAP. I felt better after a few hours but it wasn’t until 24 hours that I felt I could attribute it to more than wishful thinking. Fifteen days postop I am now adequately controlled with acetaminophen w/one dose of opioid at night and before PT.
I liked this product because it is lighter-weight, adheres better, is thinner so more flexible, comes in a child-proof container, and is good for 12 hours, not just 8, so more convenient for morning and evening application. I use 2 at a time, one on each side of my patella where the most common TKR pain is. Be aware that in one can there are 10 strips, meaning using 4/24 hour day means one can lasts only 2 1/2 days, so plan accordingly.
Small complaint: the picture doesn’t accurately show this, but there’s far too much (big plastic can) packaging for the amount of product enclosed; no option for getting many more per can, so that’s a lot of plastic in the landfill. But needs must.

Moving on... The first 5-10 minutes will definitely make you feel energized but longer than that, you will start feeling relaxed. For someone like me who always suffers from back and neck pain, this really works. Instant relief, I must say, when I got up. This acupressure mat is just so relaxing and revitalizing that I can feel the endorphins pumping throughout my entire body!

I HIGHLY recommend this acupressure mat product! Even though I know there are other less expensive types of this mat in the market, I believe this one is the best! title: Works just fine
text:
Not sure what all the negative reviews are about, perhaps there are quality control issues with this scale? But the one I receieved is great.

When I first got it I had to zero the scale using the small knob underneath the front edge, and I periodically have to do that still. I decided to test it by placing a 2L jug of water on the scale (about 5 lbs), my own weight, and my weight while holding the jug. It was accurate as far as I could tell. The dial has 1 lb graduations.

It does take a bit of skill to use to get repeatable readings, you'll need to shift your weight a bit while standing on it until the needle reaches a steady value on the dial since it has a tendency to stick. But I am getting consistent readings to within 1 pound, which is great for a cheap little scale like this.

I am liking the fact that there are no batteries to change with this mechanical scale. Also the fact that some cheaper digital scales will try to cheat you by displaying the last measured weight if you step on soon afterwards, to give the impression that the scale is repeatable. There are no electronics in this one, what you see is what you get (assuming it is measuring your weight accurately of course)

A complaint however: the scale is tiny, 10"x10". I would have preferred something with a slightly bigger surface

Other than that this is a decent little scale. I can't see why anyone would need to buy a scale, digital or not, that measures your weight to a precision of less than 1 pound. If you need that kind of precision and accuracy, there is no substitute for the kind of scale you see at your doctor's office. Also keep in mind that the average person's weight will vary by 3-5 lb a day so unless you are stepping on the scale with an empty bladder and at the same time each day, expect to see some variation.

3/10/20 update:
Still couldn't be happier with this product. I just ordered my second tin (not yet done with my 1st) which will be delivered tomorrow. The oil is great for an after washing light moisturizer, but I love the balm as it not only heavily moisturizes, but also helps for styling and keeping fly away hairs under control.

I'm also looking forward to fall when I plan to regrow my beard :D this has also been great for dry cuticles over the winter!

Original review:
Heads up, same review for the oil and balm as I've been using them in tandem:

I ordered without any reviews... I couldn't be happier. This oil absorbs well and isnt greasy. I've been using it at night before bed to keep my beard from drying out at night (cold winters, low humidity, fine hair... it sucks). I've been pairing it with the code balm during the day to keep my beard soft, hydrated, and held in place when I brush it.
For the oil I've been using a cheap mustache comb that came with my trimmers, placing oil in the comb teeth and combing my beard from my neck forward to spread the oil followed by using a firm boar brush to work it into my skin from the neck forward.
For the balm I have been using a medium soft boar brush and scraping an end of the bristles lightly into the balm and brushing it into my beard from the face to the neck to style it.

I dont know if I'm doing this right, but I'm happy with the results. Both hydrate and absorb well and have a long lasting scent that, although the ingredient list makes one think of a "darker" or heavier smell, actually is light/bright smelling and would, in my opinion as a gay man, compliment any "aqua" scented style of cologne very well. All of the other brands I have tried I havent found anything that went well with my cologne (dunhill desire blue), but this does. I'm very happy with this purchase and plan to buy the oil and balm again in the future. I wish this scent came in the mustache wax as well, though I do like the scent of the fertile crescent wax.

title: Prep Refresher = Brilliant Complexion
text:
I am a Black woman in my late 30s who has been dealing with cystic acne for the better part of 10 years. Over the last year especially I have been dealing with the scarring from this acne and have been experimenting with tons of products that can both deal with the cystic acne and the scarring with little success. But I have found that only glycolic acid works and after reading the reviews for this toner I thought that it couldn't hurt to try. I wanted to wait to see what it would do for my skin before writing a review and the results have been nothing short of remarkable. It's been about 5 days since I received it and started using: It has lessened the darkening of some of the scars and a few of the lighter ones are so faint I can't remember how dark they were before using. My pores were larger and my skin used to be oily to the point of embarrassment and now my complexion is much smoother, clearer and more matte. I took pictures of my skin before I began using and when I looked back at them (before writing this review to make sure it wasn't just my imagination) I can easily see a huge, huge difference!

I use it morning and night. I also received a free small bottle of collagen facial wash by Cellbone that was included in my order and it too is awesome. I wash with that, use a cotton pad (vs. a cotton ball, the pads for me are easier) to apply the Prep Refresher on my face and neck, and allow it to work -- I feel a tingling sensation that's mostly bearable (!) and when it subsides I apply aloe vera gel over my whole face, let that dry which it quickly does, then a moisturizer with SPF on top of it. I am so happy with this product and may go for a professional glycolic peel in a month if the deeper, darker scars are still apparent. I always get nervous too because with my Black skin I don't want to use a product that will cause more hyperpigmentation. I am going to call Cellbone to see if or when I should take a break from using this product or if it's safe enough to use everyday for an extended period of time. But overall I am completely happy with this product.

(Shipping from Cellbone was almost $7, high by my standards)

title: Great Quality Brushes
text:
I was given the chance to order these Aisxle 5 piece Eye Makeup brush set at a discount in exchange for a review. Being a makeup freak I jumped at the chance.

I love that these come in a small metal case. It makes finding the brushes in my makeup bag a breeze. No more digging around for each brush.

I have used these the last 3 days to test them. I pulled on each brush to test the bristles. I had none come out when pulled gently, and I have not had any come out or shed while using them. They pick up a good amount of powder.
I read some reviews where people thought the bristles were a little stiff. I did not find that to be an issue. The brush with the tapered end is a little more stiff than the others but I did not find it overly so. It worked great as the main powder brush for my eyelids. The more fluffy brush with an angle was great for my crease powder.
I also loved the small angled brush. It is perfect to use as a liner brush and to also use on my brows.

The one thing I wish these had was a label on the handle of each brush listing what their use is. I can see this set being great for a teenager just staring to learn makeup and having them labeled would be an asset for them. For the more experienced user it is not an issue however.

I love that the case is not overly large. It is a little smaller than a toothbrush holder. It fits great in my makeup bag and as I mentioned, makes it easy to find all my brushes without the digging.
Attached are a picture of the brushes in the case with the top removed, and the taped lid brush with one swoop of loose powder.

I plan using my brush cleaner on them this weekend and will update if they do not hold up to being cleaned.

I am enjoying the quality of these, especially for the price. With the holidays coming these would make a great stocking stuffer especially for a teenage girl.
I plan on ordering a few for my nieces.

title: Not worth it, only the wood is good
text:
I got this brush because I got tired of having to buy a new redecker back brush every year when they started to get black moldy and nasty... I've owned mine for about 7 months now, and the WOOD had held up fantastically... the bristles however leave MUCH to be desired.

For one the bristles on this one are abnormally coarse, practically feeling like they're going to rip my skin off, despite being used daily for over 6 months now, and despite supposedly being the same type of bristles that the other brush I normally got from them had.

NOT unlike a more traditional brush though, sure enough the bristles on my brush are already turning black as tar, and I haven't even had this brush for a year yet!

Having paid roughly TRIPLE the price of a standard brush, which likely would have had softer bristles, and which might have moldier wood but identical bristle cleanliness, really does not feel worth it to me... if they could figure a way to make the bristles themselves unable to mold, and also get them softer, then I'd be sold, but as is this makes as much sense as a nuclear bomb proof vest ... sure the vest will survive but what about the wearer? Having wood that can't mold, but overly stuff bristles that absolutely can, is totally pointless!

text:

Some prior criticisms need addressing. First, you must put your weight on the stepstool FIRST, then pull up on the assisting handrail. It is your weight that stabilizes things. title: Tastes Like Strawberry Quick
text:
We typically use SlimFast Keto shake mix for chocolate and vanilla, but of all the other KETO SHAKE options, this is my husband's favorite. We typically blend it up with creamer, ice, water, Stevia, and the KETO SHAKE powder. We live in Florida, and so smoothie-like shakes help get us through the heat of the day.

I am a chocolate shake fan, but this strawberry shake reminds my husband of NESTLE strawberry syrup to make strawberry milk as a child. He loves it!

I like it too, for strawberry, but as I already mentioned, I am a chocolate girl.

Some have mentioned issues with the color and strength of the flavor. Yes...it does NOT make a pink-colored shake...but come on, do you need food coloring to drink something that is strawberry flavored. I've always found food coloring deceptive anyway, and so the missing "pink" does not bother me. One less chemical to ingest if you ask me!

As for the flavor...it tastes like strawberry. But to bring out that flavor more, we add some extra stevia. We are sweet addicts (thus the need to go on KETO), and so an extra bit of sweetener really makes a difference. If you think the flavor is too weak (which I don't think is the case...I think people are confusing the flavor with the sweetness) simply add more sweetner and I think you will be thrilled with the outcome.

Thickness: the powder gets creamy in water, but as I mentioned earlier, we add creamer and water to ours.

To make 2 drinks...
Take a blender.
Add 1 cup ice.
Add 1-2 tbsp(s) pyure (to liking)
Add 2 scoops KETO powder.
Add 1/2 cup creamer.
Add 2 cups cold water.
Blend on high.
If too thick, keep adding small amounts of water until it is the right consistency.
Blend more.
Pour into 2 very large cups.
Add straws.
Share with your spouse!
Enjoy!

title: Good Shaving Cream
text:
I like this Shaving cream. Taylor of Old Bond Street is my favorite brand of shaving cream at the moment. So far I like the Almond sent the best, but this one may be my 2nd choice. This shaving cream lathers easy and protects my face. I will buy this again. For those unsure how to lather, here is one method:

How I make a good lather: I did a bunch of research on how to create a good lather with a cream. After that research I found it was actually very easy. And this method works like a charm with this cream.
1) Prior to showering in the morning I run the sink to get the hottest water I can. I then fill a ceramic (non-white) bowl with hot water, then put the bowl in the sink and fill the sink to the top of the bowl. I then put my brush and razor in the bowl to soak while I shower.
2) After showering I pull the bowl from the sink (leaving water in sink) and dump the water from the bowl (back into the sink). I just pour out the bowl and do not dry it.
3) Shake your wet brush a few times to knock off the surface water. Just a few times will do it. When done you shouldn't have any visible drops on the outside of the brush.
4) Dip the brush into the tub of cream making contact and pressing down slightly. Then spin the brush 2 full rotations and remove from tub. A little goes a long way here. You can always add more if needed later. You should see a small amount of cream on the tips of all the hairs.
5) Swirl brush in bowl in one direction. I go clockwise. Perhaps those south of the equator would go counter clockwise :). Every 10th or so swirl pump the brush once or twice. Repeat until you get a good lather. If you don't start getting a good lather (to thin) in 30ish swirls, spin brush one more time in the cream tub and then continue swirling.

I've found this method to be foolproof and gives you a warm and wonderful cream. There is a possibility that you get too much cream versus water with this method. It hasn't happened to me, but if it does (super stiff or chunky) then just wet your fingers in the sink and sprinkle a little water in the bowl. It's likely that different types/quality of brushes could require more or less spinning in the bowl. You'll get the hang of how many times to spin and how hard to press after a few shaves. Remember when spinning the brush in the bowl less is really more.

The body measuring tape - which is in inches and centimeters - was a nice addition for you to use to measure parts of your body as it locks and tightens to get a more accurate circumference of your waist line or arm or thigh. Or you can choose as a general measuring tool!

It's a nice product for someone who wants a simple and not complicated scale that's accurate! '
