title: Streaks, streaks, and more streaks
text:
I gave this friction polish a thorough tryout on turned wooden bowls and found it not up to the job. No matter how I applied it, it would form streaks of wax on my wooden turnings that were impossible to smooth out with any amount of pressure with a buffing cloth with the lathe running at high speed. The only way to get rid of the streaks was to buff them out with a pad with white diamond abrasive and then use carnuba wax on another buffing pad.

I tried this product on several projects, as did my colleagues in my shop, and we all had the same problem. In the end, I went back to Shellawax, which does not leave streaks when buffed at high speeds. (I have no proprietary interest in any finishing agents).

text:
Works really well, wish heating element was longer. I use this most often when I work outside (gardening and crafts) and start to get discomfort in my lower skull/upper neck from chill. Have also used in house for same pain, since it's more easy to focus than electric pad and less fuss than microwave ones. Like many people, I already have a couple of USB outlets and cables near the bed, so it's easy.
Both settings work well. Vecro closure is mixed blessing...if I want to strap it on very tightly (to get good pressure on needed area), it is staff under my chin, so not as comfortable. But, the design is fine when you just want warmth in the general area of your upper neck/shoulders. I only wish the large disc-shaped heating element was longer (more like a rectangle). Width of heated area is fine.

Be sure you have a couple of USB battery banks that fit the pocket if you want to be truly portable. I bought some nice ones, used, from Amazon warehouse.

I originally bought this to use in car as well, since I get the same pain at night when driving. But, now I'm just going to buy a second one, so I don't have to remember to pack it each time.

title: As seen on Shark Tank product really works!!!
text:
[[ASIN:B00O0CK2UM Nerdwax - The Original Glasses Wax - A Beeswax Based Blend of All Natural and Organic Ingredients - Keep Your Glasses From Slipping Down Your Nose - NO Bands, Straps, or Pads Needed! (1 Pack)]] Nerdwax is an amazing, innovative product that really works! I saw this product on ABC's Shark Tank in Sept 2015 and ordered it right away. The product works just like it says it does. You just use the handy chapstick shaped tube to roll-on a little of the wax to the edge of your glasses and the wax creates a bonding effect so that your glasses don't slip off anymore. I have a pair of plastic frame glasses with no nosepads, so my glasses would frequently slide down to the bottom of my nose when I would bend my head downward. Ugggg!!! So annoying! With Nerdwax, that problem is no longer happening. My glasses are staying in place because this Nerdwax makes a sort of bond that keeps them from sliding off. The product has a pleasant, slight mint smell and did not cause any irritation to my skin (since it is a natural product anyway). This product is not greasy, so you will never feel like you will have to wash your face after using Nerdwax on your glasses. I love that it comes in a chapstick size tube because it is so portable that way. This is one of those got-to-have-it products that I will defiantly reorder when I run out. Well worth the $12 it cost to get it. If you have read this far, please know that my husband has glasses with nosepads, and he was amazed when using Nerdwax that he didn't have to push up his glasses even once when applying the product. For his plastic frame sunglasses, he had been previously buying cushion pads and coloring them with a black marker and sticking them to his glasses (it looked really stupid), but now he will just use Nerdwax instead. This product is for ANY type of eye glasses you own and I can think of no substitute that is effective or as cool.

In response to negative reviews, I say that getting your eye-glasses adjusted properly is the first necessary step to having your glasses fit properly. This is easy to do with a little eye-glass screwdriver kit or bringing them into your eye-glass store and the technicians adjusting your glasses for free. I would not expect NerdWax to solve a problem that a little screwdriver to my stretched out eyeglasses can fix far better, so the negative reviews are questionable to me. NerdWax works and so what if you have to reapply it. Would you rather push up your glasses all day long? Ignore the negative reviews.

title: No residue at all, completely cleans contacts
text:
I have a PC that just would not boot. I have 20 years experience integrating PC systems. Nothing worked. I even pulled the processor, straightened a pin, but no go. Then I got WD40 contact cleaner. I pulled all the connectors, memory dimms, adapter boards, and sprayed everything with WD40 Contact Cleaner.

It dries very quickly. I connected everything back up, and poof, the system booted up, and it's been working ever since (6 months). Talk about getting me out of a jam. I was ready to replace the mobo! But for a few dollars and an hour's time I was saved a $200-$300 expense.

And I hardly used any. The can still feels full! I seriously could not believe it. And I shall never forget.

Five thumbs up.

title: get Air-Going!
text:
A few years back my health had a temporary setback that had me dependent upon a wheelchair. I was also traveling to see specialists and needed something that could fold up quickly and compactly to fit in either a car or on a plane. The Airgo Navigator can fold up just small enough to fit in the overhead compartment of airplane which means you never have to be separated from your own personal equipment. Fits easily in a trunk of a car as well.

Folding it does take some practice and having a couple of your own bungee cords or velcro straps is advisable to keep things *tight*. It's a bit like getting a tent back in its bag and for me required 3 or 4 tries to get it down pat; not especially difficult but I'd say it definitely requires practicing a few times to get it right so you can perform this action quickly if necessary.

Other features I like: you can add footrests and flip the backrest into position to have someone push you in "wheelchair mode".

You can adjust the seat and backrest to use as a rollator in "walker mode".

You always have a seat with you.

There is a basket to carry small items under the seat and/or store the footrests on board.

Last, but still of some importance for me is that the titanium color - looks great!

This model is built for getting around efficiently and compactly; it really is not meant for sitting in for long periods of time so if this is to be a primary wheelchair I would suggest looking into models that are made more for that purpose.

This was the best investment in compact versatile mobility I could have made. A sturdy, well constructed rollator+transport chair.

Pleased to recommend!

title: Amazing for whitening & plaque removal
text:
I've been using this for around five months. I waited this long to write a review to see if I had any actual benefits. I'm a middle-aged female (50), disabled, diabetic (controlled) and not very active/working. I stopped drinking sodas almost 10 years ago, can't believe it's been that long, I drink tea, not coffee and I'm a non-smoker. I think it's important to know where one starts with this type of product in order to know if it's going to be beneficial to others.

I've had terrible teeth all my life, cavaties, braces, root canals, failed bridges, blah, blah, blah. I believe the state of your teeth is hereditary as well as self-care. My mom has terrible teeth, my dad does not; I got the bad teeth, my sister did not, same thing with my husband and children. There may be something said for ADHD in there, IDK. I was horrible at brushing when I was younger but got better as I got older.

My teeth may have been bad but my gums were always in good shape; remember to brush the gums or this type of thing doesn't really work.

So now here I am at 50 with missing teeth, tooth pain and lots of cavaties and no dental insurance for the last ten years. I noticed in the last couple of years that my teeth were yellowing and I actually had one tooth break while eating; the tooth was hollow inside!

Any of the whitening toothpastes didn't work. I was limited to using Sensodyne and the like. I tried Crest strips and things like that with no results. I found this while surfing around on Amazon. Read up on it here and on the website for the company. I chose this one because it had double the amount of hydroxyapitate. One day I noticed that my teeth were a lot whiter; like the clock had turned back 30 years. It's removed stains and the plaque along the gums (gotta clean those gums) and I want to think it helped build up a chipped tooth. My teeth are smoother so it has filled in those little cracks that you don't really see. They also feel stronger. I can eat apples and carrots again whereas before I had a hard time chewing them.

I know this has been a long post, but thought you'd want to know how this affected me and my situation before embarking on your own journey to improving your teeth. This beats any of the American made tooth whitening products, well OTC ones anyway. I'll be using this one as long as I can. This one tube has lasted me 4 months, almost 5. So it doesn't take a lot to use.

Recommendations for use:
1. Brush and floss two to the times a day.
2. Brush for 3-5 minutes - I know it hard to think of doing but it pays off
3. Brush the gums - very important if you want the plaque to go away.
4. Use an electric toothbrush - Oral-B, Sonicare, even the battery powered ones are better than just a normal brush.

title: A decent nose/ear trimmer but not the best
text:
I've had the same nose/ear trimmer for a few years now that has served me incredibly well, but it is a bit bulky. That's the only negative I can say about it.

So I saw this pop up and decided to give it a shot thanks to the slimmer design. It looks pretty cool, too, which hey why not.

Couple things:

1) It is definitely smaller, less bulky than my other unit. Lightweight, too.

2) Battery holds up well. Have used it at least a dozen times and no issues yet.

3) Cleans up well and easily.

4) It is really quiet.

5) Super easy to turn on with the soft button hidden away in the bottom of the unit.

6) The cutter is easily removed for deep cleaning.

But on the negative end...

7) For some reason, the design of the cutter on this makes me have to use it for way longer than my other unit when trimming nose hairs. Like, much longer in order to get all the hairs, plus as many crazy angles as I can manage. It'll do the job, but it just doesn't grab the hairs as easily. Now there is one perk to that: I've yet to have any cuts inside my nose... my other unit will, every now and again, catch the skin and give me a little, tiny cut. Nothing that bleeds but yeah it hurts for a couple seconds. This unit? Never happened... so, its seemingly safer but requires a bit more time to get the job done.

I'm not sure why other reviewers don't seem to like this one so much, but I haven't experienced any other negatives. It has yet to pull on any hairs (my other unit, however, sometimes does), and again, it totally gets the job done. I think it is priced very fairly for what it is (in the sub-$15 range), so I wouldn't hesitate picking one of these up.

title: Just ok for blackheads but crushes it at microdermabrasion!
text:
Wow, this thing. I purchased initially for blackheads for my daughter but I didn't know at the time that it comes with 6 heads. It comes with 2 for blackheads, 2 oval shaped ones for wrinkles, one large round opening (for bigger blackheads? who knows), and one with a silver ring around it. The directions are useless so I had to google what the silver one was for and it turns out that it's for microdermabrasion and WOW does it work great! Assuming it's made like other brands with similar heads, the silver stuff is a diamond tip. I've been dying to get the (popular one at Ulta) with the little rotating disks that essentially are like a sander on your face but I was turned off at the prospect of having to replace the little disks (ie, throw them away, guessing they aren't recyclable).

I've been using the microdermabrasion head twice a week at the highest suction (test at the lowest first so you can get the hang of it) and my skin is SO SMOOTH after I use it! If you have any little rough patches of dry skin you can sort of go over them a few extra times and it rubs off and sucks up all of the flakes of skin.

I also tried the oval head for wrinkles last night and unsure of any lasting effects of it, but it definitely did plump my skin and my forehead wrinkles were temporarily "gone".

My only beef with this item is that it doesn't charge fully and it doesn't hold a charge very long. The first time I charged it, the display showed full battery but we only got 2 uses out of it before it went dead. Every charge after that, it only charged halfway. For the price and how effective it is, I don't have any complaints.

As for blackheads, it does work, but like I said, best to use after a shower when your skin is soft. The suction is strong but not too strong that it damages your skin, so you can go over the same area more than once if you need to, and even use several days in a row.

title: Sort and Fill ONCE a Month (tips on using)
text:
I had been using 4x/day (28 box sorter trays) two of them to sort out my pills for 4 weeks at a time. But my trays were wearing out after several years of use and I decided to give this a try. I like the small daily “pods” of am/pm. One thing I really like is I don’t have to fish the tiny pills out of the container, I can just pour them all directly in my mouth, something that’s not really possible with even the weekly sorters. Having them as individual days also allows you to customize your sorter. Here’s my best tips.

Pick a day of the week that you’d like to start on. I like to refill on Sunday night so I start my month with the 1st Monday of the month. (See photo of June 2019 starting on Monday the 3rd.)

Label the days of the week along the edge of the white tray.

Since the white tray the daily boxes sit in 8 across and only 4 rows, every month but February will leave you with pods that need to go in the 8th slot. I have them running back up the side with the smiley extras box at the top. If it’s only a 30 day month I put the 31 upside down before the smiley box. (See photo)

Decide on how you want to deal with the daily boxes when you’ve taken that days meds. I have tried 2 ways. The first was to turn the box over so the date no longer showed so I knew my next box was the next one with a date showing. The method I ended up with was putting the empties in basket I keep all my bottles in. Makes it easier to tell on a pre-coffee morning with no glasses on.

I hope this helps you! My cat apparently thought so too when she decided to lay down in the middle of my shot. Oh and I’m not missing a box it was out of the frame, probably under the cat.

However, since I live in an area that drinking is pretty much at every event this is good to have on hand as a "check your self" reminder.

You will need 2 AAA batteries, this doesn't come with any. It is pretty small and will fit in your pocket or purse. Overall, Perfect for me to put in my "finally able to drink" child's glove box and remind them the house rule. Having used a neti pot for a very long time, I was also surprised by how much easier and more comfortable it is not to have to lean way over in order to have the solution flow through my nasal passages – I'd just gotten used to doing it. Being able to squeeze the bottle also allows for changing how fast it flows in. Being able to see how much is still in the bottle, so that I can stop halfway, and switch sides is also extremely helpful! The only thing it doesn't have, which I wish it did, is a stand to hold the bottle upside down when drying it.

The salt packets are hard to empty, as the slit for opening them is badly placed: lengthwise, and in the middle, so they just tear down the middle, leaving a pocket on both sides which is hard to empty by pouring (as a nurse, I'm not going to stick it in the bottle and shake it, for sanitary reasons).

title: A nice brush that is easy to use
text:
This seems like a good brush.

I have a much more expensive silvertip brush, which is made from a different part of the badger. There isn't as much of it, so the cost is considerably higher.

This one is a smaller brush, and stiffer, which is expected from a standard badger hair brush. This makes it easier for people new to this type of shaving because it is less delicate and easier to get a good lather going. It is rougher against the skin than the silvertip, however.

The handle feels nice in the hand and is surprisingly heavy. I wonder if there might be some metal in there weighing it down. Regardless, it is well-balanced.

I can't speak to the longevity of the brush, having had it only a few days, but so far it seems to be doing fine.

If you are new to using a shaving brush, my advice is to start with a standard badger hair brush, either this one or a different one. After you are more used to it, go for the silvertip.

Sean Logue, 2016

The other tip is a hair shaving attachment and there is also an included charge cable and a brush to help clean the tips. title: Mild flavor, great potential health benefits
text:
I didn't know much about the potential benefit of noni fruit powder so I did some research. I found out that noni powder is "loaded with antioxidants, polysaccharides, amino acids, vitamins, and minerals." It is supposed to give you an immunity-boost. Who couldn't benefit from that? I added 1 tsp into my smoothie. The noni fruit powder had a mild flavor and blended well. I didn't notice any immediate, noticeable changes but if the information I researched is correct, it is beneficial in ways that may not be immediately apparent. I am going to continue using it for the potential health benefits. I have included the other information I found during my research below:

"Origins of Noni Powder
Noni is the Hawaiian name for the Morinda citrifolia plant, an evergreen shrub that probably originated in Southeast Asia and has spread throughout Oceania. It is believed that noni was a "canoe plant," so highly prized by Polynesian peoples that they brought it with them as they migrated in their canoes to new islands. As the white noni berry is pungent and bitter, it was only eaten during times of famine. However, Polynesians used the noni berry widely as a dye and to treat wounds, inflammations, infections and other ailments.

Health Benefits of Noni Powder
Noni is sometimes known as a superfood because of all its phytochemicals: antioxidants, polysaccharides, flavonoids, fatty acids, and catechins. It contains 17 different amino acids, as well as a significant amount of other nutrients.

1) Antioxidant Powerhouse: Organic noni powder is packed with protective antioxidants, flavonoids, and catechins. These compounds protect cells from oxidative damage caused by free radicals, which helps reduce the risk for premature aging and chronic conditions like heart disease.

2) Immunity-Boosting: Noni is a rich source of polysaccharides which support the body's natural defense system against illness and infection. A study at the University of Hawaii demonstrated that the polysaccharide content of noni juice improves the function of white blood cells in the immune system, which protect the body against diseases. A separate study at the university found that specific polysaccharides, known as noni-ppt, inhibited tumor growth and improved the life span of tumor-bearing mice.

3) Essential Nutrients: Organic noni powder is an excellent source of essential fatty acids and all 9 essential amino acids that our bodies do not produce naturally and must be obtained through diet. Essential fatty acids keep our cells functioning normally and essential amino acids are required to help our bodies make proteins. Additionally, noni powder is an excellent source of vitamin C, dietary fiber, iron, and potassium."

Hope this is helpful information to others!

title: A handy set of resistance bands, that allows me to use resistance on my back without going to the gym
text:
I've had a few resistance tubes and resistance band sets, and this is easily the best quality set.

There are five, color coded, bands. The purple is the lightest resistance and the green is the heaviest resistance. In between there is blue, yellow, and red. (I wonder about that ordering a bit, since it's not really intuitive. If you order colors on the spectrum you'd go: purple, blue, green, yellow, red instead of purple, blue, yellow, red and green ... the purple is obviously the thinnest band but the yellow, red and green look to be about as thick so the only way to be sure which is which is to either memorize the order or pull and go by feel.)

Each end of each band has a carabiner on it, that hooks into handles. There's also a velcro loop that you can run the tube through after you've attached it to a bar. There's even a door mount, that can slide underneath a door or hook at the top of a door if you are on the side of the door that opens away from you.

I find the easiest, and simplest thing is just to hook the handles onto one (or more) of the bands and then place one of my feet at the center of the band. I also use these for basic back stretches. I keep one of the bands at my desk and try to get up every hour or so and just grab the tube at convenient points with both hands and then pull my arms out and back until they are straight, and then I try it at a cross angles, with one arm going up to the left and the other down and to the right, and then vice versa.

I like resistance tubes because I tend to do my workout at home, mostly using bodyweight. I can work my chest and legs and shoulders that way, but it's more difficult to do anything with the back unless you have some kind of resistance. These are enough to get a good back workout. I can strap them to the door and then do a rowing exercise, for example.

I like that the kit as a whole comes with a convenient carrying bag that easily stores all components.

(I received a complimentary or discounted sample of this product for my honest and unbiased feedback.)

title: A large supply of a good quality supplement for overall joint health - easy to swallow caplets that promise good benefits

I'm a tall man and I work out pretty regularly, and I do occasionally have joints that complain. The caplets are easy to swallow. The recommended daily dosage is two caplets per day. I've been taking them for about a month now, and I haven't noticed any of the usual (but occasional) joint pain. I can't say for sure whether this is the reason, since I'm not able to compare the results with a placebo in a large double blind study. I do know that research supports an overall increase in joint health with these supplements and I'm fairly confident that Viva labs is a good source with a quality product. title: Not bad as a somewhat more nutricious alternative to cookies or candy, but these are still a bit too sweet for my taste
text:
I've been eating Zone bars, here and there, on occasion, for a long time. I read Barry Sears book on the Zone, which was one of the earlier popular dieting books to suggest that a good diet should be neither "low-fat" nor "low-carb" but should deliver a good balance of fat, carbs and protein, and that eating foods with the proper balance would give you more energy (or put you in "the Zone"). That was a long time ago, and I've forgotten the specifics, but for a while I would buy Zone bars (or Balance bars, which seem to be designed on the same principle) as an alternative to, say, candy bars. I still do that sometimes.

I've purchased the ZonePerfect Kidz bars occasionally as snacks for my kids lunches. They're a bit more like candy bars -- sweeter, with more sugar -- than the "adult" zone bars, but it's better than buying cookies. I hadn't tried the Fudge Brownie kind before, and I have to say I'm not a huge fan. It's a bit too sweet, and the taste isn't really to my liking. My kids will eat them, but don't love them either, so while I do expect to buy other flavors, I don't think I'll get this one again.

Having said that, this is good deal, and buying them in these 30 count packages saves money over buying the single boxes in the local grocery store, unless they happen to be on sale. When you buy these, there's a generic cardboard box with 6 of the 5 count boxes inside of it.

title: remembering a great man
text:
Last Monday I heard the horrible news that Harry Kalas had collapsed before a Nationals game and died at the young age of 73. To say I was shocked would be an understatement.

Here's a man that dedicated most of his life to the city of Philadelphia -a city he truly admired and considered home- and here's a man that has quite possibly the best voice I have ever heard.

The sound of his voice alone should be enough proof the guy had talent, but another thing I always admired about Harry Kalas is the way he calls the game right down the middle, and even though you know he wants the Phillies to win because of the emotion and sincerity in his voice, he always had a ton of respect for the teams the Phillies were facing.

I absolutely loved the way he would focus on the game itself and not jump off-topic suddenly talking about things unrelated to the game itself. There needs to be more baseball announcers out there who are like that today. When the announcers pay attention to the game and show emotion and excitement, the viewers do as well, and that's why Phillies games were never boring when Harry was calling them.

Every Saturday summer night for the last 15 years, it's been great to come inside after a swim in my backyard pool or a game of horseshoes and turn on Phillies baseball at 7 pm (and sometimes Friday nights as well). Of course Sunday is considered the biggest day of the week for baseball (the day we always see the Phillies and the other 29 teams play unless there's a rain delay or something).

Today was the first Sunday I didn't hear Harry's magnificent voice and it was hard not to think about Harry while the game was going on. The guy who has replaced Harry Kalas (Tom McCarthy) did a great job, but I think even he was aware that people at home were missing Harry Kalas. It was just a tough game this afternoon for the announcers and players alike.

For the Phillies to come back in the bottom of the 9th this afternoon and win the game in dramatic fashion with a 2-point homerun was amazing, and just shows how great the Phillies are, and why we should give them all the support in the world.

But nothing, NOTHING will ever beat the sound of Harry Kalas' voice during the final play of the World Series last year. Listening to the sound of his voice as he made the final call to end the game, I could sense a sigh of relief in his voice, and a hint of emotion so strong that it sounded like happy tears coming from Harry's true feelings. What a great moment for him to see the team he supported since 1971 win another world championship.

I apologize for not talking more about this product, but you should know anything that has Harry Kalas' name connected to it, it's going to be nothing but quality from start to finish. Rest in peace Harry Kalas, you will be loved in Philadelphia for a very long time, that's a fact.

Overall I would recommend this for a change of routine if you are looking for a new protein powder to try. It doesn't have EVERYTHING under the sun, like some protein drinks do, but maybe thats a good thing, right?

title: I like it but really some basic statistics would be good.
text:
its kind of like an insurance policy. you hope it works, but there isn't any way you can prove it.

One thing I was very curious about was the ability of the unit to control the air in a certain area. But I can't find anywhere on the website or the amazon product page where its clarified. At the moment I have two of these, one is in the laundry room and the other is in my son's bedroom, which is about 11x10 feet. One presumes that the unit can handle a bedroom, but as I said, its really not clear.

According to the manufacturer, the bulb loses 15% "efficiency" after 4000 hours (5.5 months of continuous use), and should be replaced. I have been waiting until mine burn out before replacing. Replacement bulbs are reasonable. At the time of this review, they are $8 each delivered from Amazon but $14 each from the manufacturer's website.

But lets go back to this 15% efficiency loss. What is this 15% of? Brightness? luminousness? UV rays (quantity)? UV strength (quality)? Germs killed? 15% suggests there is some number, some study, but all we get is 15%. If I'm running it in a small room, and if there is a loss of efficiency, won't all the germs get killed anyway, but just slower? too many unanswered questions.

Guardian's website says:
"UV-C light helps kill the DNA of germs reducing their ability to reproduce. UV-C light kills germs."

I found this a bit confusing. On the one hand, the UV light neuters the germs so they can't reproduce, which does help. The next sentence says that it kills germs. If it kills germs it doesn't seem relevant that it would neuter them.

While I like this unit, I feel that GG needs to provide a bit more depth to their information. They have a lot of grand, sweeping statements like "UV-C has been used to kill germs for 100 years", but very little information about the efficacy or efficiency of their own product.

Basically, they say "Our product must work, because science is happening inside. You can't doubt science." So I remove a star for the lack of information.

I do believe in the science, which is why it gets 4 stars, but I just can't give 5 stars for a "covered wagon medicine show" presentation depth.

Some extremely basic statistics really need to be added.

title: Like DISTORTION, Forbidden breaks free of thrash for something… stranger
text:
Originally released in 1997, GREEN was the fourth of five full-length albums by Hayward, California’s Forbidden (which is just south of Oakland in the Bay area). The band plays technical thrash metal masterminded by guitarist Craig Locicero and have been on hold since 2012. My favorite album by them is easily their last one, 2010’s OMEGA WAVE. That disc took the late 80’s technical thrash of their first two albums — FORBIDDEN EVIL (1988) and TWISTED INTO FORM (1990) — and superbly mixed it with the peculiar arty approach of their two mid-90’s releases — DISTORTION (1994) and GREEN (1997).

That brings us to GREEN. With the emergence of grunge in the early 90s after the success of Nirvana’s NEVERMIND, Craig & the boys felt freed-up to drop the thrash metal polka and really explore their craft. Don’t get me wrong, there’s still a thrash element, but it’s less one-dimensional.

Like its older cousin, DISTORTION, everything about the band is technically improved on GREEN, but something about the songwriting prevents the songs from grabbing the listener. As such, you can listen to the whole album and enjoy it, but walk away not remembering any particular song. However, this is resolved by repeat listens: The more you hear, the more jumps out at you.

The highlights for me are the haunting doom of the opener “What is the Last Time”; the experimentalism of “Turns to Rage,” which includes spoken word during the stanzas and features a quirky post-chorus piece; the heavy grunge metal of “Blank,” which starts psychedelically; and the eccentric, but catchy closer. For those with a need for speed there’s a punk/thrash/speed trilogy (tracks 6-8).

The album was just too deep, too different, in the mid-90s for the average rock-metal aficionado who apparently preferred “a mosquito, my libido.”

GRADE: B+/A-

It would have been sooooo very easy for them to have put USB charging ports directly on each device. That way we, the customers, would never have to worry about loosing the charging cable. So - epic fail.

Next is the flosser. Talk about awkward to use. And good luck keeping the flow going as you jink the device around to get the right angles. I supplied my own tubing so that the flossing head is on the end of a tube now. Much much better.

title: Clear oil that doesn't stink - a sign of quality
text:
The test of fish oil is that if it smells fishy then it has been exposed to heat/air more than it should have been. The test of fish oil capsules is that they don't leak or smell.

These capsules passed both tests. The oil is clear and low viscosity. It smells a little of fish, but is not strong. I dumped all the capsules out of the bottle and there wasn't any stray oil, which indicates no leaky capsules.

title: This is a -proper- tourniquet
text:
I've made tourniquets from paracord and sticks and I've used the good ones that are intended for front line soldiers. This one is kinda like those good ones. Actually, I'd classify it as capable of being issued as one of the good ones.

I shoved it into my EDC bag, thereby improving the first aid aspects another notch. Totally worth it.

title: Great reading lamp, easily adjustable
text:
I absolutely love this little desk light. The light is bright, but, it's like sunlight and it is really easy on the eyes. I love this lamp for reading. I do think it reduces eye fatigue.

The best feature of this light in my opinion is the very easily adjustable lamp head. You can easily adjust this lamp to nearly any angle, lower and raise it just as easily.

The lamp itself is made of plastic, but, it seems to be quite sturdy as my cats have knocked off my end table twice already and it has held up nicely. It's not heavy weight, but, it's not too light. The look of this lamp to me looks like a vacuum cleaner, but, I love it anyway.

I'd highly recommend this light for reading or studying, I love it.

title: Too tight
text: I’ve had the opportunity to test quite a few face masks.  This one would be near the bottom of my list.  Let’s start with the good.  It is very lightweight.  It has a nice formed foam and doesn’t rub on my eyelashes.  It comes with a cooling gel pad.  There are several issues as far as I see it.  First and most important, it doesn’t fit well.  I have it set to the very end of the Velcro and it is still tight on my head.  I do not particularly have a large head.  As a matter of fact, I can wear some youth baseball caps set on the largest setting.  This elastic tugs far too much to be comfortable.  The next issue is that this thing has a cord that isn’t much longer than 3.5 feet.  That means you have to be close to your power source.  You can use a usb battery but they are expensive if you don’t already have one.  With regard to the heat, this mask on the hottest setting just got lightly warm.  Most of the heat seemed to be in the raised areas where the eyes go and not the part that touches your skin.  It means that it has to heat up the air between you and the eye area in order for you to feel the warmth.  It’s just not warm enough for me.  Since the cord has to be attached to the mask via magnet, with such a a short cord, basically I have to sit perfectly still.  No way I could actually wear this to sleep in unless I found a way to mount the usb battery near my head.

title: Inconsistent sizes
text: This box comes with four scents.  All of them strong.  What I don’t like is you can’t easily tell what each one is.  two of the styles are double the thickness of the other two and they last longer.  They are pretty and the presentation is nice.  Would be good for a gift.

title: Band is kind of short
text: This heats up as expected.  The mask isnt too big and gives your nose room without causing pressure on the bridge.  I have a small to average size head, my husband’s, mothers and father’s is a bit bigger.  But I have to open the band almost all the way on the Velcro.  If you have a big head, and don’t like to have the band tight on your head (it is made of elastic) then this may not be the mask for you.  On the plus side, the cord is lightweight but I Don’t feel like it is really long enough.

title: Nicest foot soak I’ve ever seen
text: Compresses down to save space.  Has a remote control.  Heats the water and massages the feet.  Deep enough to get your ankles and part of your calf in too.  Can cover the water and reuse if you really want to.  This one is quite nice.

title: They are ok.
text: These gummies were quite soft but not sticky.  They have a fruit flavor but somewhat of a pasty doughy taste.  They are ok but the flavor doesn’t beat out my regular brand.

title: Great price for a steamer
text: This steamer has a similar footprint to my former steamer - it take up substantial counter space.  However it really cranks out the steam.  This is less than half of the price of my old steamer.  What you get for the price is a really good deal.

title: Overall good set
text:
[[VIDEOID:49a100ccd749c31c31003b444886594a]] The set is nice. The flosser comes with several tips. The brush comes with several heads. The two issues I have are related to the flosser. First you can’t open the reservoir other than the small hole in the back. This makes it a lot harder to get completely empty and air dry or clean. The other is the tube that sucks up the water is stationary. This means you have to contort yourself to get the last of the water out by leaning the unit a particular angle. I have another that the tube is weighted and it rocks from side
To side depending on which way you need to lean the unit while reaching your teeth. Overall this is a decent set. If you need both you might save a few dollars buying a set. Standard replacement brushes can be used on this.

title: There are better products out there
text: If you look at my photo you can’t even tell which side I straightened.  I have used straighteners before and they have taken the frizz out of my hair.  This one not only didn’t really straighten, it didnt help much with my frizz.  Also my hair was brushed completely with my normal brush first.  However this brush caught In and pulled hair out.  It doesn’t perform like a brush helping any tangles out of your hair.  I used it on the highest setting and I was disappointed with this product.  I suggest you could find a better product elsewhere.  It comes with a glove to help prevent burning but my larger had (not fat) it barely fit.  My girlfriend’s hand it fit fine.  It also comes with a nice carry bag.  Overall, I’m not a fan.

title: Taste Good.  Pain Relief Unsure
text: I love the taste of these.  As for it they actually provide pain relief, One has to hope yes, but I’ve also lost a lot of weight and that could be what is curbing the pain.  I gave it 4 stars because i just don’t know if they really work well or not.

title: Excellent Supplement
text:
This turmeric-curcumin and black pepper supplement by Zebora is good! I use turmeric, curcumin, and pepper for reducing inflammation and pain resulting from arthritis. This supplement does seem to help. These ingredients are also known to build up the immune system.

The process used in creating this supplement is supposed to make it more water soluble and more readily absorbed by the body. This will make it more effective as a supplement, and it seems to do the job. This supplement is made with BioPerine, a substance made from black pepper that contains all of black pepper’s healthful properties. In this way, the wonderful properties of black pepper are made more potent and more accessible to the body. Black pepper reduces inflammation, lowers blood sugar levels, and improves cholesterol levels and the memory.

I like that this supplement is non-GMO. These are rather large, flat tablets, but they are easy to take. Three tablets a day is what is recommended.

title: My Dogs Will Take These Healthy Treats!
text: This Kenn & Kitt Hip and Joint Supplement for Dogs seems to help my older fur babies. This treat contains Omega 3 and glucosamine, which lubricates their joints, lowers the chance of inflammation, and makes them feel more comfortable as they age. Most of the trouble with a supplement like this is getting the dogs to eat it. My dogs loves these soft chews, and they never refuse them. They seem to consider them a treat. These treats are wheat-free and contain no preservatives. This treat is made in the United States. This deal is for 60 soft chews.

title: Nutritionally Good, but Not to Be Used Like Sugar
text:
This Super Organics Agave Inulin Powder is a sweetener that has nutritional value. I know. This seems like a contradiction in terms, doesn’t it? However, you cannot really use this like you do sugar.

This product is a much finer grain than sugar and it is much less sweet. The consistency is very different. It doesn’t melt in your mouth like sugar, but it forms a pasty consistency. It does mix well in tea. However, more of it is needed than you would use of sugar.

I like that it has fiber. However, this is not a calorie-free sugar substitute. It is a food with nutritional values, so there are 15 calories per four grams. It is, however, non-GMO and organic. It would be perfect for creating a healthy smoothie.

I like the resealable bag it comes in. That is handy.

The price is quite high for an 8-ounce bag.

title: Wonderfully-Soothing Baby Oil with Coconut Oil
text:
I do not have a baby on which to use this baby oil. I wanted to try it as a moisturizer for myself. I value coconut oil and use it daily, due to its wonderful health properties. Consequently, I was eager to try this mixture of baby oil and coconut oil. The first thing I noticed is its fresh and gentle scent of baby oil combined with coconut oil. It is a wonderful, light scent. I regularly use baby oil as a moisturizer, and I noticed that this oil is a little thicker than traditional baby oil, and, although it does absorb well into the skin, it does not absorb as quickly. For these reasons, I believe that this would be a better massaging oil than the traditional baby oil or baby lotion. As a moisturizer for adults, I believe it might be better used at night, as it doesn't absorb immediately into the skin. It did make my skin feel soft and smooth and soothed, leaving behind a light, fresh scent. It is ultra-gentle and great for sensitive skin. It contains no parabens, phthalates, dyes, mineral oil, formaldehyde, or harsh fragrances. This product is not tested on animals. The pump bottle is great for dispensing this oil in small amounts.

I was given a free sample of this product in exchange for an unbiased review.

title: I really like this
text: I really like this, so much better than the old loofa ones that tend to mold if left hanging in the tub. This is more sanitary, can give a vigerous scrub, is easy to use. I am petite, and the scrubber is quite long. I am still having no trouble using it and enjoying the feel of really fresh clean skin.

title: PERFECT!!!
text: These are awesome! I added a ton of photos with measurements, as my item, to place inside, is an exact height/width and I needed them to fit. I counted all the bags and ended up with 2 extra. These are really cute! They secured well when pulled (don’t pull too hard) and I had no need to tie them as it’s a pain to get knots out without cutting and I’d like these to be reusable for people. Overall A+ the metallic gold is gorgeous and shiny and all bags are perfect!! I will purchase these again!!

title: Excellent
text: Excellent replacement brush heads.

title: Bought them to try, LOVE THEM for their utility
text: Since I couldn't really get info on what to expect as far as fabric used or consistency of the product, I just went ahead and bought some of these to fill a couple of 'emergency kits' I made up for friends last Christmas. I was quite amazed! I opened one individual towel...and 'towel' is what they really are, far more a 'woven, thin fabric' than paper, you just add a little water (cold or hot, doesn't matter...maybe one-to-two tablespoons worth) and they expand to be  a 'cotton-like moist towlette' that will endure through ANY wiping effort you have in mind! Kid clean ups, personal hygiene, make-up, first aid efforts...name it! They are some type of cotton, so they are biodegradable...but probably not as fast to decompose as a paper towel. SInce I bought them, I've found them VERY handy in the car, or camping, as you have the equivalent of a small wet-wipe or wash cloth at your disposal anytime! HIGHLY recommend.

title: Sturdy and small
text: Ignore the color because I have a mix of more than one set. The actual set came with one purple, one blue, and one green. I really like these pill cases. I take six different pills and they fit into the slot nicely. I’ve had other small cases where the covers of the individual day containers started to break off so these are much more sturdy than that despite the small case size. I bought these at the grocery store before and they’re my favorite so when I saw this deal on Amazon I snatched it up.

title: Five Stars
text: THE BEST BARNONE.

title: Good pill spliter
text: Exactly what I was looking for.

title: Very fun to use
text: Also great to clean car tires too

title: Really exfoliating
text: Natural and soft but hard and scrubs off my dead skin

title: Really sweet and yummy
text: Love the packaging, it's a really creamy gummy and I love that it has so many different vitamins and supplements to keep me healthy. Would make a great gift.

title: Very nice creamy gummies, very sweet
text: Like the taste of these and it's very creamy and sweet! I like the taste and it helps a lot with cravings. The gummies are a good texture, it's easy on the teeth, not super hard, very soft and pleasant.

title: Makes a perfect gift!
text: Bath bombs are very creamy and fizzy. Love the scent and colors. Very fragrant and each have their own little unique pattern. Love!

title: Very fizzy and fragrant
text: Great scent. Very fizzy and colorful with huge selection to choose from. All whole pieces none were broken.

title: Okay cling wrap, very flimsy container
text: The cardboard is super thin and collapses completely gripping it with one hand. The cling wrap itself is alright, just thicker than I thought it would be. Takes some force to cut it with the little zip tool they give you.

title: Nice and puffy!
text: These are great to clean yourself with. Good size, not too big or small. They’re bunched up tightly and stay compact when washing yourself. Easy to rinse and stay clean.

title: Large bath bombs that fizz up like crazy
text: Love how fragrant and colorful these bath bombs are. They’re shaped like eggs and make bath time fun. So cool to see them fizz up so crazy and it makes the water soft.

title: Smell so relaxing and sweet
text: Love the different colors in these bath bombs. Makes me feel so relaxed when bathing. They fizz up really nicely and feel velvet soft and smooth in the water. Comes in giftable packaging!

title: Suction is very weak
text: This was not a very good suction tool. I firmly put it over the bite and then pulled the little piece upwards and it’s a very weak suction. Barely feel anything and didn’t do much to my bites.

title: No more embarrassment!
text: This is a great product and it works great. Just a little spritz and you can’t even tell I went. Smells really good, like a floral garden. The bathroom doesn’t smell like a perfume department though, it’s subtle.

title: Simple to use
text: This is handy to keep around my neck when power washing, cutting the grass, weed whacking, etc. the rope doesn’t cut my skin it’s actually pretty silky soft. The rubber stays into my ear fine. Good for reuse if you clean them.

title: So fizzy and bright colors!
text: Lovely set of bath bombs with fun little toys. They all are so fragrant and smell sweet. The colors are bright and make bath time fun!

title: Really nice floss threader with carrying case
text: The carrying case is very secure and closes tightly. No spillage at all. Very good floss threaders too.

title: Smells so fragrant
text: These bath bombs are a nice size and they’re heavily scented. They’re fizzy and the colors change the color of the bath water. I like that they’re in a nice gift worthy packaging as well.

title: Has a lot in a little bag!
text: This is perfect to keep in the car or desk or just in your purse. It has a lot of different items which are useful for everyday cuts and scrapes. The items are handy and pretty good quality. Comes in a red first aid bag.

title: Would not stick
text: I use tape a lot and for some reason this batch does not stick at all. You stretch the tape and apply it in a methodical way and then rub it to create friction. After a few hours it starts to peel and then comes right off. Don’t have any hair and tried this with three other people. Same thing. Not strong enough to adhere to skin.

title: Tastes excellent
text: This is so yummy. Tastes just like a mini candy bar but for only 25 calories. Makes a great gift for those who aren’t about swallowing pills but still treating them to chocolate and health!

title: Great price for $10
text: You can use this wet or dry. I prefer dry. I use the soft bristle side on my arms and legs and back to help relieve my stress and promote blood circulation. The rubber side I use to massage and press into sore muscle spots. Effective and simple. Wooden handle is nice, no splinters.

title: Super cute and whimsical
text: This mask fits me perfectly. So cute and soft. It’s actually made pretty well, the ears are 3D and the design is sewn onto the mask. There’s a string in the back that is secure on my head. Great for naps!

title: Nice gift bags
text: These are nicely made and come with ribbon for the handles. The bag is very shiny and smooth and can fit a lot. Perfect for parties or birthdays!

title: Really small and uncomfortable
text: This would fit more like a child. It’s very small and the straps are very uncomfortable and cut into the skin. The back is made weirdly. There are so many Velcro pieces it’s very hard to use this by yourself. It digs into the armpit after a couple minutes and the strap underneath the chest slides upwards—doesn’t stay in place.

title: Quality eyelash curler
text: Very strong and easy to use. Beautiful design with a velvet pouch. The brush is nice to comb out the mascara too.

title: Tasty!
text: These gummies are very tasty and help me stay regular and on track with my fitness goals. They’re squishy and gummy, taste sweet like candy. Kind of like a treat for me! Very tasty.

title: Great for the forgetful minds!
text:
This water bottle is such a great invention. It comes with a ball inside the water bottle to mix up smoothies or powders if you want. It’s very thick plastic and the lid snaps closed tightly. The pill case is such a genius idea. Only downside is that the Sunday pill slot is a lot smaller than the rest of the slots (see picture).

But for me, that’s not a problem as I don’t take a lot of medicine. Overall, extremely happy with the quality of this. The clip that you can hang the water bottle onto is removable as well.

title: Extremely large and very vibrant
text: These bath bombs are very heavy and very large. Almost like giant oranges to me. They each have their own individual scent and color. The water changes to whatever color the bath bomb is. Very fizzy and very fragrant. Skin feels moisturized and soft after using. Beautiful gift set to yourself or loved ones. Highly recommend, especially for under $25!

title: Tastes great and helps me stay alert!
text: These gummies taste kind of like strawberry and they’re very sweet. I use to put 1/2 tsp of apple cider vinegar in my water to help me lose weight and it has helped a lot but it tastes awful. These gummies have solved that plus more with the green tea. I’ve noticed I’m more alert after taking this. Really happy with this product!

title: Great for smaller feet
text:
This is a good massager for people with smaller feet. I’m a woman that wears size 8. This fit me perfectly. My dad is wears a 9.5 could not fit his foot in the machine. Those with wider feet would probably have problems with this. So it’s not meant for everyone’s feet.

The bottom base is plastic so I was surprised to see how cheap the quality was. The top grey part is a fabric like material. It has to be plugged in during use.

It’s pretty long and annoying. It squeaks and I can hear the air pressure go off and the plastic pins inside go up and down. The massager parts inside are plastic. For $100, I expected more. I can feel the pins on my heel and toes but I couldn’t feel the rotating balls in the middle of my foot.

There’s a heat setting, speed setting, and air compression setting. It did massage my feet, but I don’t think the massage benefitted my feet and it didn’t make a difference. Not a very strong massage at all but it was okay.

title: Beautiful and powerful
text: This dries my hair super fast. It’s hot, cold, or medium. Has different speeds too. It’s beautiful on the outside and works wonderfully. Very happy with this!!

title: Very well made and a must have for dry feet
text: Finally no more filing by hand! This WORKS. It’s basically a drill on steroids for your feet. It’s tough sandpaper that shaved away really dry cracker feet and calluses into smooth feet. Very happy with this, works in seconds!!

title: Works!
text:
This works well if you know how to use this. After you press the on button, press down firmly on the area of skin that has hair. Then while pressing down firmly, you twist the tool as if you’re trying to scoop up the hair.

The head of the tool has an inner blade to catch and pull the hairs by squeezing the hairs against the outer blade. It’s not painful, pretty quiet, and gets warm but not hot after using this. As you can see, it trimmed my fathers ear hairs very well.

It took a little time to figure out how to use it but once we got the method down, worked very well. I was able to trim my mustache area and unibrow area too. It’s a very sturdy trimmer and it comes with a usb charging cable.

Very happy with this product! Just have to click a button and go over the area and it works! Also works great for your nose hairs as well.

title: Great useful item.
text: No one can ever keep up with the little metal clips, the last ace bandage the metal teeth just bent right off the first attempt to use it so I gave up & ordered a box of these things to go with the other 30 ace bandages we don’t have clips for.

title: Portable WaterPik, Sonic Care Clone
text:
--Toothbrush

Toothbrush is as good as Sonic Care. Way better than manual toothbrush, get that dentist feeling clean if you’ve never used it before.

May have less options on strength and pulse variety depending on what version of Sonic Care you have.

Uses same head attachment as Sonic Care. Glad there’s no propriety brush head. Very easy to purchase more when you run out.

Charges on bottom via USB Type C. Cannot stand straight when charging. Must pull out rubber water resistant cover with pen or coin, and lay it on it’s side to charge.

--Water Flosser

Water flosser is like a portable WaterPik, but is bulky and not as natural to use. The orthodontic and tongue cleaner tips are a very nice addition.

Water pressure is a bit stronger than standard WaterPik head due to the small opening. Recommend you put it on Soft setting first

Head attachment is a bit loose compared to WaterPik. Wobbles when you touch it slightly.

Propriety head and charger. Have no idea why they didn’t go for USB Type C like for the toothbrush

Overall, very decent bundle. Toothbrush is very similar to Sonic Care brand but has odd charging method. Water flosser a bit strong, and must use propriety changing cable (careful not to lose it)

title: Includes Classical Music
text:
Sound quality is good.

Very nice tracks for white noise and nature sounds.

Includes classical/orchestral music which is a nice addition. Most white noise machine does not includes these. Tracks are shorty in length, but also loops. Wished it was longer

I like the wood accents behind the buttons

Buttons are easy to navigate. Some are indented for blind pressing

Light is very subtle and makes for a good nightlight. Solid color, no option to pulsate or auto cycle through automatically

Uses USB C which is much appreciated

title: Not Responsive, No tactile feedback
text:
Has touch sensitive buttons. Sometimes not responsive, or will not register inputs correctly and will do it's own thing

Sounds recording selections are very odd. Some tracks have duel tracks going at the same time and does not really meld well together.

There should have been more quality control on this product. Would not recommend

title: Shiny box, Thin Cardboard
text:
Very easy to assemble. Everything is basically all set up; just need to push open, and do some minor folding to secure top of box

Thin cardboard. Does have weight capacity. Wouldn't put anything heavy inside or it may slip out from the bottom

If you have parchment paper, can put cake or pie in it. Just hold it from the bottom and use tape just in case

Holographic exterior makes it good for formal events like prom, school dances, or weddings.

title: Wall Powered, Proprietary Plug
text:
Don't like how it's not battery powered. Seems odd seeing that's the trend these days.

Also has a proprietary wall plug. Plug is small so powerbrick/strip friendly at the ends.

Buttons are flush and not tactile. Can get some miss presses.

Some features require you to short press and hold

No individualized buttons for specific sound. Have to cycle through genre of sounds.

Has a great variety of sounds totaling 32 sounds

No visual indicator for the sounds selection, volume loop around, must play by ear.

I like how the speaker is facing upward and not on the bottom of the device

Muted light. Great night light, but not for reading

title: Extremely Compact
text:
Best to familiarize yourself with contents inside before an emergency happens so you don't skiffle around.

Everything is tightly packed, may be difficult to get some items without dumping it all out (especially in a panic).

Quality of items inside is decent. Not the best quality, but gets the job done until a replacement is needed.

Has a belt pass-through for those who like to carry on at all times

title: Line them up
text:
Double security. Will not slip out when shaken.

Do need to line up dot with hole to secure. if you slide in wrong way it will not push down all the way

Finger grove very ergonomic

Has raised dot matrix plastic bumps for blind, so you know which way is up

title: Vaseline clone?
text:
Very similar to Vaseline, but a little bit less moisture/oily.

When applied it works the same, but doesn't' last as long

Better as lip balm than large skin surface areas

Fragrance of Petroleum Jelly is more pronounced

Container is not transparent, not able to tell how much you have left from outward appearance

title: Soft Touch Buttons
text:
Don't like the soft touch buttons on this device. There no tactile feedback when using

Aside from that works as intended.

Sounds are good quality. Good selection

Must press the play button to activate the sounds. Don't get why you can't just press the sound option directly to turn it on. Must use two button press to activate

There is a timer option for 15,30,60,90 and 120min signaled by Asian Female AI voice with broken English.

Volume selection doesn't have same feature and have to play by ear. When reach max volume it does have a beep sound

Night light works well. Able to cycle through several colors.

I like how it uses USB plug instead of a wall outlet. Plug that goes into device is propriety though. Wished it was type C to type C to be more modernized.

Also would be great if it was battery powered. Seeing it's USB out, able to plug it into a power bank

title: Uneven Surface
text:
Beads insides are uneven. Feel unbalanced when wearing. Very bottom heavy

Has some weight to it to help with those who toss and turn a lot when sleeping. Still find myself taking it off subconsciously overnight

Mask is flat so can rub against eye lid

Product placement is large and in your face

Comes with nice clinch bag. Opening is very large and spacious, easy to slip store (no need to cram in)

title: Tethered to wall
text:
First thing to mention is that I think the controls should be inverted: very odd position from wall plug to mat itself. Find myself having the controls upside down most of the time. Not sure if it's meant for other person to control for you?

Works well, heats up fast.

Buttons are clicky, and easy to operate

Operation is very simple: on/off button, and heat button. Will auto turn off in 1.5 hours, no option to set specific time (30, 60,90,120mins for example)

Pad material itself is very soft to the touch

Cord is of decent length, but more for sedentary use than mobile use

title: Easy Setup, Lightweight
text:
[[VIDEOID:5636b84d70fd849b9721a2f324aa2d06]] Works as intended; keeps flies and other away from food

Easy to setup and put away. Pull string and hear clip sound to expand, push button the collapse

Portable and lightweight

Not fan/wind resistant. If strong enough gust comes it's way, can push against the plate/dish or blow away entirely

title: Zipper a bit finicky
text:
Large tote bag. May look like a man-purse if you're carrying around as a male.

Size around 9inches tall, 10 inches wide and 6 inches deep. Can go larger, but may not be able to zip up and keep insulated

For size comparison; able to fit 12 cans of 12oz soda, 4 laying down next each each other, stack of 3. Best to test out Tupperware dimensions before purchase to see if it fits.

Has two exterior pockets. Good for utensil and other items. May not fit long items like chopsticks or straws.

Would be great if there was a water bottle pocket on the side.

Handle is very firm. No padding. Optional non-padded shoulder strap.

Zipper is not a smooth transition, have to zip pass a threshold and/or pinch the fabric to get it moving

Nyon fabric is not water or stain resistant. Contents inside main compartment may be dry due to duel layer, but not much for stuff you put in exterior pockets.

Insulation is good. Keeps food warm or cold for a maybe 4+ hours.

title: Chewer's Paradise
text:
[[VIDEOID:d14d5432bbfd159d1716700475c92928]] Cubed-like Gum instead of a thin flat stick/square

Nice initial bite, gets right in the flow. Don't have to work in a consistent chew as much compared as the thin variety

You get a rush of mint flavor for the first few bites. Slowly dissipates thereafter, but last a very long time

Has two ways to dispense: 1 or 2 at a time or in bulk (if you want friends/family to hand pick the one they want off your hands)

No wrapper, may leave garbage or whatever you spit the gum in sticky.

Overall, very good gum. Long lasting and great for those who like to chew their gum for extended amounts of time

title: Very Concentrated
text:
A little (pinch) goes a long way, as the flavor is very strong even for the scoop it comes with. In fact it overpowers a fruit smoothie with even half a scoop

Has a very medicinal, bitter taste to it

Has a lot of good nutritional properties associated with it as it's considered a super food.

Good if you want Ashwagandha Root Powder in bulk vs pill/capsules

Comes in a re-sealable bag which is nice. Also transparent, so you know how much is left without opening up the bag

Overall, good health benefits. Just know it's hard to go down.

title: Fits like a glove (on your wrist)
text:
Very impressed on how the sleeve fits my wrist in comparison to size chart mentioned in the product description.

The material is very breathable and made with high quality fabric.

It's not too tight that it hinders mobility, and not too loose that it's not functional

title: These really didn't make much difference in my lab results. ......yet.  WATCH FOR UPDATE
text:
I took these for several months before writing this review. I recently did some blood work and, yes, my LDL cholesterol was down a little bit, along with the total cholesterol. The trouble is, I'm not sure it was these capsules that were responsible. I eat a mostly vegetarian diet. Very little meat, very little dairy.

Phyto(plant)Sterols are found in plants, of course. In grains, vegetables, fruit, legumes (peanuts), nuts and seeds. I eat all that regularly. I'm sure I get plenty of plant sterols. My total cholesterol and LDL do need to get a little lower though. Yes, even with my vegetarian diet. It's a genetic family thing.

I just consulted my go-to nutrition website "Nutrition Facts.org" Dr. Gregor discusses actual scientific studies with regard to thousands of nutrients and medical conditions. Studies show that plant sterols do lower lipids (cholesterol, triglycerides) when taken or eaten at the appropriate amount. His video indicated that 1 gram per day should lower cholesterol about 10%. I was taking the Swanson recommended amount of two capsules to get 0.8 gram per day. As I said, I did get a small result from that.

Dr. Gregor's video shows clearly that when taking 2 grams per day, you get the maximum benefit of cholesterol and triglyceride lowering effect. Over that, there is no more significant effect. I am now going to take 4 capsules per day to get 1.6 grams. This, along with my diet, should get me to 2 grams. I would not exceed the Swanson suggested dose without consulting a health professional. My personal doctor said there is no problem taking a little more, but do not go over 2 grams per day with the pills, since more doesn't help.

By the way, the highest sources of plant sterols are in seeds and nuts. Top of the list are sesame and sunflower seeds. I just ordered a two pack of Pepperwood Tahini sesame butter from Amazon. Sesame butter with a bit of honey on toast sounds good to me! Hey, let's talk sesame cookies too. I will do labs again in a couple months and update this review.

Mix two tablespoons of VCO and two tablespoons of baking soda until it forms a paste-like consistency to get the purest toothpaste for cleanest teeth without any additive. You need to do that only with baking soda that is consumable, this is not.

Great container than the cardboard box since I can place it right in my shower. Sodium bicarbonate is a mild alkaline compound that can help neutralize the PH balance of skin. This 'buffering effect' may help quell the inflammation that occurs at the skin's surface, easing soreness. Used topically, baking soda takes the sting out of sunburn and minimizes the itch and discomfort caused by a variety of skin conditions (including eczema, prickly heat, and poison ivy). To get relief, place a cup of baking soda under a running bath tap so it dissolves completely, and then soak in the water for about 30 minutes. For my daily use I just make a paste for rubbing on the skin just like any lotion. I even mix in a container with water and apply with a soft towel in the shower. For cleaning equal mix of Borax and baking soda bring happiness to any dishwasher and washing machine for clean smelling clothes with no perfume.

I use others for internal use including brushing, you need to do your own research. Any food ingredient should be contained and handled properly and accordingly and baking soda needs to be aluminum free for internal use. This is not a food container. Variously called sodium bicarbonate, baking soda, or simply 'bicarb', it's good to have a small tub of this in your travel bag. On holiday, exposure to chemicals such as the chlorine in the swimming pool can irritate the area where urine leaves the body (the urethra) and can trigger cystitis in women. Essentially, this is inflammation of the bladder and can lead to a burning sensation when you pass urine. There are other factors that can make it a common holiday ailment: heat and alcohol can dehydrate the body, making the bladder more prone to inflammation; `holding on' when it's inconvenient to go to the toilet, or facilities are unavailable, can also contribute. Bicarb is alkaline, so drinking half a teaspoon of bicarbonate of soda stirred into a glass of water several times a day helps as it makes urine less acidic and less likely to cause stinging. It won't reduce the inflammation in the bladder but it will reduce the pain while the inflammation goes down. For any medical issues seek medical advice.

title: A Slick But Frustrating Scale
text:
I wanted to love my Fitbit Aria, I really did. I was a Fitbit early adopter and have been loyally wearing a Fitbit of some sort for years now (currently a Charge HR) and though I logged weight data from a reliable scale every morning I was home, I was thrilled by the prospect of more data automatically integrated with my Fitbit account. I celebrated too soon. I am a computer literate user with two advanced degrees and after two days of struggling, I still cannot get the Aria set up completely. In my house it is now basically a nice looking dumb scale that has more variation between weighings than my reliable Soehnle and stridently refuses to sync.

The enclosed directions are laughable at best (especially if you are considering setting this up for multiple users), and unfortunately the online guidance is equally confusing and requires many steps (and occasional dead ends) that must be managed exactly correctly to get any results. Although this is a very attractive scale and had the potential to be a great product, I honestly don't care that much about the aesthetics of a bathroom scale: I just want it to do what it says it's supposed to and after the better part of two days trying to make this work correctly, I discovered I honestly don't care anymore.

For $130 you should expect better. I gave it two stars (generously), as it does weigh users apparently somewhat accurately (close to my other scale which has been very reliable), but setup is a nightmare and I don't recommend it based on that alone.

title: Good BP monitor, fairly easy to set up
text:
I like this automatic blood pressure monitor.

Pros:
–Fairly easy to set up, decently written instructions.
–Option to plug in with USB-C to USB-A cable (included) or to use 4 AAA batteries (also included, and yes, they work).
–Fully automatic. All you have to do is strap it on and push a button.
–Ability to save readings for 2 users.
–The readings will save with date and time.

Cons:
–It has the ability to read your results out loud (which is actually another pro), but the voice used sounds like it comes from someone who isn't a native English speaker. However, I still found it easy to understand the numbers.
–The carrying bag is a little small. I'm planning to use the box for storage.

Note that the "PA" setting is for turning on the reading in KPa. If you are in the U.S., you're likely used to measurements in mm Hg (such as 120/85). If that's the case with you, you can turn OFF the PA setting. However, if the PA setting is on, it will show the measurement in BOTH KPa and mm Hg.

Overall, a decent choice for an automatic BP machine. 4.5 stars rounded up to 5.

text:

Vitamin D3 is critical for staving off some really miserable conditions like depression, fatigue, obesity, alzheimers and skin problems. Studies have found that anywhere from 40% - 75% of people in the U.S. are deficient in D3. (Depending on which study you're looking at) I love this gummy form because it's so easy to take! I hate swallowing pills, so if I can get something in a gummy candy, I do it! This is an excellent vitamin to take, considering how beneficial it is and how common deficiencies are. I had a vitamin D3 deficiency and after taking a 5,000iu daily D3 supplement for only 2-3 weeks, (my doctors advice) I noticed a big improvement in my energy level and in the appearance of my skin.
If you have any of the conditions that I mentioned, such as frequent fatigue, your doctor can give you a blood test to find out what your blood levels are of D3, B vitamins and any others you suspect you may be deficient in. If you don't want or can't afford to go to a doctor, trying this D3 supplement is a safe and easy way to rule out a deficiency in this vitamin. If you take this and in two to three weeks you find that you have more energy, among other things -  you most likely had a D3 deficiency like roughly half the population does. Do a little research on dosages, because there are several factors that you need to take into consideration when you take D3 long-term. D3 is a fat-soluble vitamin, which means that it IS possible to get too much. It can become toxic and that can cause some problems. (Eg. Kidney stones, nausea) You need to consider how much sunlight you get, for instance - whether you use sunscreen, do you live in Alaska, or Arizona- things like that.
This is a very easy, inexpensive supplement to take and it can make an enormous difference in how you look and feel.

title: Keto friendly!
text:
I have been a long-time user of garcinia cambogia and absolutely love the results. I have been following a strict keto diet for a little over a year & started taking a similar supplement long before I began my journey. If you just do a quick search online, you’ll see that it has many benefits such as loss of appetite or desire to eat less than usual, reduced cravings for unhealthy foods, a more positive & uplifted mood (feeling happier, energetic, etc.), an increase in concentration and energy, stabilized sugar levels, improved bowel movements, and a reduction in joint pain. I can honestly say that this has helped in every single one of those areas. I love that this comes in a powder and is tasteless so you could pretty much mix it in anything. I would like to note that if you’re mixing it into something cold then you’ll want to use either a blending ball or a mixer. I did find that if mixed in little by little, it’ll blend nicely into cold water after giving it a good shake.

With all that being said, garcinia cambogia is not for everyone. Those who are diabetic and are taking medication for their condition, who have a history of liver or kidney damage, or those who are pregnant or breastfeeding should probably avoid this before speaking with your doctor.

I didn’t ever feel anything but positive side effects but everyone is different so you might want to try a little at a time before moving up to the recommended dosage.

Overall, I am 100% satisfied with this and look forward to purchasing more once it runs out.

title: NOT Keto/ diabetic friendly!!!
text:
I have been on keto for a year and six months now and was so excited to receive this until it got here and I read the ingredients. Unfortunately at the time of ordering this, the ingredient list was not available. Like many others, I assumed that it was pure coconut milk powder. It’s not. This contains “Organic maltodextrin”. Organic maltodextrin or not, it has maltodextrin. Like another reviewer, I was unable determine if the maltodextrin source is corn, tapioca, potato, or wheat.

Evidence has shown that maltodextrin can affect the balance of gut bacteria, which play an very important role in people's health. Maltodextrin has an even higher glycemic index than regular table sugar. Meaning that maltodextrin can cause a sharp increase/ spike in people's blood sugar shortly after they eat foods that contain it. This is not good for those with diabetes or someone who is doing the keto diet or sugar free diet.

HOWEVER, my fiancé eating habits are much different than mine so he was happy to try it and stated that the taste was pretty good & he seams to enjoy it. For that, I’ll give it 2 stars. He has been using it in his coffee successfully. He was unsuccessful with mixing it in cold water. It will clump if not mixed into hot water.

I will not be reordering. I definitely think the manufacture should choose a different natural sweetener if ever planning to market this to the keto, diabetic or low-carb community.

title: Good gummies, with two issues.
text:
I ordered these gummies based on their Raspberry Pomegranate flavor, 500 mg Apple Cider Vinegar dosage per gummy, and good brand name. They’re very similar in composition and shape to the other, more popular brand of ACV gummies.

Like the other brand, these Solgar ACV gummies contain the ‘mother’. The mother is the cloudy stuff you see at the bottom of a bottle of ACV, and the most important ingredient. That’s what actually contains the helpful enzymes and good bacteria known as probiotics.

I noticed right away that there was no protective outer seal around the top. Not a good start. When I popped off the top, there was a ‘seal’ on the top, but it was really just a piece of thin foam paper, and not actually glued to the top of the bottle like most actual seals on pills or vitamins.

The smell is good… it’s definitely raspberry, and while you can smell a little vinegar, it’s not overwhelming. The taste is good as well. There’s very little vinegar taste, but they’re not something you’ll want to nosh on for a treat.

But when I went to dump a couple into my hand, I noticed that they’re wet. For whatever reason, that really turned me off. I thought maybe I had received a bottle that was expired, but the date on the bottom says “EXP: 12/2022” so that’s not the problem.

When compared to the leading brand, Solgar ACV gummies are (at this time) a little less expensive. The Solgar ACV gummies each have 2g of sugars and 2g of carbs, while the others have 1g of sugars, but 3.5g of carbs. Since carbs generally break down into sugars, I’d call that a wash.

So the only negatives I have are the lack of real safety seals, and the moisture. Other than that, the taste and reported composition is good.

Hope this helps.
