title: Not Burpless; Horrible Taste
text:
Product: Built By Nature Omega 3 Fish Oil Supplement 3600mg High DHA & EPA Natural Fatty Acids, Pure and Tested Wild-Caught Fish, Triple Strength Brain, Heart, and Joint Support, Burpless Subtle Lemon Flavor, 60 Softgels

I really wanted to like these, and I had great hopes for them. Unfortunately, it didn’t work out that way.

First, these are NOT burpless. I was burping them up 1 out of 3 times taking them. That’s bad enough, but it is not an uncommon experience with fish oil supplements. The taste was just horrible, even for fish oil. Maybe it was the lemon flavoring, I don’t know. It was just worse than other fish oil I”ve burped up. I ended up not being able to finish the bottle, which is very unusual for me. I’ll usually go ahead with a moderately bad flavor. The expiration date for my bottle was good for about a year, so freshness shouldn’t have been the problem. This was with taking only 1 as a dose. I can’t imagine what it would have been like taking the recommended 3 per dose.

That 3 softgel dose is also higher than most fish oil supplements,which tend to be only 2. This means the bottle only lasts for 20 days, not a full month. It also means taking 3 large pills, which these are. I could swallow them, but they might be hard for anyone who has any difficulty swallowing pills.

The bottom line is these just didn’t work for me.

title: Good Set Of Bath Bombs For Quantity And Price
text:
This set of Flower Scented Bath Bombs (set of 16) is a nice set, especially for the number of bath bombs and the price ($19.99 May 2021). I use bath bombs almost everyday and tried many different brands with varying success. This set has enough positives that you can give it as a gift with confidence. They are definitely good for their price point and actually better than I expected.

They are pretty and have botanicals on the tops, although not as many as shown in the pictures. Still, they are pretty and I have no problem with them being displayed in the basket I keep on my bathroom countertop for easy access. They are on the large side, although not the largest I’ve used. This is good for me, since my tub is older and holds a fair amount of water. They are still able to give a relaxing bath.

They had a nice scent in the box. There are four different scents in the set. I can’t say I could identify the scent by just smelling them, but it is pleasant and definitely floral. The scent isn’t as strong once in the tub, but I do get a light fragrance during my bath. This is fine for me as I don’t like overwhelming scents.

They fizz okay and actually give a light layer of bubbles initially. The water color is nice. The colors are more muted than vibrant, but they are relaxing. I would say they are slightly above average for color and scent.

They do a fair job with moisturizing. I can feel the oils while in the tub, although the effect doesn’t last that long after the bath. They don’t make the tub too slippery. I’d give them 3+/4 in this area compared to other bath bombs I’ve used.

I haven’t had any problems with them staining or clean up after use.

I’m enjoying this set of bath bombs. It’s nice to have a set of 16. This isn’t typical to have this many, especially for bath bombs of this size.

title: Did A Pretty Good Job On My Bathtub
text:
I have an older porcelain bathtub that has become more and more difficult to clean as it has gotten older. It probably needs to be resurfaced, but I’m not looking to do that anytime soon. I’ve tried all kinds of cleaning products and just haven’t gotten the results I wanted, even with a whole lot of elbow grease. While researching cleaning these older tubs, I consistently found peroxide was the recommended cleaner. So, I got GreenFist’s Hydrogen Peroxide All Purpose Cleaner Spray 32 oz (2 pack) as another attempt to clean the bathtub.

I like the idea of a more natural cleaner than the hasher cleaners (some of which I have tried). I sprayed the tub down really well and took the electric scrubber to it. While it didn’t handle all the stains, it did clean the tub better than anything else I’ve tried so far. Bonus, I didn’t need a nap afterwards from herculean scrubbing efforts.

The scent is fairly mild and has a somewhat citrus smell. It’s doesn’t leave a strong “fresh” scent like some cleaners, but I’m fine with that. The bathroom is small and I have to close the door when cleaning to keep the kitty from helping. Many cleaners can be overwhelming in the smaller, closed space.

I didn’t see an expiration date on the bottles. It’s my understanding that hydrogen peroxide degrades, particularly after opening the bottle. I have no way of knowing how “fresh” this is or how long the effectiveness will last. I was also surprised to see it in a clear bottle, as I always thought it came to opaque bottles to help preserve it. Maybe this is different from medical grade peroxide? I suppose I will just continue to use it as long as it is being effective.

I’m happy with the results for this product and will be trying it on other areas in the house.

title: Average Bath Bombs Best For Kids
text:
I use a bath bomb almost every day, so I’ve used many different brands. There are certain things I look for in the bath bombs I really like, though I don’t consider myself a bath bomb snob. There are just certain things I want from my bath bomb as an adult. For me, YULONG Lab’s 18 Pcs Bath Bomb Gift Set with Natural Essential Oils rates as an average bath bomb. I feel they are best for kids or just daily bath treatment for an adult who isn’t wanting that luxurious bath time.

These bath bombs are small in size. Now, that doesn’t mean they are necessarily not a good bath bomb. I’ve used small sized bath bombs that were actually quite nice. Unfortunately, that wasn’t the case with these. I have a large tub, so I will probably end up using two at a time, which it means I’m only going to get nine bath uses from the set.

The areas where I was disappointed with this set were fragrance and water color. There just wasn’t much fragrance to them, even in the box before they went into the water. I don’t like an overwhelming scent, but I do like more than I got with these. The second area was the water color. One bath bomb barely colored the water.

The packaging and the bath bombs themselves are pretty. They also fizzed...well they actually gave more bubbles than fizz. They actually did pretty good with the bubbles. They also made my skin nice and soft. They also didn’t stain the tub and cleaned up easily.

Overall, I’d have to say that these are average bath bombs. They have come down on the price (currently $19.99) which is more reflective of the type/quality of bath bombs. If you are looking for a luxury bath bomb, these aren’t the ones for you. But as a basic bath bomb, they hit the mark. There is certainly a place for this type of bath bomb. I would possibly gift these in certain situations.

title: Thick Consistency, Not Much Lather
text:
Spotlight Oral Care Toothpaste for Total Care is packaged and priced like a higher end toothpaste, so I thought I would give it a try. Maybe I’m just used to toothpastes like Colgate, but this toothpaste has a strangeness factor to it that I haven’t adjusted to yet. I don’t hate it, but I don’t love it either.

The first thing I noticed is that it is thicker than any toothpaste I’ve ever used. I have to work at it to get just a little out of the tube onto my toothbrush. The consistency is somewhere between toothpaste and caulking. The second thing I noticed is that it doesn’t suds or lather much at all. I’ve never experienced that before. I wondered how well it could be cleaning without hardly any sudsing. If you are a messy brusher, this might be a plus. The third thing is the flavor. When they say mint flavor, they mean mint. I get the mint tingle through my whole mouth and lips. I’m talking about the Blistex tingle, not a mild tingle. It’s a bit too much for my tastes.

All that said, when I do finish with my rather unique brushing experience, my teeth do feel very clean, more so than with my regular toothpaste. The clean feeling also lasts longer. I do think this toothpaste is overpriced for one that doesn’t contain whiteners. It’s ingredients are aimed at cavity prevention and plaque buildup, which are basic toothpaste functions. While it seems to work at cleaning my teeth, I don’t think I would get this again.

title: Could Use Improvements In Some Areas
text:
I use a lot of bath bombs, almost everyday. I have to admit that I am a bit picky about them and look at several different areas. Lyskiycyn’s Handcraft Bath Bombs（XXL-5.7oz) ended up being about average for me. While they were okay in some areas, there were other areas they could use some improvement.

Presentation: The box itself is slightly above average. It’s fairly sturdy. The presentation of the bath bombs inside the box was nice. Aside from the ball bath bombs there are a couple different shapes, including a large heart with the word “Love” on it, that make the set a bit unique. The ball bath bombs had botanicals embedded on the top, which is always a nice touch. There were also several silk (?) flowers, which is definitely different. It was a pretty touch, although I’m not sure what I’m supposed to do with them. They do smell nice, so maybe use like a potpourri. Several of the bath bombs had areas that were crumbled however. The petals fell off some of the flowers while removing them from the box. For my own personal use, those aren’t really big deals, but it does drop the product down as something I’d want to use as a gift.

Scent: There is a nice scent when opening the box. The scent of the bath bomb in the water is only a fair plus. I can smell it, but just barely. The scents of all the bath bombs together nicely. I keep a basket on my countertop filled with bath bombs to use, so that’s important for me. They keep my bathroom smelling nice and fresh. I’d give them a fair for scent.

Fizz/Bubbles: These bath bombs leaned more towards bubbles than fizz. They do fizz, but the bubbles are more obvious and hide the fizz while they are dissolving. The bubbles didn’t last long past the bath bomb dissolving. I’d give them a fair plus on this one.

Moisturizing: This is a key area for me. The moisturizing effect was on the light side. I could tell there was an additive in the water, but I didn’t leave my bath feeling my skin was really soft and smooth. I got more good skin benefits from the soap I used. I’d give them a fair minus in this area.

Water Color: This is the least favorable area for these bath bombs. The water barely changed colors. I did not get pretty, relaxing colors for my bath water. I’d give them a poor in this area.

Clean Up: They did very well in this area. Cleaning the tub was a breeze. They didn’t leave the tub slippery or slick. They also didn’t stain the tub. Yes, I have had some bath bombs stain the tub, so this a potential big deal for me. I’d give them a good in this area.

Price: When I got these bath bombs, they were selling for $12.99. The current price, when writing this review, is $20.99. I feel the price of when I got them is more reflective of the quality of these bath bombs. At the current price, I’d be pretty disappointed since my expectations would be higher.

This is an average set of bath bombs that are probably more appropriate for children (except not really child themed) or teenagers. It proves that bigger isn’t always better.

title: Love This Sound Machine, Nightlight Combo
text:
I got the Swonuk Sound Machine with Night Light to replace my other sound machine that was getting finicky in its operation. I can’t sleep without white noise and my other machine would periodically suddenly stop, instantly waking me up.

Different people who use sound machines need different sounds. This sound machine has a lot of different sounds, so there should be a sound that works for most people. There are even three musical lullabies for babies. The volume has a good range and actually can be set quite loud. The machine will remember the last setting from the last use. I usually takes me a couple of nights to adjust to the differences in the sound with a new machine. For some reason, that was not the case with this machine.

It is also a night light with vivid colors that aren’t too bright. There is a dim and brighter setting for the white light. You can also have it automatically cycle through the colors. I use it when I have to get up in the middle of the night. I also use the colored lighting at times before I go to bed just for relaxation.

I always bring my sound machine with me when I travel. This machine is more compact than my previous machine and will travel well. Hopefully, that will be happening again soon.

The only issue I have with the unit is the controls are touch sensitive. There are no button or even raised areas to the ring with the controls. It’s very easy to brush up against the wrong control. It’s even harder at night if you are wanting to control the machine. I’ve hit the volume up when I was wanting to turn on the night light. Considering how loud the machine can get, it is quite jarring in the middle of the night.

Even with that, I have been unexpectedly happy with this sound machine. I guess I was expecting something “less” and it’s nice to be surprised in the positive direction.

title: Wonderful Fragrance

title: Safer For Pipes Than Chemical Clog Removers
text:
I’ve read and been told by numerous plumbers not to use chemical products to unclog pipes as they can cause damage to the pipes over time. We have an older house with metal pipes and they clog frequently since they are now rough on the inside and hold gunk. After having plumbers come out to snake different pipes several times, we heard and tried Green Gobbler, as an enzymatic cleaner, with some success. When I came across the Eco Strong Enzyme Drain Cleaner (2 oz bottle x 5), I decided to try them and compare. The small bottle option is a nice buying option to be able to try and product to see how it works for you. The pricing ends up being comparable to the Green Gobbler 2 application bottle.

I’ll start by saying that it does seem to have worked after one application on a slow running bathtub. It wasn’t completely stopped up, but was starting to run slow. This is a place we’ve had trouble with in the past for different reasons, but I thought I’d try to nip the problem before things got worse.

What I like about this product:
* It has a nice scent, but isn’t overwhelming. There is no harsh chemical smell.
* It’s really easy to use. You just shake the bottle well and pour it down the drain. I did make sure I wiped around the drain for any product that may have splashed since we have a cat that gets in the tub. That’s it, just don’t use the drain for at least a couple of hours but preferably overnight. Unlike Green Gobbler, you don’t have to flush with hot water after the treatment. I liked not having that extra step.
* It’s made in the United States

What I didn’t like about the product:
* It wasn’t clear to me from the product description, but they recommend treating three consecutive days. If there are no problems, then once a month maintenance. This means with the 5 bottles you’ll get one clogged drain use from the package and two maintenance treatments. I thought I’d get five clogged drain treatments from the package. I saw better flow after one treatment and will probably just do the one unless I start seeing decreased flow again soon.
* The product does not have a child proof lid or safety seal. I was pretty surprised by that. I don’t have kids in the house, but if you do, you’ll need to store it safely. As soon as you open a lid, the liquid is exposed, so just take care. You really don’t want to get it on your skin.

I really like the idea of using an enzymatic product to unclog the drains. This one seems to work pretty well. I can’t speak to how well it would work on a fully clogged drain, and it probably depends on what is actually clogging the drain. I found it a bit more convenient than Green Gobbler. I do hope they become more safety conscious with their packaging.

title: One Of My New Favorite Bath Bombs
text:
I love my bath bombs and am always trying new additives for my long soak baths. I absolutely love these bath bombs and I’m pretty picky.

Size: They are large at 4.5 oz each. Bigger isn’t always better, but since my tub is large I’ve had better luck with bigger ones. These offer plenty of the good stuff for all the water my tub holds.

Water Color: These add great color to the water depending on the bath bomb. The colors are rich and pleasing to the eye. They don’t stain the tub or washcloth.

Fragrance: Each bath bomb is a different scent. All of the ones I’ve used so far have smelled very nice without being overpowering.

Moisturizing: These bath bombs left my skin feeling smooth and nourished. I could definitely feel the essential oils. Oh, so very nice.

Fizz: They had lots of fizz that lasted for a few minutes. I even got a bit of a bubble from them.

Clean Up: There’s not a lot of clean up with these. They didn’t leave the tub slick or slippery.

Aesthetics: This is a very beautiful set, suitable for gifting. The box is heavy with an elegant design. There is the issue of a typo on the front of the box and hopefully that will be corrected with their next box production. Each bath bomb is double wrapped. The outer layer is tissue paper with a sticker and the inner layer is the shrink wrapped plastic. The bath bombs themselves are swirled multi-colored.

I’m very pleased with these bath bombs as they hit the mark with all the areas I look for. They make for a very relaxing, pleasant bath experience.

title: Enjoyed These Bath Bombs
text:
I love my long soaks in the tub and like using an additive for a more relaxing bath. There a few must haves with my bath bombs. These hit most of those requirements.

Fizz Factor: They had pretty good bubbly fizz when dissolving. They dissolved pretty quickly.

Enough Bomb: I have an older tub which holds more water, so the bomb needs to be big enough not to become too diluted. These were a good size at 4 oz each and filled up the palm of my hand. There was plenty of the bomb for my full tub.

Scent: The scent was average to me on these. I could definitely smell them and the fragrance lasted through my entire bath, but was not overwhelming. They just didn’t smell exactly like I expected for the stated scent. It wasn’t unpleasant, just not quite the smell I thought it would be.

Water Color: These added a nice, pretty color to the water without leaving any kind of stains. They were relaxing.

Moisturizing: I could definitely feel the essential oils and shea butter in my water. It felt nice on my skin without being just greasy. My skin was softer after using these.

Clean Up: There wasn’t a lot of clean up after using these. I don’t want to have to do a bunch of tub cleaning after my relaxing soak and I didn’t have to. They did not leave the tub slippery either.

They come in a sturdy box, but it isn’t particularly decorative. The bombs are double wrapped: tissue paper with an identifying sticker on the outside and plastic shrink wrap underneath. They were intact and not crumbled. There were no ingredients on the packaging which seemed a bit strange.

This is a nice set of above average bath bombs. I felt they were a bit on the pricey side coming in at around $3.80/bomb. They could be used as a gift set, just not a higher end gift. Overall, I was satisfied with these for my own personal use.

title: Packaging failure from start to finish, also not at all 'berry lemonade' flavored
text:
Look at the first two photos, there lies the failure this was from the get-go. I've learned that there's a very good set of reasons why this stuff comes in packets and not containers.

The first photo is what I wish it looked like, and hopefully that's new packaging. Because what I got is the second photo. A very tall, very narrow tube. Which creates a problem of how does someone scoop from it when half the product is gone? There's also a dry silica pack inside the package, which due to the fineness of the product tells me that even a little moisture in the can is a problem.

You'll need a razor to cut off the plastic film that covers the container, which again is needed because the product is exceedingly finely textured.

The solution to that initial packaging mistake is a very long and tiny scoop, which after removing it and getting the product ALL over your hands (its electrostatic and clings like fine corn starch), you have to put it back in handle first before you can close it. So you'll have to wash the stuff off your hands again the next time you use it.

title: Contains maltodextrin, source unlisted, no contact info for company
text:
At the time I ordered this, no info was available on Amazon regarding the ingredients and I assumed that this was pure coconut milk powder. It’s not. It’s got maltodextrin for a filler, which is problematic two ways: 1) it means you have to use more of this to get any coconut flavor – meaning this package does not make much coconut milk at all – and 2) there’s no info on the source of the maltodextrin.

The labels on the product and the info on the website differ and maltodextrin can come from many sources. At the time of this review, there is no contact information for the company on the package or on Amazon, I can’t find any info via Google, and therefore, I cannot determine if the maltodextrin source is corn (the most common), tapioca, potato, wheat, or whatever. While the website would seem to indicate that the source might be coconut, that could be referring to the coconut milk part of the ingredients, and in all my years of reading labels, I’ve never seen coconut as a source of maltodextrin, so again, I have to wonder if that’s what’s being said.

It would be nice if the maltodextrin source were listed on the label. Since corn starch is why a certain child unit carries an Epipen and multiple family members have celiac disease, that makes this product useless for my family even if it made a reasonable amount of coconut milk.

text:
This was recommended by a optician to help get rid of calcium on my lenses. For the first 1/2 bottle it worked great. Then I started to notice the disc at the bottom of the container wasn't reacting to the solution as much as before, but i didn't think anything of it... UNTIL I woke up one morning and put one contact in - MY EYE STARTED BURNING! They had been soaking for over 10 hours. Even after taking it out and flushing my eye with saline, it ruined my morning as my eye became red and highly sensitive to light for several hours. You know that feeling you get when a contact tears and scratches your eye? It was worse). This started to happen more frequently. I threw the 2nd bottle and the cup away after the 3rd time.

This is a great product in concept. The chemical reaction does help clean the contacts. However, I think Alcon may have went a bit cheap on the discs in the cup. Which is disappointing when it's critical that all the hydrogen peroxide (or whatever it is) is neutralized in 6 hours, or you will burn your eyes. I've now stopped using Alcon products completely.

title: Okay, but could be better
text:
I purchased these to power a Minolta SRT-101, which takes an increasingly hard to find PX625 (or equivalent) battery. The original PX625 batteries used mercury and are no longer available in the US. Duracell once manufactured a 625A cell that was a perfect fit, and despite being a slightly different voltage (1.5V vs. 1.35V) worked great... but it's difficult to find too.

So I thought I'd give these little units a try. The battery itself is a zinc-air battery that seems more stable and long-lived than the Duracell batteries were. However they are physically adapted to the PX625 form-factor by use of a metal ring that the battery sits in. This ring seems fairly cheaply manufactured, and of the three batteries I got, one was unusable (the ring would not sit level on the battery), and one appears to be usable, but required me to "reset" the ring to its proper position. The third (still in its package) looks to be correctly aligned, but I won't know for sure until I use it whether it has any problems.

All that said, these accomplish the goal of powering my aging SRT-101 and at a pretty reasonable cost.

title: Both regular and chocolate peanut butters taste great, but packaging isn't great
text:
These are small packets of peanut butter, date paste, coconut oil and salt. The chocolate flavor adds cocoa powder and Stevia. Both taste great, but the ingredients separate so the packets have to be kneaded to re-mix the ingredients. Unfortunately, the packet seals aren't the best so you may end up with a bit of ooze from somewhere, anywhere along the seam. This happened to me with 2 out of 10 packets.

Part of the problem is likely the date paste. It "needs" a lot more kneading to re-incorporate and it's thick so perhaps I am more vigorous with these than with other similar products without dates. But the dates really do add a wonderful sweetness and more complex flavor than other plain nut butters.

These are convenient for packing into a pocket or backpack (make sure to include wet-wipes in case the seams break) for a quick, healthy snack. But they are very expensive for just over 1oz of peanut butter. Justin's makes a similar product (I haven't tried it) that is about half the cost-per-pouch for the same size, if cost is an issue to you (no date paste though). I can tolerate the cost, but not the leakage.

title: Painful
text:
Essentially this is a $300+ hearing aid (at the time of this review). I have difficulty with high pitched sounds (this from someone who once had perfect pitch hearing). As a listening device it amplifies EVERYTHING without any sort of filtering. So the high pitched sounds were magnified painfully without clarity. On top of that everything sounded far away and hollow (yet loud) almost like listening through a tin bucket (for those old enough to remember it's similar to mono than hi-fi speakers). The background noise made this useless as a basic listening device.

There are four settings in what seems to be a fixed equalizer (a fully adjustable equalizer would have allowed more personal customization). So for instance, the #1 setting amplifies the high range down through the #4 setting which brings out the base. The middle two settings seem fairly balanced with leanings toward the upper and lower settings.

The volume control works as expected.

The relaxing sounds were nice but the waves are on an annoying loop that doesn't loop. There is definitely a starting and ending point to the track.

I didn't have trouble hooking it to the TV. It worked but the nature of the sound changed (see above) but then again TV's and other electronic devices can be tweaked for preferred sound. Maybe the problem is that this device does not come with the digital cables (the can be purchased separately). So my TV was outputting analog sound which is a serious step down from digital sound (think two cans on a string vs dolby/thx sound).

The cradle comes with an open slot, which I assume can be used to charge a second receiver.

Maybe there is something I'm not understanding but this is a simple amplification device. The sound is not clear and certainty not natural (to me). Maybe my problem is that I'm remembering (or think I'm remembering) the fine tuning my ears used to have and this definitely does not restore any of that distinction or clarity.

title: Can’t replace my Weimans! But it smells fresh & clean ....
text:
Update: I don’t know if it’s the humidity this summer, or this Method Stainless Cleaner breaks down after a time, but last night when I cleaned my stainless, I could absolutely NOT get the streaks out - my stainless looked streaky and terrible—I tried buffing it out. Perhaps I used the wrong kind of cloth or...? I don’t have a clue what would be different this time but I had to go over my stainless with my Weiman’s and that finally did the trick. I do use this cleaner for other things, since it has a pleasant scent, but I’m sticking to my tried and true Weiman’s Stainless Cleaner for all my stainless.
——————
Original review:
Weiman’s Stainless Steel Cleaner—it’s been my go-to stainless cleaner for years and it works beautifully, but it does have a strong chemical scent. However, Weiman’s always cleans my stainless and leaves it streak free. Method is a bit of mixed results on my stainless, but I like it for other jobs around the house - like my stovetop.

What I really love is the light apple-scent; the scent is subtle but fresh and pleasing: yay! I tried it on my refrigerator and did just as the instructions said: sprayed a bit on a cloth, wiped it onto my stainless, then buffed it with a soft dry cloth: voila! It worked and no harsh chemicals! The bottles look just as they do in the image so I didn’t snap a photo. (But see update....)

I also used some on my stovetop and that made it look sparkly clean. I then went around my kitchen trying it out on my countertops, my wood table, and around the sink - my kitchen was filled with a nice subtle apple-inspired scent and everything look sparkly clean without smudges.

You do have to buff the stainless with the dry soft cloth to achieve the right effect or else it’ll looked smudged; however, with my other kitchen things like the wood and countertop, etc, I didn’t buff it and instead just used it as a regular cleaner and it did just fine.

At around $6.00 for each, the price is reasonable and about what the Weiman’s costs on Amazon, or maybe a little less. I like that it’s a more natural method to cleaning. I don’t think it will replace my Weiman’s for stainless but I’m pleasantly surprised at how much I do like the Method cleaner. I’ll try more of their products.

Update: I let a friend use this who had a lot of dryness, redness, and "aging" around their eyes - they reported back to me that they couldn't believe how much a difference this product made--skin softer, less noticeable lines, and the redness/dryness went away. They're sold - in fact, I'll have to purchase some more for me since I don't think I'll be able to pry that jar out of their hands!

text:
This product is a blessing for gastric bypass patients. One full bottle at 160 calories packs a powerful 40 grams of protein. It is a delicious way to get 2/3 of your daily protein requirement. title: Like having a dentist in my house.
text:
I've had problems with my teeth since they first came in. My birth mother got no prenatal care, no vitamins, less than adequate nutrition for a woman who's not pregnant to begin with and ingested various chemicals that were not good for me, her fetus. I was neglected terribly. Long story short, I was a sick baby who spent about 3 years on antibiotics. Between the effects of no calcium in vivo and antibiotics, my teeth have always been prone to problems...add to this the fact that I was diagnosed with MS 6 years ago and have been on meds that cause dry mouth ever since, dry mouth causing extreme problems with decay, etc. ...so, toothpaste and tooth care and I go way back.
I was curious about this and received a coupon, so I went for it. The first usage I put on the same amount of gel as I usually do with other products. ....it turns out that was WAY too much. You need about a large pea size amount.
The minute you put it in your mouth and start brushing, it explodes into foam. It's kind of startling at first. You may find you need to spit a bit of extra foam out time to time. But, it tastes great and feels interesting with all the foaming. After I'm done, I spit and rinse as usual....and run my tongue over my teeth giggling. It was like I'd just gotten out of the dentist's chair! It was amazing! I'm still surprised every time I use it how well it works. My dentist even asked me what I've been using because my teeth are looking better.
It's a little more expensive, but a little goes a long way, and you're saving money at the dentist!
It comes in several nice flavors, in sensitivity formulation, whitening and a pro enamel version that help keep your enamel from wearing away.
This Aquafresh and my prescription fluoride gel are the only things that touch my teeth anymore. My hubby adores it too, and my 7 year old thinks it's hilarious to get all that foam in his mouth, so it encourages him to brush. Who could ask for more?

title: Need an Upgrade
text:
Pros: Definitely excellent for sensitive gum. It does clean the teeth very well if you take the time to brush.

Cons: The bristles are densely packed together so toothpaste will get stuck and accumulate on the bottom. Eventually, it will cause the brush to lost its shape as you can see in the photo (I use charcoal toothpaste so that's why it's black). And because it is very soft, it will not clean the tongue. You will need a regular brush for that, so that makes it very inconvenient.

Within two months, I'm already on the second brush. The 1st brush, I used it directly with the toothpaste so the issue was even worst than the photo shown. The 2nd brush, I use a regular brush to make the toothpaste foam first and then use this brush. It does help reducing the issue, but still not a great solution in the long term. At this rate, I'm going through with brush more than necessary.

Suggestion:
- Spread out the bristles, reduce the bristle amount if necessary.
- On the end of the handle, make a short brush or scrapper for the tongue. 2 in 1, win win solution.

title: First Pain Free Steps in 4 Years
text: I am not a verified purchaser as I bought the smart insoles directly off Actipatch's website.  I've been suffering from plantar fasciitis since 2013.  Getting out of bed, the first steps are so painful.  I  received the insoles yesterday and immediately put them in my shoes.  At bedtime, I slide them into the sock.  This morning I was pain free.  I couldn't believe it.  First pain free steps in four years.  I did a lot of walking today (I forgot to put the insoles back into my shoes) and the pain returned late in the day.  This was after 5,000 steps according to my fitbit.  However, the pain is at a lower level than I've been experiencing.  I will sleep with the insoles in the sock again tonight.  I might update this post to let you know after I've used the insoles for two weeks.  I would suggest to the manufacturer to add an on/off switch like is built into the knee pain device.  I don't plan on keeping the insoles on my feet 24 hours per day for 15 days.  Also, my pain runs the full length of my foot, so I'd recommend a full insole be offered, not just the heal.  Even with these two improvements I'd like to see in a future model, I give it 5-Stars because I was able to walk pain free for most of the day.

title: Great product. But I question the claims about ACV in general
text:
I'm giving Bragg's 5 stars because this is truly a quality product. I never have to think twice before buying Bragg's and the same is true for their apple cider vinegar (ACV). So my problem isn't with Bragg's, or even ACV itself, but rather with the miracle-working powers ascribed to ACV. After having tried it, and reading many of the reviews, I'm seriously wondering whether I'm just the most unlucky, unloved person in the world. Let me explain.

I tried drinking ACV "shots" a couple of months ago (yes; it was Bragg's), hoping to lose a few pounds. One tablespoon in the morning, with lemon juice. I'll spare you a diatribe about the taste, etc. The only effect I experienced was that almost immediately my nails became much harder. I already had strong, healthy nails, so this wasn't a needed effect. Despite being so hard they seemed to break more easily. I suspected they just weren't as flexible; the slightest accidental move and they would simply snap. Not a problem; my nails grow quickly anyway. After a couple of weeks I just sort of gave up on it. If my system became more alkaline and therefore more resistant to disease, I didn't know it.

Fast forward a few months. I visit my sister and mother who have taken up drinking ACV with water everyday and swear it's helping them lose weight. I could see my sister's girth was about 50% reduced from the last time I'd seen her and even my normally cautious mother was swearing she now fits easily into clothing she couldn't before. Naturally, I returned home determined to glean these same benefits for myself. I reasoned that I probably hadn't been taking enough of the ACV before and that's why I'd seen no effects. I immediately embarked on a regimen of 2 tablespoons a day - one in the morning, one in the evening - in a full glass of water, and waited eagerly for the pounds to begin melting off, like so many others had experienced. Here's what did happen:

- Though I've been sleeping well I have been tired all the time. As in, I sleep 10, 13, 16 hours, and am still perpetually tired. I've looked for other things to blame it on, but can't come up with an explanation that seems logical. I certainly did not experience the bursts of energy reported by many.

- Uber-strong nails again! Completely unnecessary, but what the heck.

- I seem to have a perpetual, mild sore throat, and I sneeze everyday, even though I do not have a cold.

- The weather here in Seattle turns my hair into straw and though I tried valiantly, I never found any product or method to remedy this. Out of sheer desperation one night I added it to my spray bottle and sprayed it in my hair. To my surprise, it made my hair soft and full of body. It's been great. I will keep using it this way because for once I don't look like a Fraggle.

- I think my skin looks so much nicer. In fact, about a week into it, a complete stranger walked across a restaurant just to tell me how beautiful my skin was. I would totally keep taking just for this effect, if I could (read on).

- As a runner, I typically run between 6 and 12 miles at a time. In the first couple of days after starting the ACV, I found myself struggling to make it to 3. My muscles just seemed like they couldn't handle it. And they ached in a way I had never experienced before. I did some vigilante doctoring and determined that the ACV had probably depleted my potassium resulting in significant muscle weakness. So I picked up a bottle of potassium tablets and away I went. I did much better having added the potassium, but if I forgot to take one I couldn't run. Plus it obviously wasn't a real fix; two days ago I ended up running 2.5 miles back home with muscle cramps in my right leg, another thing I'd never had to deal with before. I suspected ACV, and decided it wasn't worth it. But I read some more reviews and thought maybe I just needed to give it more time.

So did I lose weight? Nope. I've gained 4 lbs in the week and a half I've been drinking ACV, though I'm careful about what and how much I'm eating. As of my last weigh-in this morning, I've decided it's time to quit ACV. The hundreds of reviews were compelling but, given my experience, I wonder whether the weight loss people experienced was more a result of them drinking more water, rather than an effect of the ACV itself. It's conventional wisdom that drinking water, especially before meals, helps reduce the amount a person would consume, leading to weight loss. I could be wrong, and probably am, since I'm completely outnumbered, but it doesn't make sense to me otherwise. Since the ACV was the only significant change I've made before experiencing these symptoms, common sense tells me it's likely the cause of them, so I will stop. And I will probably always wonder why it worked wonders for everyone else but me.

title: A little loud but WOW-great pump!
text: I LOVE this pump! Yes, it is louder that most other pumps. But I will gladly trade a loud pump for the comfort! It is so comfortable and there is NO pain or tenderness after pumping. And even though the instructions warned me of an adjustment period for volume pumped, I had no problems or adjustment issues. The first time I used it I pumped 4+ oz off each side in about 5 minutes-which is a little more than what I had produced with the other pumps. I had pumped for my last two kiddos (one exclusive pumper and one half nurse/half pumped) with the Medela Pump In Style Advanced. I liked that I had a great supply with it but pumping was always a bit of a chore and never completely comfortable. With our newest addition, she arrived early like her sisters and I needed to pump more than I really wanted. When my Medela pump died unexpectedly and the pump was over five years old, there was nothing Medela could do. I decided to take a chance on this pump partially because of the price (so much cheaper than replacing my Medela-my insurance will only cover a double electric if my kiddo is readmitted) and partially because I was really interested in this new style of pumping. I am so GLAD I did! I will be telling every new mom I know about this pump because it is awesome!

title: Much better than using your fingers!
text:
These are very well-made, sturdy little pill poppers. I have nine cats, who all hate taking medicines more than a petulant toddler. The only way I can get a dewormer pill into any of them is with one of these gadgets. Even still, I have to break pills in half and shove the pill (in the tip of this syringe) all the way into their throat to get them to swallow. It's all about speed and finesse. You place the pill in the end of the syringe, and make sure the plunger is right up next to it, so that a very light push will eject the pill when you get it in position. You force their mouth open by pinching their cheeks, inserting your thumb gently on one side of their mouth (while they are attempting to bite you) and put the syringe into the very back of their throat, past the tongue but don't push it against the soft palate, just get it into the throat, push the pill out, then quickly remove your thumb and hold their mouth closed for about five seconds to ensure they've swallowed. It's an unpleasant task at best, and a downright agonizing one with some animals. But it's sometimes the ONLY way you can get medicine into your feline friends.

These syringe tips are made from soft, pliable material that bends and will not scrape or tear the delicate lining of your pet's mouth or throat. If you are careful, gentle, but yet firm, you can accomplish those pesky medication tasks without too much fuss. It is a lot harder to give a cat a pill with your fingers than with using one of these, so if you have a cat who likes to spit out her pills, or attempts to gnaw your fingers off when you try to give them anything, try these, because they make your job much easier.

I did receive this product free to try in exchange for sharing my review, and I am glad I got them, because I need to keep them on hand because of my large indoor AND outdoor cat population. I would recommend these syringes to anyone with cats, finicky or not, just to make the job of medicating easier and less stressful for both humans and kitties.

title: It's okay, but prefer more info on the label
text:
I have tried a lot of different joint supplements in my time, and some of them are better than others. This seems like an okay joint supplement, but the only thing I do not really like is that it does not give you exact numbers on the "proprietary blend" of glucosamine, chondroitin, and MSM. I can see that it has all three, along with a few other things, but it just gives you a base number (2,189 mg) for the blend of different joint care supplements. I would like to know exact amounts of what I am taking, in order to compare it with other brands that I have tried. I can not make an educated comparison when I do not have all the information I need.

That being said, it seems to work about as well as the brand I am used to, but I have not been taking it long enough to know if there is any long-term differences. If you are like me, and take glucosamine supplements every day, you know that it takes a while to have enough in your system to work effectively. I need to continue taking this brand for the rest of the month to be certain it works as well as others, so I can update my review next month with my longer-term results.

Short term, this joint supplement is still keeping me limber and in less pain than if I did NOT take it. I do notice it when I forget to take a glucosamine supplement the day after. I wake up much more sore and achy than I would otherwise, and that is my reminder that I must have forgotten a daily dosage. I will keep taking this one until it runs out, and if there are any significant changes, I will report them in a follow up update to this review. At this point, I am still in trial phase, and am not sure if I like it as much as the one that lists all the ingredients and their amounts better than this one does.

I received this product free in exchange for an unbiased, honest review, and I hope that I have provided as much. I try to be fully forthcoming in all my reviews, even if it is something I get at a discount or at no cost, because I value Amazon reviews very much for all my own purchases. If I have a reason to revise this review later on, I will happily do so. Right now, I would say I like it all right, but there are some things about it that could be improved upon.

title: Misleading Scent Description
text: The scent notes in this detergent are listed as cedarwood, oakmoss, and amber, yet there is only one dominant scent you will discern upon removing your clothes from the dryer. Unfortunately, that scent is patchouli. If you are a fan of patchouli, you will love this product, but if you detest it, as I do, you will not be happy with it. The good news is that the scent is very light. I did a small load of laundry and used 8 pumps of detergent. This was the maximum recommended number of pumps, so it is unfortunate that the product doesn’t deliver on adding any kind of vibrancy to the smell of your clothes. Interestingly, I notice that the company sells “fragrance booster” for those who want to enhance the intensity of the scent. The fact that they have to make a scent booster should be a good tip off that the detergent itself isn’t very potent. Also, I noticed in watching an older video review that the notes of this detergent used to be listed as cedarwood, oakmoss and patchouli, not amber. I’m guessing that they changed patchouli to amber, because so many people are put off by that scent. They must have believed they could fool customers into buying it and not being able to detect what’s really in it. Not me.

title: Great electronics, horrible spray pump
text:
This (or a device like this) is great for having around the house, or at a remote location like a cabin or summer trailer. All it takes is water, a teaspoon of salt, and a 2A USB source (charger/adapter) to make a small bottle of bleach mix. No need to bring a separate bottle, store it, worry about kids or animals getting into it, etc. Make it and use it in one go, on the fly.

This particular unit does the electrolysis need to make the bleach without an issue. The problem is in the nozzle for spraying. It's designed to have a pressure system that allows you to squeeze the trigger multiple times and the unit sprays the bleachy water in a fine mist continuously. Sounds great right? Except the nozzle gets clogged within minutes, and a safety valve starts rediverting the stream back into the bottle.

Why would this happen? Because you're literally converting table salt into bleach in an imperfect system. If even a small clump of sodium remains (which is highly likely) it can and will easily make its way to the nozzle and clog it. And how do you unblock a pressurized system, filled with bleach water? Carefully, wearing clothes you don't care about getting bleach on.

I bought this mainly to make bleach with. I plan to 3D print a small cap for this, and simply use it to make the bleach I need, then pour it into a proper dollar store spray bottle and use it on demand. While it would have been great to be able to use the sprayer directly from the bottle, it's not worth returning, given the price of the unit. You could also use a pin to enlarge the hole, but then getting the aim right is kind of a pain.

If you're looking for one that works as a spray bottle as well, pick another design. This one sucks. If you just want it for making bleach cheaply? Grab it, and look for a cap for it over on thingiverse, where it will eventually be posted. :)

The only negatives I can find are that they do get a little damp if you wear them long enough. That's going to happen with any mask type thing though, and at least with these you can pretty easily change them out.

title: Not what it used to be
text: Been using clear care for 10 plus years and have enjoyed the product. Not only have I never had an eye infection, but I can make my contact lenses last a lot longer than the packaging states. So why the so-so rating you may wonder? Lately I have noticed that the neutralizing disc has not been lasting until the bottle is empty. I used to be able to buy a twin pack and the disc would take me through a bottle and a half. Now, I cant even get through a whole bottle before it gives out. How do you know when it gives out, your eyes burn like crazy, and yes I have waited beyond 6 hours. I let them sit for 9 hours and they still burned. I now have three bottles of clear care kicking around that when combined I am sure will make a whole. I am aware that you can purchase a case with the disc in it, but I do not want to as I paid a lot of money for this product. I feel that they might be ripping the consumer off by cutting back on the coating of the neutralizer. This might be that built in inflation control that you often see with products such as toilet paper companies shrinking their product. Either way, after my many years of using this product, I have decided to make the switch to a cleanser that uses tablets rather than a coated disc. I am fed up with burning eyes and being ripped off.

title: Decrypting the Instructions
text:
The atomizer is well built, small, silent and has a learning curve. some of the reports say the atomizer failed, my guess is they did not follow the instructions. They instructions are written by an engineer and a little cryptic. If you are currently using one of the big Nebulizers with hoses, etc. They are bullet proof and easy to use, noisy, a mess to clean up, hard to transport.
You have to know that they need to be sanitized with each use or you are drawing mold into your lungs.
Fill a sink with warm water and dish soap. The atomizer uses ultrasonic screens to atomize, located in the detachable top. I use the power cord as the unit draws more juice than the batteries can handle after a couple of days. You can live with it for a couple of days while you travel. Pour your Albuterol or what ever into the top. Make sure the cup is completely attached, and turn on. It will start to smoke immediately if you followed the instructions on how to clean and dry. If you hold it parallel or tipped away a little it should run all the way through.
If you are using one of the old big ones you are probably used to sucking it in pretty strong. If you do anything but slow and steady you will draw the mixture right through the screen and into the exit tube. Pour out what is in the tube onto a paper towel and set it on the counter running. The screen should clear within a minute and start smoking again. The unit will shut off when done.
Put the face mask or mouthpiece in the dish water. Pull the cup off, pour out the left overs, and slosh through the dish water for the cup then for the exit tube. Then slosh through the faucet for a rinse. Do not get the base unit (or handle) anywhere near water. Dry completely with soft dry cloth. Put about a 1/16" of clean water in the cup and re attach. Set it on the counter upright,turn on and within a minute or two it will start to smoke. Let it finish and shut off. This cleans the screen of any residue. Dry out the exit tube and the cup with your cloth and put away.
I found after a couple of days it went smooth and was no worse than the old one. It did take me a couple of days to decide I liked it better.
Some truths. The albuterol or discus you use will in time desolve tooth enamel if you don't pay attention. It is a good time for salt water rinse and gargle. Then a good time for a baby zitzer to squeeze salt water with some baking sods to clear nostrils. any time you use inhalers of any kind, rinse your mouth with a little water and swallow. Now you have all my tricks.

title: No Manufacturer Packaging - Possibly Counterfeit
text:
First, I adore Sanyo Eneloop batteries. However, I doubt seriously the authenticity of the product I received from this listing. On 27 July 2012, I ordered 16 AA Sanyo Eneloop batteries sold by Thomas Distributing and fulfilled by Amazon. The description of the product at the time of my purchase stated, "comes as four four-packs (a total of 16 batteries) with TWO FREE 8 Cell Battery Holders".

However, when I received the product, it was 16 loose batteries packaged in aftermarket plastic holders wrapped loosely in plastic with a crudely printed label (please see the image I posted). No manufacturer packaging was included. I am concerned that I received a counterfeit product or that the product at least was not new. Given the limited lifespan of the product, I could not accept the batteries in this condition and returned the order under the reasoning that the product I received did not match the product description. I appreciate greatly Amazon's return process in which they pay for return shipping in cases like these.

Based on other reviews, I cannot say that every battery sold via this listing is counterfeit or lacking in any other way. However, the delivery of the correct product is clearly inconsistent and I am no longer comfortable ordering my favorite batteries from online vendors including those on Amazon. I would rather drive over an hour to my nearest local vendor and purchase them there. Eneloop has its own web site where you can locate your nearest local vendor. I really wish Amazon would carry these directly from the manufacturer and do away with the inconsistent vendors.

Edit: This listing is more expensive, but appears to be sold directly by Amazon rather than a third-party vendor (it's worth the price difference to me if I get what I'm paying for):[[ASIN:B005C2Z68M SANYO NEW 1500 eneloop 16 Pack AA Ni-MH Pre-Charged Rechargeable Batteries]]

title: Buyer Beware: "International" brand is not what you expect.
text: This is not the Camay product that has been sold in the U.S. for decades. The classic brand began to disappear from general availability several years ago (see: "When a Trusted Brand Disappears" By RICKI MORELL, NYTimes,  November 30, 2010).  Morell  suggests  CleaningProductsWorld.com. The Amazon  offered soap felt wrong when I picked it up. I still had a bar of Classic so I was apple to compare.. This may be formulated for a specific kind of water. The smell is a bit acrid. The word "international" is on the packaging. This fact did not appear in the product description. If one has low vision it would be easy to miss the difference on the packaging until one uses a magnifier to examine the illustration. The soap did not come in box as depicted, just poorly wrapped plastic. If people know what they are getting, then is fine but the product description did not note a different formula. This was a misleading offering and will cause me to be more cautious in comparing the picture to the actual product at the Amazon site. This is Dollar Store technique that exploits people with poor vision or low literacy.

title: A great buy...if you like being dissapointed
text:
I am a cigar smoker currently deployed to Afghanistan...I bought this lighter because it had decent reviews, and it was cheap...boy is it cheap...The constructions is solid, very nice aluminum frame(that is why I gave it 1 of its stars)...Shipping was real fast (hence the second star) I recieved it 5 days after ordering (which is awsome considering most mail takes 7-10 days to my location) I opened the package, filled the lighter, and it light first try...YES...a solid purchase....not so fast...I pulled my Diesel Cigar out of my travel humidor, cut it, and "attempted" to light it. In fact I attempted to light it for 5 minutes (despite the many colorful comments from my fellow cigar smoking Marines with better lighters) I was not going to give up...Eventually I had to use the Bic I had in my pocket.....

I could hear the gas flowing, but there was no noticable spark. If I used my Bic as the ignition source it would light, but it would not light on its own.

Moral of the story...do not buy this light, you "WILL" be "VERY" dissapointed!!!!! (Plus your friends will make fun of you for buying a junk lighter.)

Anybody want to buy a NIBO Space 6 Butane Lighter??? Slightly used/Real cheap...I only hit it with a sledge hammer twice :)

title: Beats the Brush straightener Hands Down!
text: Upon receiving this product my first impressions were, "wow this looks weird, how is this thing supposed to work?". I also had my doubts about how well it would work on African  American non processed hair. Because the temperatures maximum  range was atleast 100°c less than the previous straighteners I've tested. This straighter features a new design, a six level temperature range of 130°c to 200°c, and a 360° rotating cord. It heats up fairly quick, around 30 sec to 1 min depending on the temperature setting. I decided to test this product on an African American thick and kinky hair type. This straightener did an amazing job. In comparison to the two brush straighteners I've tested previously. First of all I was able to get closer to the root. Which in my opinion is crucial for straight styles. And simply for appearance purposes. Who wants straight ends with kinky roots? Beyond that her hair came out pretty decent. I'd compare the end results to a blow dry with an accompanying light press. Press meaning (straightening or hot comb). For silky or loose curl hair types, this product would work twice as well. This device is easy to power on. And it has illuminating lights to show what temperature it's on. With other straighteners in this catagory, I've had issues with accidentally pressing buttons whilst in use. This was no longer an issue. The straightener also has a safety cut off feature. Which I found to be a blessing and a curse. Sure if you've forgotten to turn it off, fires will be prevented. However it can be irritating, it turning off while your sectioning your hair or applying product. There are a few things that could use improvement. A higher temp range,an alert sound when it's about to shut down, and a bag or case for storage when not in use. Instructions for cleaning would also be appreciated. I was very impressed with this product. And im almost positive you will be as well. If you'd like to see my video review of this product. You can find it on my YouTube channel. Search carel kennon. I recieved this product at a discount for evaluation purposes.

title: It's attractive and looks more like a piece of furniture ...
text:
This adjustable medical table came in a large box secured with two packing straps. Inside was a small box with four wheels, screws, and all pieces for the table.

What I Like about this Medical Table

1. It's relatively easy to put together. There are three main pieces - the top, the side bar and the bottom bar. You screw on the table top, screw on the bottom part, and add the wheels. You will need a Phillips screw driver and a wrench.
2. The unit rolls easily and is the right height even to roll under my couch with ease.
3. The top is 30 inches by 15 inches - a great size for all kinds of toiletries, food, etc.
4. It's attractive and looks more like a piece of furniture than something from a hospital.
5. While sick individuals might use this beside their beds, it's handy for anyone who needs an extra spot to put items or a portable desk.

What Could Be Improved
1. The instructions are basic and could be presented more clearly.
2. The top does lean some if you press on it, so it won't hold an excessive amount of weight.

I purchased this medical bedside table at a promotional price for testing and review purposes. Overall, this is an attractive bedside table, which could easily be used with a chair or couch as well. The dark woodgrain top makes the product look more like home than a medical institution. Note that there is a give to the table when you press on the end of it, so if you have a full glass of liquid, it could spill over.

title: Supports the kidneys and urinary tract
text:
These organic cranberry capsules came in a double sealed bottle.

What I Like about these Organic Cranberry Capsules
1. These capsules are pretty small, which makes them easy to take. Yet there's still 25,000mg of organic cranberries in each capsule.
2. All the ingredients are organic and non-GMO, so I feel safer about taking them.
3. No soy, yeast, milk or gluten.
4. These capsules are easier for me to take than drinking cranberry juice - plus, no sugar!
5. I work in a job where it's not always easy to get to a bathroom. Cranberry helps me ward off infections.

I was given this bottle of organic cranberry extract free for testing and review purposes. Overall, I find these capsules an excellent investment. Everything about the capsules are organic - even the rice for the outer capsules! And there are no fillers that can cause inflammation/allergies. If you're in a job where it's hard to find time to go to the restroom during the day, then cranberry makes great sense as a supplement. It supports the kidneys and urinary tract and can help you avoid an infection. When I feel like I could be coming down with a UTI, I will take 5-7 cranberry pills, and I get immediate relief.

title: Contains no sugars or carbs
text:
This set of ten Toniiq electrolyte packets (there are three tablets in each packet) comes in a nice, sturdy, white box, suitable for gift giving. Very impressive presentation.

What I Like about these Toniiq Tablets
1. Sometimes I just can't stomach the thought of drinking one more glass of any kind of liquid, especially when sick. The last thing I want is to mix up some fizzy electrolyte drink that tastes nasty and try to get it down. To have these electrolyte tablets handy is a life-saver.
2. These are handy to carry with you in your purse, pocket, or gym bag.
3. There are no sugars or carbs in this supplement.

What Could Be Improved
1. The tablets are large and thus may be difficult for some people to swallow. Two smaller tablets would be ideal.
2. I'd rather have each serving in a separate envelope, for freshness. I wouldn't normally use three in one day. (not a complaint, just a personal preference)

I purchased these Toniiq electrolyte tablets at a promotional price for testing and review purposes. I think they're great, especially if you're on a medication that zaps your potassium. I take them to work and keep them on hand for times when I feel like I am getting tired or blah during the day. Replacing electrolytes makes me feel clearer-headed and more energetic. If you struggle with keeping your electrolytes balanced, this supplement may be of benefit.

title: Globe energy saving surge suppressor that requires at least 15 watts to operate properly (item 78133).
text:
This 8 outlet energy savings surge suppressor does a good job at reducing vampire power eating devices. It allows five outlets to be controlled by one master outlet that shuts off the secondary outlets when the master outlet no longer draws power. There are two additional outlets that are not controlled by the master outlet (always on). The master outlet has to draw at least 15 watts or the secondary outlets will not provide power. So if the device that is plugged into the master outlet draws less than 15 watts during operation, you will hear a clicking sound which means the secondary outlets are being turned off. Note that this comment applies to item number 78331. There is another Globe energy savings surge suppressor item number 78250 that I have that is slightly different. The other item has a user selectable wattage threshold setting to activate the secondary outlets from the master outlet. There are three levels - low (10 watts), medium (22 watts), high (42 watts). The device that is plugged into the master outlet must draw at least the wattage based on the user setting (a small black switch at the bottom of the unit). This item also does not have slide protective covers for each outlet. Item 78133 has just one wattage threshold setting - 15 watts and does have protective outlet covers.

There is also an older version of the Globe energy savings surge suppressor - item 78159. I do not know the wattage threshold of this item because I do not have one of these. Best to contact the seller to make sure which item number is being sold.

title: Very Poor Service when trying to set up account
text:
[[VIDEOID:178d9028cdb8022118b36797346ac095]] Purchased this for my 94 year-old mother who has recently had 3 falls. Was VERY UNHAPPY with the company when trying to set up service and to activate. When I first received the unit, I tested the unit following the directions in the booklet. A recording said that the device had successfully connected and the device was working. (see video). I had not even activated the unit yet. When I called to activate, I asked about the recording and was told that if it was actually connected I would have been connected to a real person - that the unit was not working (even though the recording said it was). I felt the recording was VERY MISLEADING - if my mother had tested it, she would have thought it was connected and working and would have thought she did not need to call to activate it - this could have been a matter or life and death if she tried to use it during an emergency and it wasn't even connected. After giving my and my mother's information over the phone, I was told the unit would be activated in 20 minutes, and I could test it then. When I tested it, I got the same recording, saying it was successfully connected and working. However, no person ever came on. I tried pushing the button for assistance (as if it were an emergency) and the unit said it had not been activated.
I then called customer service and was told it WAS activated and to try the test again. I did so while the representative was on the line - and he was able to hear the recording saying it was successfully connected and working. However, it was NOT activated and working as no live person came on the line. He put me on hold for a minute and then came back and said it was NOT yet activated, but the activation was pending. I told him the other representative had told me activation would take place in 20 minutes, and this representative then told me it would take 24 - 48 hours to activate!!!! So basically the unit was useless at that point. Also, I had been told so much incorrect information at that point that I was ready to cancel the service. I decided to wait until the unit was activated to see how it worked. IT DIDN'T! After 24 hours, I tested the unit again, and it said that the cell service was not good and a connection could not be made. I moved to another location in the house and tried pushing the button as if it were an emergency. I got the same recording saying the cell service was not good and to try another location. About 3 minutes later, while I was in the same location, and without pressing the button again, a live representative came on the line asking if I needed assistance.
During the activation of the device, I was given different information and incorrect information. Then once the unit was activated, it did not work and then did work when I was in the same location. There were so many things wrong with this entire process, from the first message saying it was working (when it wasn't) to the misinformation about whether the unit was activated and how long it would take, to the actual unit not working when the button was pressed. I would never trust this unit as an alert system for my mother or anyone! A person could push the button and lie there dying while waiting for "assistance" that they thought was on the way - while the entire time the system wasn't even working! I am returning this unit and canceling the service!

title: Awesome purchase for a working mom
text:
I had a manual pump that was gifted to me when my LO was a couple of days old but I quickly realised it wouldn't be convenient for me. I invested in a set of double wearable pumps, they had plastic-like flanges and weren't very comfortable. Then I got a momcozy pump, I loved the collector cup but I found having to change the setting on two motors individually got to be too much and I found the motors were getting in the way after a while. I found this pump by accident, I was looking for another brand that was recommended to me. And after I read some reviews I decided to give it a go.

First things first, my momcozy cups work with this so I have extra pieces now... yay! Second, 1 motor controls both sides which I find so helpful. I haven't used the highest setting (16) but the fact that I have so many levels is great as I would use my old pumps and have it at max and still not be removing the milk (there was no discomfort on the highest level the suction just wasn't doing it for me). I found that I get the most milk when I leave it in massage mode for 6 minutes and switch to express mode for 4 minutes depending on how my breasts feel I repeat for another 10 minutes (massage mode 6 minutes then express mode 4 minutes).

It was nicely packaged and I like the little box to hold the tubing. I would definitely recommend this to anyone for themself or as a gift. And I would say to play around with the settings. What works for you might not be the "norm" but if it works it works! I first used the auto express mode which is pretty cool and let it run till I felt discomfort and switched to express mode and used the previous level (i.e. level 6 if I felt discomfort at level 7 in auto express mode) then I figured out what worked best for me. I also want to remind any moms feeling discouraged with the pumping or the amount of milk they are producing, that you are doing an amazing job and you are becoming the best parent possible for your child. Keep at it!

title: Cute, Inexpensive But No Scent
text:
This is supposed to be an "air freshener", and it comes with two little fragrance pads you insert into the charm, but I haven't been able to detect any fragrance at all after inserting a pad, installing the charm and driving with air blowing through the vent.

However, it's an adorable little cat charm and rather inexpensive. The "air freshener" was really only an added bonus for me. I suppose I could make my own pads using an absorbent material and essential oils.

The packaging it comes in isn't all that attractive, so if you're giving it as a gift you might want to provide your own gift box or wrap it rather special with gift paper. And there are no instructions, so you will need to explain to the recipient that it's an "air freshener" that clips to the vent in your car, so that's what the tablets and clip are for.

Four stars for being adorable and inexpensive, but one star marked off for failing to meet an advertised feature and lack of any explanation regarding purpose/use in packaging.

title: Easy-To-Use, Subtle Scent
text:
I won't know for some time how well these work, but I'm keeping my fingers crossed that they help reduce clogs. I have 2 drains that regularly seem to build up scum - the bathroom, where shaving foam, shaved hairs, creams and lotions seem to collect, and the kitchen sink due to grease, etc.
These are very easy to use, you just drop a full stick down your drain where it will sink into the trap and sit there slowly dissolving. You place only 1 stick per drain each month.
The sticks are lightly scented, but it's very subtle. I didn't notice any scent in the drain once I dropped down into the trap. But the important thing is whether or not it helps reduce the smell coming from your pipes. That's not usually a problem in my house, so I'll never really know how well that feature works.
Some of the sticks may arrive broken in the packaging, but it really doesn't matter other than perhaps the smaller pieces might not stay in the trap and may instead get washed down the pipes.
I'm pretty happy with these so far. They're simple, they're subtle and they're inexpensive. If my sinks continue to clog as easily as they used to, I'll come back and update my review. If they never clog again, I'll definitely come back and raise the rating when I order some more!

title: Helpful and Comfortable Breathing But One Size Does Not Fit All
text:
This works better than I expected, but has room for improvement.
First, one size does not fit all - this was a little too short for me from the tip of my nose to the bottom of my lip when my mouth is open. It's OK when I'm not talking, but gets a little clumsy at times when my bottom lip bumps it and I have to occasionally readjust the position. Which isn't good, as that means I'm putting my hand to my face.
But this works wonderfully to help maintain a gap when you breathe in, ensuring you get cool air. My biggest complaint in wearing a mask is how hot and uncomfortable it can get, and this nearly solves that problem completely. It's still a little warmer than not wearing a mask at all, but only if you focus on it - I really don't notice it unless I think about it.
An added benefit in wearing this is that my glasses don't steam up anywhere near as much. They still can, depending on the circumstances and how heavy I'm breathing, but it's not too common and it clears quickly.
One tiny complaint is that it's a little heavy to wear with the really flimsy masks, making it stretch out the elastic strings of those masks in no time. This is probably a little thicker than it needed to be. Perhaps they wanted more rigidity?
Overall, I'd recommend trying these if wearing a mask is simply too hot and uncomfortable for you, or if you wear glasses and have problems with them steaming up. I give it 4-stars and I'm very happy I ordered some - I really don't mind wearing a mask as much now.

title: No frigging way this is 100% pure!
text:
There is no way this is 100% pure oil. I have used Tea Tree oil in the past (as well as oregano oil) to remove skin tags. I purchased this product for this specific purpose. Although Tea Tree is the best at removing tags (IMO), it is also the most caustic, so you have to be careful using it as it can and will easily burn your skin.
I was concerned when I read the label and it said "suitable for therapeutic and fragrance applications". Usually this means it has a neutral oil or something added to it. However, it went on to warn about skin irritation. I figured for the price I'd give it a shot. Needles to say, I should have trusted my instinct about the concern.
There was absolutely NO irritation when using this straight. I applied it several times a day on a tag under my arm, a VERY tender area. Nothing...no pain, no redness and certainly, no effect on the tag itself. After two weeks of giving it the benefit of the doubt, I went back to an older bottle of oregano oil (not this brand) and immediately felt the effects (ouch)! It also dried out the tag and worked.
So I do not recommend this oil. It isn't 100% tea tree. no frigging way!

title: Superior to others
text:
I don't write reviews but this product deserves one. I spent hours researching the ingredients of this and other dental probiotics and this one was the most natural with the fewest additives. That was important to me. The other ingredients besides streptococcus salivarius that are in this product do not cause side effects. Then I checked with my pharmacist who said that streptococcus salivarius as a probiotic is safe and does not cause side effects. It might cause a little bit of gas for a couple of days until your body gets used to it but that will go away. But this is not a miracle product, you have to do your part too, like brushing and using a mouthwash first and then putting a tablet on your tongue and letting it dissolve. When it's finished dissolving I run my tongue all over the inside of my mouth (under my upper lip, the sides of my cheeks and behind my bottom lip to distribute the dissolved pill throughout my mouth. The idea of this product is to crowd out the bad bacteria, so I help it along. After your procedure wait half an hour before eating. Let the pill do it's work. It is imperative to floss every night also before going to bed. This gets rid of any bacteria that has accumulated between the teeth. Everything you do will help whether you use this product or another such as brushing your teeth after eating and brushing the uvula (the skin that hangs down in the back of your mouth).
As for the effectiveness of this pill I say it works. Some reviews indicate that it does not work and to save your money. First of all it's not that expensive to at least try it and secondly it may not work for them. Every person's body is different. For me it was a life changer. For me it works about 90% and brings me to normalcy with a much cleaner breath. You can use it just once a day or twice a day if you will be socializing that evening.
