title: Unique and Effective - I Love It
text:
What a unique scrubber this is. I've never seen such a thing before. It's simply amazing that there are 4,000 tiny little silicone bristles all across the surface of the scrubber. The bristles somehow manage to work quite effectively at exfoliating the skin while feeling incredibly soft at the same time. It's not like you're scraping your skin with stiff bristles. This is a very gentle experience. At the same time, it also does a really nice job of stimulating your circulation.

The rounded shape also makes it so there are no uncomfortable edges or corners on this thing, making it a pleasure to use.

The pump works brilliantly to inflate or deflate the scrubber's base and provide just the softness or firmness that you need for the job at hand. Note that no matter how firmly you inlate it, it will still feel soft and comfortable against your skin. It's hard to describe how that could be, but it somehow manages to do just that. When it's fully inflated, it's convex, making it great for getting into an indented area. When it's partially deflated, it's flat and can get to pretty much any area of your body. When it's fully deflated, it's concave, making it great for scrubbing your chin or nose or any other small protruding area of the body.

It's comfortable to hold and you can either grip it by its handle or put its handle between your fingers and then grip the outer edge with your hand. That's especially useful if you take this into the shower and get yourself all soapy, which will make the scrubber a bit slippery.

Since it doesn't come with any soap and doesn't have a soap dispenser in it, you can use it with any soap. It does an exceptionally good job of lathering up the soap because of all those bristles. Mine is going to live in my shower from now on.

It's also not just for soap. It also works well for deeply applying lotion or other moisturizer to the skin. The little bristles work it into every pore. And since it can be cleaned, you can remove the lotion or moisturizer from it by taking it into the shower with you to use with soap.

It's easy to clean. You can soap down and rinse the whole thing, give it a good shake, and then either lay it on its side to dry or put it into the little holder that comes with it that can be attached to any clean, dry surface with the peel-and-stick label. I just set mine on its side and the air gets to it and dries it in no time. It's also not absorbent, so it's unlikely that any nasty things will grow on it.

If you're looking for something to take into the shower with you to scrub yourself with that isn't absorbent and that's easy to clean and comfortable to use, I have a feeling you'll enjoy this little scrubber brush.

title: I Love Everything About It
text:
This is just a beautiful little pill box that brings back memories of my childhood. I got the rose gold one and it has almost a coppery sheen to it. The whole thing is artistically styled and very elegant.

It's very nicely made and seems quite sturdy. I have no doubt that the lid hinge will last for quite some time and that the button will open the lid many, many times. I love how the lid pops open, but not all the way. You can then gently lift it all the way open. That means you can work this with one hand, which is brilliant.

The lid also snaps shut easily by gently pressing it down, which you can also do with one hand. Note that the lid doesn't seal this pill box air-tight, but it will keep your pills (or whatever you keep inside of it) inside and protect them from being touched by anything while they're in there.

There are no rough or sharp edges. Everything about this pill box is round or rounded. The embossed design on the top is lovely, and it was thoughtful of the designers to put a different embossed design on the bottom as well, so you can feel which way is right-way-up even in the dark without having to look at it.

The little three-compartment divider tray inside is a thoughtful touch for keeping different kinds of pills or other small items separate from one another. The tray is permanently attached and doesn't come out.

I washed and towel-dried my pill box and then left it open to air dry overnight in case I'd missed any moisture before using it. It holds quite a few of my little pills, and I'm already enjoying using it each day. It's just gorgeous and I love everything about it.

title: Wonderful reusable alternative
text:
These are beautifully made with a nice variety of prints and it was a thoughtful touch to include two different sizes. They're stitched together well with no loose threads or crooked seams and the snaps are smooth and hold together nicely when snapped shut.

The ones I received are exactly as pictured above. I thought I'd upload a photo of all of them with their snaps shut to go along with those photos.

These are soft and thin and comfortable to wear. They don't feel bulky and it's actually easy to forget that they're there at all, which is a good thing. They're nicely absorbent and don't produce any kind of odor.

I wash mine in cold water in my washing machine without fabric softener and then hang them to dry. They're fully dry by the next day. If I needed them sooner, I'd tumble them dry with no heat, but I haven't tried that yet.

I appreciate the inclusion of the wet bag, which is made of the same materials as the pads, making it waterproof so you can keep it in your purse or pocket without worry.

This is a wonderful alternative to buying throw-away pads that can be made of questionable materials and/or be difficult to obtain at times. It's much nicer to have this attractive stash of monthly supplies that's under your own control.

title: I guess the product is cute/ok, but I REALLY wasn't a huge fan of the packaging.
text:
It comes in a plastic capsule.

A bulk of my childhood was spent in an Asian country, Korea, where they put cheap toys in plastic capsules at coin-driven dispensers. Not quite as big in American supermarkets, though they also do have them, often at the exit of the check out... wasn't a child in the U.S., so I don't know what stigmas these things have.

My wife who is a bit of an enthusiast for these things, loved that it came in a capsule... seems to take it for granted, or even as a 'validation' that this product is an Asian 'import'.

Me? I wasn't a big fan. I felt like I'd just paid 20 bucks for a toy that probably doesn't cost more than 1 or 2 bucks.

That said, the item itself is solid. Sturdy in construction, the painting or whatever it is doesn't look like it'd wear or break down too easily... the chain doesn't seem to be plastic as the 'packaging' had me worried it to be. The chain does seem like it's NOT plastic at least, it seems heavy. The charm itself... it's rather light, obviously not solid gold, but... well. Yeah this was for my wife... maybe she ought to be reviewing it instead.

Is it cute? My wife thought so, she found it charming, as she's a big fan of "Luna".

For me, I just really didn't like the way they packaged it... was I paying 15 bucks for importing? I can't imagine why they'd package this like it's a 2-5 dollar toy.

I will gladly claim ignorance, perhaps there's something to the 'import' culture that I am totally missing.

Btw, the moon itself? it's not filled in. It's, translucent... I am not quite sure if it's supposed to be, or if it is... I don't want to poop on my wife's parade, as she really seems to love it.

title: Set-up is bush league
text:
I like the scale and I like the Fitbit device and software, but I have to agree with other reviewers regarding the setup procedure. It is not impossible, but it is not nearly as smooth as it could and should be. Seems to me that a port on the scale and a and cable connecting to the Fitbit receiver already attached to the computer would have been a logical way to go with the setup process. No doubt this would have cost a few bucks more in the manufacturing process. Additionally, when you create a process that is not simple and straightforward, the lack of phone or chat support is really an unforgivable faux pas if your intent is to build a loyal and satisfied customer base complimentary of your products.

ADDENDUM 9/21/2012 - After using this scale for a while, I have also found the accuracy to be much suspect. If I weigh myself 3 times in a 2 minute span I get three different results. Occasionally the results vary by as much as 2 lbs. I will therefore reduce my rating from 3 stars to 2. I still use it as it does serve a purpose. It is just that for the price I would expect the thing to live up to claims from the manufacturer.

Addendum 12/18/2012 - OK. I have now had it with thing. Not only can the weight reading vary by up to 5 pounds in the space of a minute, without moving or touching the scale in any way, other than standing on it, but the body fat function has completely quit. Requests for help to Fitbit have gotten nowhere, other than "reset the scale", which, of course is of no help whatsoever. Time to call Amazon and see what this one year limited warranty is like. If at all possible, this piece of C..p is going back. JUST GOT OFF THE PHONE WITH AMAZON. Have never dealt with an organization so willing to stand behind their sales. They will be sending out a replacement scale within 2 days. As far as I am concerned, you just cannot beat Amazon's commitment to customer satisfaction. Thanks guys.

Addendum 12/22/2012 - The new scale came in and after 6 or 7 unsuccessful attempts at getting the setup process to complete (One while I had tech support on the phone), I completely give up on this thing. I'm done, finished, I want a refund. Amazon has agreed to take it back and it will shipped to them on Monday.

title: Outrageous Garlic Flavor in a Whole New Way
text: Garlic is a pantry staple in my kitchen with fresh garlic at the top of the list but it's hard to keep it on hand and keep it fresh in my tiny RV space.  Dried garlic powders rarely bring enough flavor to the table and bits and pieces of dried garlic don't always have enough time to cook properly in "hurry-up" meals.  Here's the solution!  I bought the two bottle combo of Garlic Juice Spray or Pour.  One flavor is regular garlic flavor and the other is roasted.  I rapidly used up the first bottle making garlic bread.  The flavor is pure garlic without anything added and garlic bread became a snap for anytime.  First, I would spray a light coat over the bread and then lightly butter the bread before popping it into the oven.  Voila!  Full flavor with minimum work.  I also used a lot of it up simply pouring it into soups, stews, chili - basically anywhere that garlic worked for me.  I sprayed it on roasts and chicken before slow-roasting them and poured it into my ground beef when I was browning it for spaghetti sauce or Mexican dishes.  I think this item is a little pricey but none of it was wasted and I enjoyed the ease of having it close at hand.  I never really developed a preference for one flavor or the other.  Both of them were great and at first, I had both bottles sitting next to the stove.  I would chose one or the other according to my mood and when both bottles were less than half full I poured them into a single bottle mixing the flavors.  The only time my bottles left the side of my stove was when they got empty!

text:
My boyfriend is a professional animator and as such, he's constantly using his hands for small motions (mouse clicking and keyboard typing). This causes some minor occasional muscle soreness in his hands. I found a few products for heated hand massagers that were highly rated by animators and other people who spend long periods of time on the computer. Unfortunately, we live in Florida. Adding extra heat would probably not be appreciated. I ended up getting him this product as it looked like it may help with the muscle soreness and also provide some cooling air.

We have it, it sits on a bookshelf near his desk for use if he decides his hands are sweaty and he doesn't want to just wipe them off.

Overall, a kind of weird product that works just ok.

text: I recieved this pipe yesterday (excellent shipping time), but the photograph here is extremely misleading. When I first opened the box, I thought it was actually a different pipe because the picture looked so different. It took me a while to realise what was going on. The lighting in this picture distorts a few aspects. First small thing is that the pipe is a lot bigger in person. That's not a complaint, obviously. Second, the tube running from the metal object on the glass base to the metal tray up top appears (to me) to be covered in small, metal pieces. Turns out, those pieces are actually glass and some acrylics. It looks great in person, I was afraid it would be some cheap, metallic-painted plastic, so glass is fine with me. Third, and this is the one I'm not so pleased about, the glass base is not a smooth-blown piece. There are etchings in the glass around the middle of the central bulge. It's not awful, I'm still pleased with the pipe altogether, but the picture makes the base look a lot smoother and cleaner. It's really just a simple design, but I bought the pipe because I liked the base in the picture. Regardless, the pipe I have is the same one pictured here, so I can't complain too much. title: Poor design
text:
I read quite a few reviews before I bought it and found most of them to pertain to real issues. I was excited to get it quickly and try it. I was disappointed as it cost me time and effort.

- It is poorly designed for an average person's nose bridge and eye socket. The designers chose a profile that does not fit 95% of people. The nose ridge area needs to be wider and 'sloped' back to allow average person to have it fit comfortably. I had six people try it on and it did not fit a very small nose to a larger one.
- Average eye glasses could have been used to create a design that fits most people. I have never had to get customized glasses for size fit. Most people can wear off-the-shelf glasses. Disappointing that the designer did not undertand human physiology.
- The heat is almost non-existent compared to a mask that can be heated in a microwave. With the plethora mask available, it is shameful that the designer did not consider the measurement in this design. I have used several brooder mask from cheap to expensive and never had a fit issue. Because of poor design of the nose ridge, the eye portion of the device does not even come close to a normal person eye width. Again, even cheap sunglasses could have been a design prototype
- The massager does not work as claimed nor is it possible for it to work since all it does is make noise to pretend it is working! Shameful
- I saw a lot of talk about music in the reviews. That was not an important feature for me but it seems to be ok. I think lot of reviews are not used to reike type music.
- The hard case (I know it is needed to house the motors) is a big design flaw when a normal human skull size is not considered. It barely fit a small person let alone normal or large person
- The temple thumper is way too aggressive and may cause some injury. I am not sure why it is not mentioned in any reviews. It is almost dangerous on how hard it pushes on your temples
- The strap is designed for a ten year old child's head and not an average human adult.

This was a big disappointment! I sent it back

It is definitely a much better value. My wife covered the box with a pleasing gift wrap to make it look better on the granite counter. One technique I'v learned is to place the plate of food on the counter in front of the plastic wrap. Then, with two hands, pull out the plastic a little past the plate. Then, pick up the plate, slide the cutter to cut the film, and grab the other end of plastic to finish wrapping the plate. This whole operation takes seconds to perform.

One other great use is when you're painting a room: Paint out the excess paint on the brush, then just take a generous piece of plastic film and wrap the brush completely. It will stay soft for at least a day! Thank you for viewing!

title: "No memory effect" means you can have a backup battery without a separate charger.
text:
I suggest buying 4 headphone batteries and using two at a time with these simple rules.
1. Always switch off when taking off.
2. Always recharge overnight whichever batter is in the headphone at the end of the day.
3. During the day, whenever the headphone will probably not be used for 2 or more hours--switch batteries and recharge. (Or--you might also switch-and-recharge in the middle of the night or early in the morning.)
4. Any time that a battery starts to conk out after only a few hours use--it is on the way out. So it is then time to enter a third battery into the switch-off routine.

Thus--even if you usually use the headphones all day long--you will always have two almost-fully charged batteries--or the equivalent--to get you through the day. This should work even if there is only one or two days weekly that you are able to switch batteries and partially recharge for a couple of hours during the day.

Note. Our Sony headphone must be switched off during recharging. Also it seems that perhaps the sound input to the TV needs to be plugged in during recharghing, although I am not yet sure about this.

I have not yet used these 'aftermarket' batteries for very long. However, so far so good. The original Sony batteries conked out after two weeks. It seems likely these others cannot be worse, at least.

I intend to update this review after several months of intense battery usage. So y'all be sure to come back again, hear?

title: Fresh Neem & Fenugreek tea have unmatched value for diabetics, hypoclycemics and everyone else!
text:
(Of course, people being treated for sugar control problems should notify their doctor first if taking these natural supports because they can modify prescription needs--possibly lessening doses and therefore lessoning side effects--but of course medical supervision may be needed. Above all, be gradual. Do not suddenly take a lot at once!)

There are a lot of natural pills available for blood sugar control. I do not have a medical condition but I get sugar-shocked very easily and have tried most natural supports. Pills are convenient and helpful, perhaps more important than making teas because you are more certain to take the pills daily. However regardless of your level of discipline, there is a special feeling from taking fresh tea made from fenugreek or neem--whether daily or occasionally.

Also note that some natural supports for blood sugar may cause heavy-handed lowering of blood sugar levels. This is not the case with neem or fenugreek. In mild doses at least, these can be equally helpful for high or low blood sugar. And hypoglycemia or "low blood sugar" is now recognized to be a pre-diabetic phase, which perhaps is more accurately described as "irregular blood sugar." Hypoglycemics and diabetics both need to cut down on sugar and sugar sources including sweet fruits.

And blood sugar control is key to just about every health condition and health maintenance. According to holistic neurologist Dr. South the more sugar in the blood the less energy reaches the eyes and brain, due to the excessive insulin which may produced but for which there is insufficient reception.

I.e., everyone who is getting older is getting less efficient at handling sugars and more susceptible to mild or severe complications related to glaucoma, diabetes and dementia--all directly related to blood sugar control.

On the other hand, a lot of people tend to emphasize one thing only for blood sugar control, like cinnamon, which is good but can be harsh in large doses. It makes sense to take moderate doses of a number of different things. This gives you added "synergy" as well as reducing the effect of the "law of diminishing returns."

However I am not going by scientific data so much as by the special feeling I get when occasionally taking neem or fenugreek tea. These can be taken alone or with mild novelty teas such as "lemon zinger." However I find that it is best not to mix several sugar-control herbs such as neem, fenugreek or cinnamon. Also you really should try this alone to get the feel for it.

Neem is bitter and several ayurvedic sources suggest to boil it which makes it ghastly. I really find it is best just to drop 1-2 teaspoons in a cup, add boiling water, steep and drink. This is bitter but you will not only get to tolerate it, but to enjoy it for the feeling of calm it gives you after, which can perhaps be described as the exact opposite of "sugar shock."

Neem is also a great flu-chaser. As you probably know, neem has so many benefits that it is called "a pharmacy in a tree."

Fenugreek is available in tea bags. ([[ASIN:B001GCTU4I Click here for Alvita Tea Bags, Fenugreek Seed, 30 tea bags (Pack of 3)]].) However Neem is only available as a loose leaf. The ideal of course is for it to be organic. This is the good stuff but drink it don't smoke it.

title: Quite possibly the best out there
text: I have tried a number of Reishi extracts. I have developed a feel for what represents the chemicals you want to have in your Reishi. I have had some really good ones. This one, so far is the best. The bitterness is very prominent without being revolting. The packaging is very impressive. It comes with several layers of protection. When you open that, you find the powder in yet another high quality resealable clear plastic bag. There is also a silica type desiccatant to ensure that any moisture that made it through the foil pouch never gets a chance to get to the final pouch containing the actual extract. The extract dissolved nicely into a small amount of almond milk. I can understand that some people might object to a bitter Reishi, but then it seems you aren’t getting the benefits of the chemicals that the mushroom contains. I have had Reishi that looked like dark chocolate and was not bitter, but also not quite so effective. title: Simple but great idea. These little cloths have been through the ...
text:
Simple but great idea. These little cloths have been through the wash and used multiple times. The Swiffer cloths were becoming clostly and each time I threw them away, I would think about how I was just pumping more junk into the landfills. These fleece sweepers fit my Swiffer perfectly, stay on the whole time I am cleaning my hardwood floors, pick up all the dust and TONS of hair that I shed. Once I throw the dust and hair in the trash can, I take out the Swiffer with the fleece still on, and dust off the fleece outside. After a second use, I will toss it in the wash and it comes out completely clean and ready to use again. For its main purpose to pick up dust and hairs, this is perfect. The product does just as expected and the different colors are cute.

Update Feb 2018: still happy with the product, has survived several more washes and cleanings. Not a single one has come unraveled. They're still soft and they still do the job! So for over a year, I haven't had to buy any Swiffer dusters which means I have thrown less junk into the landfill AND I have saved money, while still having a clean house :) win, win, win!

Update 9/21/19: these guys have still survived more washing and cleanings! They're still cute and none have yet to come unraveled. Totally worth it. I can't say I'm a superhero when it comes to recycling, but when I do realize I'm just creating waste, I try to find a better solution. This is indeed been helpful in the cleaning department. I haven't had to buy swiffer sheets at all since I've had these.

I am prepairing for VSG- will be using thes products for awhile. Will be repurchasing this as well as trying out some of their other flavor options. I travel a lot, expect to do so on the clear to full liquid diet post op. I needed a powdered clear liquid to get through TSA- while being unable to eat airline food. I will be set with this and a few packets of broth.
Note: this liquid is not completely transparent- see through. Which is what I teach patients are how to tell if something quality’s a clear liquid. It’s more of a slightly cloudy liquid. Nurses as the worst patients— and it is clear enough for me to count as a clear liquid!

title: Easy to Put Together But Screws Strip Out Easily
text:
We live in a small apartment and my wife already had an over-the-bed table/tray that would slide over the bed but it was too low, her legs kept hitting the tray.

Pros: Puts together very easily and quickly. Comes with a little wrench and screwdriver. Good height and easy to adjust: my wife can leave the table over the bottom half of the bed and her legs don't hit it when she's sleeping. Attractive table top.

Cons: Wheels might be a little small to roll effectively over high pile carpets. Also, wish there were a small lip around the edge of the table top so that things wouldn't slide off so easily. The instructions show some kind of metal cross brace when, in fact, it's a wooden cross piece, and that wooden cross piece is thin. After a couple of years, the screws stripped out, which I think will happen if the tray is moved often (which, in our case, it's moved a couple of times a day). The screws that hold the top onto the metal brace are also very short, and if you grab the top to move the whole unit, eventually the anchors will pull out.

If you take any fish oil pills and they are too large or you burp the fishy taste back then this liquid fish oil is for you. I highly recommend Carlson's Fish Oil. It's working for me and isn't that all I can ask of it?

title: How to Stun a Skeptic
text:
After attempting to clean the caked on coffee residue in a metal carafe at work numerous times with minimal success, I was ready to try anything. We're talking black insides on this carafe, not just a bit of a stain. 15-20 minutes of scrubbing would barely touch it. So, I found this on Amazon and thought I'd try it.

I thought I would need a stiff brush to go along with it, but it came with a sponge (!) brush. I poured some Squeak'n Clean in the carafe, and let the coffee maker heat 4-5 cups of water directly into it. When it was finished, I ran the foam brush around the inside a few seconds, and when I drew it out, it was almost black! I poured some of the water out and IT was black, too! I spent perhaps 2 minutes swishing the brush around in the carafe, and when I rinsed it out, it looked brand new. I wish I had taken before and after pictures. I proceeded to brew the best pot of coffee out of that coffee-maker in years.

title: please try to get the micronized version like the one sold by this seller
text:
This review is for the Nutrafx Micronized Creatine Powder. I have previously used creatine supplements, so I have an idea of what to expect. If you decide to take creatine supplements, please try to get the micronized version like the one sold by this seller. Micronized essentially means finer powder with a larger surface area so it improves solubility and potentially alleviates the gastrointestinal side-effects of creatine monohydrate. Just imagine the difference between granulated sugar (non-micronized) and caster sugar (micronized).

Creatine has been shown to improve strength and hypertrophy; and it appears to be most effective for activities that involve repeated short bursts of high-intensity activity such as weight lifting. Like most, if not all, there is no flavor to any these creatine supplements, so you add it to your juice or water (like I do) and just drink it. There is no need to “pre-load” creatine. You simply take 5 grams each and every day and just keep it that way.
Creatine performs well with my other supplements and fits perfectly in my stack. The container comes with 60 servings and its own scoop. This is enough for two months’ worth of supplementation and for you to really reap the benefits of the creatine before buying some more (if you choose to continue).

Verdict: Nutrafx’s creatine did exactly what I expected it to do. Muscles felt fuller and it gives you that little edge to be able to do one more rep! I will definitely buy more when the time comes.

title: but this product is off to a great start and has not disappointed
text:
This review is for the Athletic Greens BCAA capsules. I have only tried BCAAs in powder and this is my first try with capsules.
I was drawn to BCAA products for their claim to reduce fatigue after intense exercise. I do weight training 3 days a week using a hypertrophy program that consists of high volume. Therefore, I really need something to help me recover on that off-day.

The bottle has 30 servings so for me that is about 10 weeks since the directions state one serving prior to working out or splitting the does throughout the day. Note: There is no need to “pre-load” BCAAs. So do not think you have to take more just to get started.

So far, I have been using these capsules for three weeks and I believe it is working. I do not feel as tired, as I did when I was not taking it. It takes time to reap the full benefits of BCAAs, but this product is off to a great start and has not disappointed.

BCAAs perform well with my other supplements and fits perfectly in my stack. The only downside (if you can call it that) is that you have to take 16 capsules. So if you do not like this or if your supplement stack already has capsules, then get ready to start swallowing these down a regular basis.

I hope you Amazon shoppers find this review helpful and take everything said above into consideration and give these BCAA capsules a try!

title: Scam - beware!
text:
This is the e-mail I just sent Earth Star:

"I have some feedback on your 120 count Earth Star Milk Thistle. I purchased it on Amazon last week on the strength of its reviews.

The bottle was sealed. It even had the little safety layer on top, so it had not been tampered with.

My Amazon Orders page says I was sent a bottle with 120 capsules. The bottle itself says 120 capsules. When I opened it, however, the amount looked 'wrong'. I figured there couldn't possibly be 120 pills in there. So I poured out into a bowl and counted only 60 capsules.

I checked the bottle one more time - it said 120.

There are two problems with this: a) I'm paying twice as much for your product than I should because you're providing half the amount of pills on the label, and b) something is seriously wrong in your operations. You either have a major quality control issue, or are willingly defrauding customers. Either way, it's serious.

This leads to the worst problem of all: if there are major issues in matters I can verify like the pill count, what about the things I CAN'T easily verify, such as the potency and effectiveness of the ingredients?

You've instantly created mistrust in your brand. Anyway, I've returned my bottle for a refund."

EDIT: I ran this link through an online fake review detector and this product came up with a "D" score. Just look at all the reviews in August where the reviewer says they got the product for free, or at a discount. Fishy.

title: sturdy yet pricey and ...old?
text:
I somewhat have mixed feelings for this item. For a $50 purchase I felt slightly dissapointed but I do recognize that functionally, it seems adequate for the job. Here is my effort to remain objective:

Shipping: It cost $13 to ship to TX and arrived 10 days after I placed the order. For the shipping cost vs. service, I would give this 2 stars, if not 1. I consider this pricey and slow shipping. My unqualified guess is a flat rate small box would have probably gotten it sooner at the same cost or less.

Product: I haven't yet tested it. The main frame seems sturdy and well built, and this was in essence the reason for me opting for this particular product. The aluminum cups I can't assess without actually using them first (which I haven't done so far). The span (opening) of the press seems big enough to accomodate larger watches. These come packed in a cardboard box. Some pins and accessories had been additionally packed in a round plastic container (kind of like a pill box), but the plastic was so old it had become brittle and the box was shattered. No harm to any of the working pieces, but the broken plastic did not make a good first impression.

Packaging and presentation: Packaging was ok, until I got down to the actual product box, which was closed with tape so old it was yellow. All the boxes seemed to have sat on a shelf for years. I was ok with it, given the metal pieces were in good condition, but don't expect bells and whistles on the presentation. For a $50 purchase I might have expected a little more here.

I will not be returning this (probably I'd loose money on the shipping), and consider I might only give it limited use, added to the fact I was able to service my watch with the watch vendor befor actually putting this to use. Hence, I would not purchase the item again, but note however I can not attribute this to product craftmanship or quality in general, as it seems to be up to the task of getting the job done... it's simply that I probably have no more use for it.

title: Best money spent for my child (and me)!
text:
Our alarm arrived one week ago Tuesday. It is now Thursday morning. My son is 5 yrs 9 months with primary enuresis. The first night he was up three times, which shocked me. I thought he was only peeing justh before wake up. Over the course of the week, it went to twice a night, then once a night. After exactly a week, I woke up at normal time and he had not been up yet. I wasnt sure if the battery pooped out or if he made it. When he woke up he was beaming... "Mom, I held it all night!"

I'm writing this the morning of the second quiet night. He is still asleep, but has not been up. I expect he is dry again. I told him after he is dry for three weeks he won't have to wear it anymore. In retrospect, i see that night time urination had become a habit for him. I guess some kids don't develop the cues to stop doing it. Whatever..... It worked! I couldnt be happiier for him and his little heart and for my washing machine.

The product itself is very simple. The alarm goes off when the cirucuit is completed via the wetness of the fabric it is attached to. I paid full price for this item and I would do it again. You do not need the expensive alarms. They all work under the same premise.

Ping me with questions, if needed.

title: Lemon flavor too strong for me
text:
I've tried three different varieties, and this was the worst because the lemon flavor is overpowering. It's just too much. I almost would rather throw it away than finish it, to be honest. With that said, if you're looking for something that hides the fishy taste, this is the perfect product for you.

The question is, Does it work? I have no idea since there is no obvious effect for me. By contrast [[ASIN:B003IVTCAM Green Pastures Blue Ice Fermented Cod Liver Oil ~ Oslo Orange ~ 8 Fl. oz (237 ml) Bottle = 118 Servings]] gives me a very noticeable boost in energy and mood (so, best take it in the morning), and I'm not the only one who seems to notice a boost in libido as well. The energy boost is so apparent that I cannot take it at night, or it will interfere with my sleep.

This Carlson oil may completely hide the fishy taste, but I feel nothing when I take it. It might as well be olive oil. It has been stripped of its A and D vitamins, unlike the product I just mentioned. I don't know what other processing Carlson does, but I believe the full potency of fish oil is best kept if the product is not overly processed. The fermented fish oil has been the best fish oil I've ever tried, even though it tastes the most like fish. I just remind myself that I'm buying this for the health effects, not for the pleasant taste.

I've also tried [[ASIN:B001G7QEP6 Twinlab Norwegian Cod Liver Oil, Unflavored, 12 Fluid Ounce]], and it was the same as Carlson's but without the overpowering lemon flavor. No noticeable effect.

I'm not sure if I can recommend this product. Sure, it tastes very lemony, but how do you know it's working if you feel nothing? I will take the fermented fish oil any day, and deal with the fishy taste. I'm sure I'm one of the few here to say so, but for real results, I would take the fishy taste over this strong lemon flavored product.

title: What an incredibly bad idea!
text:
What brilliant mind came up with a device to create MORE ozone?! One, I suppose that hasn't heard there's an issue with ozone and our planet's health.

Interesting that the company's stated mission is to "save the environment from the scourge of food waste". What about the scourge of dead batteries? Food wastes break down and return nutrients to the soil (even in a landfill); batteries, as they deteriorate, dump toxins into the soil and air. Thanks, but I'd choose rotten berries and greens any day.

A better (and cost-free) idea is to buy only enough produce to use in a reasonable period of time, and then use it. If some produce goes bad, toss it into your compost pile and use the fertile, rich soil that results in your pot plants/garden.

title: La Belle Vue Heated Ceramic Straightening Hairbrush
text: I love this straightening hairbrush! My hair is very long and thick. It's turning gray and becoming coarser as I age and it's very wavy and curly, a bit out of control. I have the kind of hair that curls and frizzes when it rains out. It took me a few times to learn how to use this brush, but now I can get my hair completely done in about 15 minutes. It's much straighter and shinier when it's done. To be fair, I use a good shampoo and conditioner by Brazilian Blowout. Then I follow up with HSI Professional Thermal protector. You want to make sure your hair is completely dry. I have used this brush when my hair was damp, but it produces a really hot steam. This brush quickly heats (about 5 minutes) up to 428 degrees, which seems to be my magic number for my unruly hair. I split my hair in half, so it hangs in front and brush each section very slowly. I count to ten as I brush down. It probably won't completely straighten your hair as well as a flat iron, but it's much faster! My hair still has some wave, but is mostly straight and stays straight into the next day. My biggest complaint is where the buttons are placed. They are in the handle right where my hand is, so I have to hang on to the tippy end of the brush. But other than that, I love it and feel that it was a really good investment.

title: After a full night's work in the garage, it seems to work!
text:
Mosquitoes LOVE me. And I don't love them.

Something about my blood attracts them, which has always made leaving my house in the evening a little bit of an adventure. I'm also allergic to their bites, so I swell up and itch horribly!

I was happy to give these a try, though, and to see if they ACTUALLY worked. And great news! They did! Or at least I'd like to think so.

Summer is starting to peek out over spring and I have a lot of outdoor projects I have to work on. I put one of these bands on my wrist and worked in the garage for the whole day and wasn't bit at all! That makes me assume they work.

Now the 3 bands themselves come in helpful resealable pouches, which is great because they STINK! When you open the package (or even get near it) you can really smell them. That's the unfortunate reality of blocking mosquitoes, though, so I don't blame the manufacturers! I have to say that after I removed the bands, I didn't notice any lingering smell, so it seems to have stuck with the band. Due to the resealable pouch you can place your wristband back into the pouch, and it can retain it's anti mosquito smell! I've only used mine a couple times and it's still going strong, so I don't know how long each band lasts, but it does seem to be at least a decent amount of time.

These are probably GREAT for bonfires, parties, and hiking!

I appreciate the opportunity to review this Mosquito Repellent Bracelets at a discount in exchange for my honest and unbiased review. I was in no way required to provide a positive review.

title: First experience was a good one.
text:
I'm a beekeeper, and although I never intend to get stung, it happens. Took what would be considered a light sting (I know, most people would never consider any bee sting "light", unless you're a beekeeper. Then, you know what I mean.) Immediately, I whipped out the pen and applied it to the spot. Then, I put the pen away and went on with my work. It wasn't until much later that I thought, "Hey, I don't have any swelling or itching where I got stung." It's the only time I've used it, and my first impression was positive. It is early in the season, and I know I'll get another chance to use it. If my opinion changes, I'll update this review.

Update: Am really impressed by how well this works on my bee stings. Granted, there is some research that shows that beekeepers can build up a resistance, but using this has significantly cut down on swelling from stings. I've found I need to use it about four or five time immediately after a sting for it to be fully effective.
Update2: Tried it on a mosquito bite for the first time and worked like a charm.
Update3: If I had one complaint (not enough for me to remove a star), it doesn't hold a charge for very long. If I haven't used it for a couple of weeks the battery is depleted.
Update 4: Doesn't hold a charge for more than a day (took away a star).

title: Great for runners!
text:
LiBa's Shiatsu Neck Massager is a great massager that is well made and looks like it will hold up with daily use. It has three buttons on the side of the massager. One to turn it on, one to turn the power on and off, and one to change the direction of the kneading balls. The massager also has arm straps so you can apply the right amount of pressure on the massager when it is on your neck. At first, I didn't think I'd use it but it does help me get the best massage for my neck and also my shoulders.

The buttons are easily reachable so that no matter where you use the massager on your body, you can easily access them. It comes with a wall plug as well as a car plug so I can use it in the car, at home, or the office though I have to say that it wasn't that comfortable in the car if you are using it on your lower back.

It is amazing on your calves if you work out regularly. After my daily run, I gave this massager a try and it made my legs feel great. It's OK on your lower back, good on your neck and shoulders with enough pressure applied.

My only complaint is that the heat is not very strong. I could barely feel it when I had it turned on. Honestly, the only way I knew the heat was on was because the massager turned red. Without that indication, I would never know the heat was on.

title: 12V 9Ah
text:
I was looking for a 9Ah replacement pair of batteries for my APC BX1500 UPS. I chose this brand at AAA Security Depot because AGM batteries are supposed to allow deeper/more discharge/recharge cycles. I found that all these batteries are SLA or sealed lead acid, so that is not a critical feature. I did buy a third battery for another single battery UPS, so I could get a small discount. The package arrived earlier than expected on my door step within a card board box, covered in a thinly padded US Postal "priority mail" mailer; each battery was in a thin open plastic baggy, I'm guessing to prevent the possibility of acid leakage damaging the other batteries. One of the F2 terminals was bent but easily straightened; if you use a metal screw driver, be careful not to short out against the other terminal. Double check your wiring before sealing it up; one of the connectors came loose and there was no output voltage - I used a voltmeter to confirm. If there is no voltage on a BX1500, the "Replace Battery" LED is lit solid and the alarm beeps every 2 seconds. Carefully read the specs at any battery site; I've seen several "suggested" batteries listed at a lower capacity of 7 or 8 amps - 7 amps is only sufficient for a lower capacity UPS like the APC BX1000.

If you don't plan to replace UPS batteries soon, pull them out; there was a slight difficulty removing them after I had left spent batteries installed for more than a year - they can bulge with age.

title: Minimal Improvement - nails stopped yellowing and cracking - yet now dark gray
text:
Minimal improvement after 6 months - nails stopped yellowing and cracking - yet now dark gray

From my Doctor - I will try these next -

Fungal nail suggestions:

Week 1) Daily soaks in dilute bleach solution: 1/2 tsp bleach in 16-32 oz of water
Week 2) Daily soaks in warm soapy water
Week 3) Daily soaks in dilute vinegar solution: 2 tsps vinegar in 16 oz of water
Week 4) Daily soaks in warm soapy water;

Repeat 1-4 until symptoms have resolved;

or

Apply antifungal creams as below:

Week 1) apply clotrimazole after the soaks
Week 2) apply tineacide after the soaks
Week 3) apply clotrimazole after the soaks

Rotate the creams weekly.
None of these methods can be guaranteed to eliminate fungal nails- but for folks wanting to try something different, they may be effective.

title: Use it to color your hair golden blond
text:
Golden blond hair color, organic and healthy.... I use this product as a hair color... mix it up with warm water to a yogurt consistency, cover and let stand overnight. Then apply liberally to hair, use it like mud, cover hair well. Then put processing cap on or wrap with plastic wrap, add a towel for warmth, and leave on a couple hours. Rinse out.

The result will be a healthy, gorgeous golden silky blond... at least going over gray/white hair. It is equally good over any hair color as a conditioner and to add gold highlights. It will last through several shampoos and then gradually fade. Much better for you than the toxic chemicals usually used to color hair. Try it.

text:
I am a skeptic. I try to resist hoaky natural and holistic stuff (my apologies to those who prefer them). I was getting very tired of taking OTC meds to keep the seasonal allergies (Hay fever) under control. My wife suggested these, and I started to take these, for grins, and to keep the peace. Within a week, I was not coughing sneezing, and above all, not experiencing side effects from medicine. I drive a convertible car, and I haven't raised the top (well, except when the weather is bad) to avoid allergy fits. I haven't felt this free since I was a kid.
Natural and effective (please note - YMMV). Two in the morning, Two in the evening. I never once had to succumb to OTC allergy medicine that made me feel either drowsy or hyper, this season.
Highly recommended to try, if you are suffering from allergies from airborne sneeze-inducing-eye-watering "stuff". I made it through the high season for allergies this year, and will most definitely use it next year!

title: It’s kind of hard to tell, but they do work….
text:
I’ve had these Nature Fresh bamboo charcoal air purifying bags for a couple of months now, and I’m happy with them. Our house has a couple of areas that always smell musty, although we can’t figure out why, and I put two each of the biggest bags (there are four of those) in each of those areas, and they’ve helped reduce the odor in there, and make things smell a little fresher. I also put the medium ones in a couple of our closets, where things get a little stuffy. It’s a little harder to tell whether those are having any impact in there, because there weren’t a lot of smells to begin with anyway, just kind of stuffy. And I wouldn't really expect these to do much about "stuffiness". But they certainly haven’t hurt anything. And finally, I put the other two in my "Ugg-like" boots that I keep at work, for when my feet get cold. Those are a real smelly challenge (!), and the charcoal has helped with the smells from those too. The fabric the bags are made from is nothing spectacular, but it’s pretty, and they are well made and look nice. So, all-in-all, I’m happy.

There are a couple of little issues with these, though, just to be aware of. The wall-hooks in the first picture aren’t included, although the two with the little buttons do have the strings on them. (I have no idea why two of them have buttons and strings and the others don't.) And, when they were shipped, the bags came just all tumbled together, and I had to come back to the website to re-read how to rejuvenate them. That’s by putting them in the sun for a couple of hours every month or so. I live in southern California, so that’s a viable option for me, but I wonder a little bit about folks who live in rainy or snowy climates during the winter. It might make sense to offer a low-heat oven option also, if there is one. I’ve rejuvenated them once, by putting them in the sun for the afternoon, and although I wasn’t really sure if they had stopped working, they definitely seem to still be working. And I’m about to do it again, after a second month. I’ll come back an update my review if they seem to stop working at some point.

All-in-all, though, these Nature Fresh charcoal bags seem to do what they claim to do. And although it would have been nice to receive some hooks or something to hang them with, the product webpage doesn’t say any hooks are included. In fact, most of the pictures show them being used without hooks, so I’m not going to take any stars off for that. (If I could do half-stars, I might have taken a half-star off…but it’s not worth a whole star.) Finally, please note that I received these bags for free from Amazon’s Vine Voice program, in exchange for my honest review.

title: Small, fragile
text:
I bought these hoping to be able to more neatly apply body powder (like Gold Medal). The concept is good, but the puff itself is pretty small (about 3" across) and fits very snugly into its container. Then I dropped one of these, and the material is so thin and brittle, the clear top got large cracks. Which I tried to mend with clear tape. Ugly!

The puff can be filled with powder, but again, the puff is so small that the filling cap and opening are too small to easily fill. You have to use a teaspoon! title: Overpriced, but the best white noise I've found
text:
We currently own 3 of these single speed Dohm machines. We bought the first one 5 years ago for the nursery. It was the perfect white noise sound, and it was super small so easy to pack for trips. So we bought a second one about a year late, just before my husband's business trip. Unfortunately about 6 months ago the older one started rattling a little bit. Not much, but it was enough to annoy me, so I knew it could interfere with the kids sleep. I really didn't want to pay $45 for this tiny little machine. However, I sucked it up and bought a third one. The only negative is the price.

The positives include:

- natural white noise sound (nothing like those awful Homemedic digital noise machines)
- can adjust the white noise by twisting it
- small and portable (easy to pack for trips, and takes up very little room on a dresser)
- has a mechanical switch so it's not digital. Therefore it won't crap out as soon as a digital Homemedic machine, AND if the power flickers off (like it did for us twice last night in the wee hours), as soon as power is restored this machine starts working again. So our 5 year olds didn't even notice it or wake up, since the outage was only for a few minutes at a time. We, however, still use a digital air purifier in our bedroom for white noise, so at 4am, well after the brief outage, I woke up thinking "Why is it so quiet??"

title: Didn't work on efflorescence
text:
EnviroSafe is described as the 'most potent masonry cleaner in the world' that 'cleans... retainer walls while dissolving all signs of efflorescence'. I certainly was hopeful that it would take care of the unsightly efflorescence problem on my retaining walls, but after spraying a fairly strong mix of EnviroSafe on the wall blocks several times and scrubbing with a stiff brush several times, I noticed very little improvement.

Before I bought EnviroSafe, I watched an online video that showed it removing efflorescence on some brick in about a minute with some scrubbing. That seemed pretty quick and a reasonable solution to the efflorescence problem that's affecting 20-some wall blocks. I worked on several blocks for at least 10 minutes each and the only thing I noticed was on the worst affected with a thicker accumulation of efflorescence, that it would 'chip' off in spots... far from 'dissolving all signs of efflorescence'. The wall blocks I used are only a year old and the efflorescence has not 'gone away' on it's own. The blocks have a rough surface, so maybe EnviroSafe only works well on smooth surfaces, as in the video.

I'm really disappointed as this is pretty expensive stuff and I'm left with the same efflorescence problem that I started with.

So around midnight this evening I carried the whole kit out to my car, swapped to the car adapter, and was so happy when the massager lit up again powered via my car.

As for replacing the wall adapter, I was able to find a replacement among my stash of adapters without having to order a new one, so I'm guessing the designers of this product kept it simple. I wish I could help offer an Amazon product number for replacement but it was a standard 12V supply with a very common male adapter.

I believe the harness for the massager is well made and has put up with a lot of my pulling on the hand-holds. I'm constantly shifting the massaging spots to different places along my neck, shoulders and back, and I'm always pulling hard on the seams of the materials of the harness to increase massage pressure; so far the seams have held up very well after two years.

title: Best sound machine
text:
We have slept with a sound machine in the bedroom ever since we lived next to a hideously ill-behaved family and their sad, ignored beagles. Both the humans and the beagles were noisy and disturbing at many points during each evening and night. When we moved to a new home after 1 year of neighboring with these people/animals we kept the sound machine in the room as we had grown used to the pleasant white noise.
Having purchased many different types and brands of sound machines over the last 15 years, I can say that the Marpac Sound Conditioner is by far the best one ever. The sound it produces is like having a fan on in the room, without having the cold air chilling the room during freezing Michigan winters. The sound is not a recording like so many sound machines have. Sometimes those white noise recordings have an annoying audible loop noise that can be really irritating. Not so with the Marpac unit. It actually produces the white noise when you turn it on, and it is a lovely, soothing, relaxing white noise that cancels out any distracting or disturbing noises from the sleeping area. The Marpac 580A is fine for a average/smaller sized bedroom. I would recommend the Marpac 980A 2 speed unit for master bedrooms and larger sized sleeping areas.

title: Huge Improvement in Impulse Control, Focus, and Chaotic Energy for 7yr Old w/ADHD
text: Our 7yr old son was diagnosed with ADHD, and behavior modification techniques weren’t helping much. We knew we were going to have to try medication, but we were very worried about putting him on the typical amphetamine based medications. A friend recommended Synaptol to us, and although I was skeptical, I thought it was worth a try. The difference in our son’s impulse control, ability to focus, and chaotic energy was noticeable after only 2 days! He’s only been on it for one week so far, but the results have been significant! He’s been able to sit down and complete his homework independently, with only verbal instruction from me one time. Usually, I have to guide him through almost every problem, even though he knows how to do it. He just can’t keep focused, and he gets frustrated easily. He’s been breezing through his reading without all the struggling. His level of self control and impulse control has turned a 180. Best of all, his personality hasn’t changed. He’s still his usual sweet energetic self, but the chaotic uncontrollable energy hasn’t been there. Now, I’ll admit, it’s only been one week, and there is the possibility that he just happened to hit a new maturity phase the same day we started Synaptol. Maybe it’s just coincidence that we’ve had an unusually successful week, but the difference has been vast! I’ll review again after a month and see if we’re still having the same success.

title: Great design. Shabby quality control. They don’t seem to learn from their mistakes.
text:
I bought the scooter from Enhancemobility not Amazon. I love love love the design. Right off the bat, the battery would not reach full chparge and one of the little wheels was bent preventing it from standing on its back. However the battery was the big deal. After many calls to the company and letting the battery charge for days like they asked, they finally agreed to send out a technician with a wheel, battery, and by that time the tiller had come loose. I waited for weeks and finally took the scooter to my mechanic and he fixed the tiller and wheel, but I still drove with this battery whose charge I was uncertain of. But it seemed ok, not anywhere near the range as advertised. But very serviceable. At some point the battery began to show full charge for a few seconds when powered up, so I was pleased and began to use the scooter more. Also the regenerative braking system began to light the 3rd charge light on the battery indicator, so I was convinced the battery was as charged as it was going to get.
Yesterday January 1, 2019, I took the scooter to the park and used a ramp to get to a grove. Very easy grade. On the way back up, the scooter performed very well as I took it slowly up the ramp. The battery never degraded, the charge indicator held steady at the middle setting. 2/3rds up the ramp the scooter stopped accompanying a burning smell. I pushed the scooter the ramp and to the car, placed it upright and touched the motor. It was VERY hot. I don’t think the 160W motor is powerful enough. I have had other scooter with 300 and 350 Watt motors that never did this. Out of money for something I’ve only had a few months.

More to the story. Enhance sent me a new scooter!! It behaves totally differently. The battery problem I had is gone, and the scooter handles ramps and little inclines smoothly. The other little annoyances are not with this scooter. I am going say I got a lemon. That makes sense to me, since they still have QA issues. My new scooter was almost perfect, but there was no air in the tires, and one of the tires requires a 90° fitting to check or put air in the tire because the valve stem is tight against the rim. Something they may have discovered if they had put air in the tires. Also try finding a 90° fitting on a air pump at a gas station.

So I am bumping them to 3 star for the product.

Hey. Remember the tire problem on the new scooter? Well that tire kept on leaking. It went flat at a plant store in Michigan. I noticed the battery losing power sooner than usual, but not the tire. I mean the battery was fresh, and previously I had put miles on it before this charge, so I thought something was wrong. I headed out of the store when the scooter stopped and that burning smell returned. Aren’t these motors fused?!!! My friends travel scooter stops when the motor gets overheated and makes you wait until it’s cooled off. I guess the bad tired caused the motor to overwork, and it burned up. The second burned up motor in less than 6 months. Got to get off this ride for good.

title: ZERO effect after three months using as directed
text:
I have used this product for more than three months to no effect. When you order this product, the seller sends you an email emphasizing the importance of using it consistently for three months, preferably along with their complimentary product Tinnitivix. I did this faithfully, but my tinnitus (which is mild) has not changed.

Serving size is two capsules per day, but they say you can take up to four times this amount. I bought 5-months worth (2 bottles at 60 capsules, and 1 bottle at 180 capsules). I gradually increased the dosage as follows: One month at 2/day (60), 1/2 month at 4/day (60), 1/3 month at 6/day (60), 1/2 month at 4/day (60), one month at 2/day (60). This was a total time of three and one-third months.

I started slow to make sure there was no adverse reaction, increased the dosage to see if there was any difference, and ramped back down so that I could complete the three months without spending a fortune. If it showed any promise, I might have considered the cost worthwhile.

I was hopeful, but ended up being disappointed that this product was ineffective. It may work for you, but I cannot endorse it. See also my similar review for Tinnitivix.

title: High quality and organic!
text:
If you're a health food lover and you haven't been using bee pollen in your smoothies or on your granola, you are missing out on something wonderful. Bee pollen is absolutely packed with nutrients and enzymes that help you digest your food better. For people with certain barriers to weight loss, the hormonal balancing that regular consumption of bee pollen provides can help you lose stubborn weight. I urge you to do your research and see if it interests you, but if it does (or if you already know about this amazing superfood) then Kangaroo is a great place to start. First they're certified organic. Since that involve proving that the land that every plant the bees land on was grown on has been free of pesticides/insecticides and all other toxic chemicals for a certain period of time, this is a rigorous process to go through, and few sources bother. Here are some other good things about it.

Pros:

-This pollen is from Greece, not China (where most of it comes from). That means much less of a chance of industrial pollution on the plants the bees collect the pollen from.

-This pollen is fresh! You can tell, because the granules are soft and slightly moist, and dissolve on the tongue. If your bee pollen is crunchy, it's been either deliberately dried or it old and stale from lost moisture.

-Make sure to keep it refrigerated after opening! It's very important, as this is a raw food, and the warning is very small on the bottle.

Cons:

-It's very expensive for bee pollen. HOWEVER, it is a very high quality.

Overall, if you're willing to pay more for quality, I highly recommend this bee pollen.

title: Perfect Design With  Assembly & Quality Control Issues
text:
I really, really wanted to like this scooter, but it has serious assembly & functional issues. The first scooter was dead on arrival; all the lights worked, but the motor did not. The manufacturer put me through some work-around procedures on the phone, but the motor simply was dead. To their credit they immediately sent a replacement.

The second scooter at least did run, but the transmission made a loud "clunk" with every revolution. I sent the manufacturer a sound clip of this, and was assured they would solve my issue. I gave them a week to do so, and having not heard from them, gave them a call. It took them that long to decide I needed to send it back for repair. Well, after two strikes I decided to seek a refund. Clearly this relatively new product was having birthing issues.

Getting the refund now involved the retailer, Senior Com, and that was so difficult to do that I had to file a claim under Amazon's "A to Z Refund Policy." Until then, dealing with Senior Com was worse than having a root-canal at a lousy dentist! They did everything they could to delay, until Amazon stepped in. After that it took only a few days to see an improved attitude on the seller's part, and soon thereafter I received my refund from Amazon.

I will never do business with Senior Com as their motto is; "Once you have their money you never give it back." Thankfully Amazon was there to resolve my issue; but the whole protracted process took over a month, with lots of promises from Senior Com, but no follow up unless forced to do so by me and finally Amazon.

Pro:
1. The lightest, easiest to lift scooter on the market.
2. Beautiful design, but terrible assembly - I had to tighten almost every nut and bolt, including those that hold the tiller to the frame. Loose bolts can easily develop fractures that lead to failure, and in this critical part it could mean serious injury for a person.
3.Very good control of speed, both slow and fast.
4. Excellent turning radius - it can turn around in its length, and easily navigate through stores and small aisles.
5. Speedy

Cons:
1. Very poor motor and transmission
2. Poor customer service from Senior Com
3. Noisy transmission
4. Loose bolts throughout
5. Feels like it will fail within a few months of use.

Again, I really wanted to like this scooter, but $2,200 is far too much to pay for a shoddy product and unresponsive seller. I subsequently purchased a Pride Victory 10, and while it is not as portable, requiring a rear carrier, it is much better in quality and design. I do hope Triaxe can fix their scooter, and if they do I might reconsider buying one, but only through a local dealer that will be responsive and honest.

title: Total game changer, so great!
text:
Seriously, if you havent switched from regular solution to this you need to do it ASAP. Game changer. My contacts feel brand new every single day! I asked my eye doc about it and he said he thinks the stuff is AWESOME (he was very emphatic about the word awesome). I told him the only downside was it was causing me to wear my contact WAY longer than the suggested 1 month. He said the only reason to change them out is that they can get torn or frayed, so as long as they felt nice and new I could wear them as long as I wanted. That means my normal 6 month set of contacts is lasting me a whole year! This stuff is great!!

Important downsides to keep in mind, though: You MUST keep your contacts in the solution for 6 hours. If you need them again sooner, you can remove them and wash them THOROUGHLY with REGULAR solution, but under no circumstance should you put them back in before 6 hours straight out of this solution. It contains hydrogen peroxide and HURTS LIKE YOU WOULDNT BELIEVE if you dont give it 6 hours to deactivate. I made this mistake once, and only once :) Also, the case should stay upright and you empty/refill it completely every day, so it is not ideal for travelling. The travel sized bottle will only last you a few days and keeping it upright can be a pain in some travel situations (ex. camping). I still keep regular solution that I use for travel. All this is not enough to knock off a star, it's just too darn good.

title: Obsolete scale kills Wi-Fi speeds
text:
The Aria has a fundamental flaw: It only supports 802.11b Wi-Fi, which is obsolete. Newer Wi-Fi routers don't support 802.11b by default—and sometimes not at all. By enabling 802.11b on your new, fast 802.11ac Wi-Fi router, you'll slow down every device on your network. Fitbit could fix this by re-engineering the Aria to use a newer chip that supports 802.11g or 802.11n, but they haven't.

As a scale, it works well enough, and has good battery life. To access the readings online, you'll need to use Fitbit's proprietary website or app; it doesn't support Apple HomeKit, for example. Getting data out of the Fitbit site to share with, say, a physician is not easy.

While my Aria lasted until I discarded it (because it was killing Wi-Fi speeds for my whole family), other Fitbit products I've owned haven't fared so well. It doesn't seem to me that build quality is high on Fitbit's list of priorities. Neither is customer support; previously, they would replace a clearly defective product if it failed just outside of warranty. Nowadays, they hide behind the exact terms of the warranty, even for failures that are clearly their fault. So I can't recommend the company's products generally.

But that Wi-Fi thing... this is an obsolete scale. Don't waste your money.

title: Elegant and looks great on granite!
text:
I really like this diffuser. It is glass on the outside with a plastic interior. It is very easy to use, plug and play. You place the water and the oil in the some container. I used filtered tap water and did not have any issues. It puts out a decent plume of mist, but there have been no issues with any condensation or oil residue. I am very new to the diffuser scene and was very concerned about placing it on my wood or granite. I started by placing it on an older table and about every hour moved it to a new surface. I placed a paper towel below and there was no moisture at all. The top of the diffuser just sets on the base, it does not lock. It makes it really easy to refill, but you would need to be careful in higher traffic areas. The whole diffuser sits on three tabs at the bottom that easily allows the cord to come out and stabilizes the egg-shaped design. I've refilled it and moved it several times and there has been no fingerprints or smudging on the glass.

It came with an instruction manual and a small cup to refill it with water. The max fill line is a bit difficult to see. Mine ran for 4 hours without having to refill. There are only two modes: constant mist or intervals of 30 seconds on and 30 seconds off. I would definitely recommend purchasing this diffuser. It is a bit pricier than some of the other diffusers that you can purchase, but it very attractive and looks amazing on my granite. If you are looking for a reasonably priced diffuser that is not plastic and does not have all the lighting features, this diffuser is for you. This is very high quality and very nice thick glass.

I did receive this product at a discounted price for my honest and unbiased feedback. I strongly rely on product reviews when making online purchases, so I attempt to give a thorough and accurate description about my experience and the product when writing any review.

title: A great part of my "stop the bleeding" kit, and easier to use than a CAT
text:
I carry tourniquets in all my first aide kits - most of them started off as "boo boo" kits, with band-aids and gauze, but I've added good shears, tourniquets, clotting gauze, and chest seals to them to build an effective "stop the bleeding" kit.

While there are many CAT tourniquets in my my kits, I recently tried out the SAM XT, at the recommendation of a military combat aide instructor. He claimed (and I agree) that the SAM XT tourniquets are a bit more "fool proof" to use. Simply loop over the extremity and pull until it clicks, then tighten the windlass. CAT versions work well enough, but can be difficult to use on yourself or get tight enough before winding. These take the guesswork out of that process with the self setting tightness mechanism.

title: Work Great, Taste like Energy Shots.

title: Works. Good for traveling.
text: This stuff works great. Aerosol can means no "pumping." Can has a lock on top that turns to prevent accidental misfires. Good to pack in you luggage. (Must be in checked luggage. Can is too big for carry on. Too much liquid for the TSA.) One con: fragrance/chemical smell can be strong when clothes are still damp and lingers a little after they are dry. Works if you use it sparingly - which is good because if you use too much, the fragrance/chemical smell can be strong if you use a bunch - especially without time to air dry / air out overnight.

title: My big dogs won’t eat these in their food!
text: Note: if you have a smaller dog, you will need to puncture the capsule and add it to your dog’s food!! If you have a super savvy bigger dog like mine, he will find the capsule in his food and take it to the bathroom and drop it in there, and you will then have to puncture the capsule and add it to his food later!  Such a pain. I wish these had a bacon flavor or something to entice them to eat them on their own. They don’t seem to notice or mind the liquid on their food though, so I will keep puncturing them and adding it to their food. I’m a mom of three and I didn’t need an extra step in my daily routine but alas, here we are. This stuff better work!
